title_en: How to Generate SEO-Friendly Blog Posts Using Ask AI in HighLevel
source_md:
[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/Ysy-vvffY8E?&wmode=opaque)

Create complete, SEO-friendly blog posts in a single Ask AI prompt. Ask AI Full AI-powered Blog Post Generation lets you brainstorm topics, generate outlines, and produce long-form drafts without leaving HighLevel, so you can keep your entire blogging workflow in one place.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Ask AI Blog Post Generation?](#%E2%80%8B%E2%80%8BWhat-is-Ask-AI-Blog-Post-Generation?%C2%A0)
- [Key Benefits of Ask AI Blog Post Generation](#Key-Benefits-of-Ask-AI-Blog-Post-Generation)
- [AI Blog Post Generation via Ask AI](#AI-Blog-Post-Generation-via-Ask-AI%C2%A0)
- [Smarter Content Generation with Web Context](#Smarter-Content-Generation-with-Web-Context)
- [Multi-Language Blog Generation](#Multi-Language-Blog-Generation%C2%A0)
- [URL & Image Referencing Support](#URL-&-Image-Referencing-Support%C2%A0)
- [Working with Blog Draft Output](#Working-with-Blog-Draft-Output)
- [How To Setup Ask AI Blog Post Generation](#How-To-Setup-Ask-AI-Blog-Post-Generation)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions%C2%A0)
  - [Related Articles](#%C2%A0Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Ask AI Blog Post Generation?**

Ask AI Blog Post Generation is an end-to-end content feature that turns a simple prompt or topic into a structured, long-form blog draft right inside the Ask AI workspace. Instead of jumping into separate editors or third‑party tools, you can ideate, outline, and draft full blog posts through a single conversational interface, then move your content into HighLevel Blogs for formatting, SEO, and publishing.

Ask AI uses the same underlying AI platform that powers other HighLevel AI experiences, combining your prompts with optional web context, URLs, and images to generate posts that are more accurate, on‑topic, and ready to refine.

---

## **Key Benefits of Ask AI Blog Post Generation**

Ask AI Blog Post Generation is designed to remove friction from long-form content creation so agencies and businesses can publish more consistently without sacrificing quality.

- **Faster content creation:** Move from idea to full draft in a single prompt, without manually building outlines or paragraphs.

- **Reduced reliance on external AI tools:** Keep your blog workflow inside HighLevel instead of juggling multiple writing apps and copy‑paste steps.

- **SEO-friendly structure by default:** Ask AI suggests titles, headings, and formatting that map well to how Blogs and search engines interpret content.

- **Improved topical relevance with web context:** For current or trending topics, Ask AI can pull in recent information so your blogs don’t feel outdated.

- **Multi-language and localization:** Generate content in multiple languages to support regional sites or global audiences from the same workspace.

- **Stronger content consistency:** Starting from a clear, structured draft makes it easier to maintain tone, depth, and angle across your blog library.

---

## **AI Blog Post Generation via Ask AI**

AI Blog Post Generation via Ask AI focuses on turning your high-level topic or prompt into a complete, logically organized blog article. This capability is ideal for getting a high‑quality first draft that you can refine rather than writing from a blank page.

When you ask Ask AI to “write a blog post about…” or “draft a 1,500‑word article on…”, it can:

- **Suggest blog titles**
  - Multiple title options to match different angles (how‑to, listicle, thought leadership, etc.).
  - Variations that emphasize keywords, outcomes, or target audiences.

- **Generate structured headings & subheadings**
  - H1‑style main title plus H2/H3‑style sections that mirror how blog editors typically structure posts.
  - Logical progression from introduction → body sections → conclusion or CTA.

- **Apply SEO‑friendly content formatting**
  - Short paragraphs, skimmable subheadings, and bullet/numbered lists where they improve readability.
  - Optional inclusion of keyword‑focused headings based on your prompt.

- **Write long-form paragraphs**
  - Multi‑paragraph sections that go beyond surface‑level explanations.
  - Ability to request specific length (e.g., “~1500 words” or “brief 600‑word article”).

- **Produce blog‑ready draft output**
  - Content organized so you can copy it into a Blog Post editor or other content workflow with minimal clean‑up.

---

## **Smarter Content Generation with Web Context**

Web-contextual generation helps Ask AI produce blogs that feel current, specific, and credible—especially for fast‑changing topics, industries, or tools.

Ask AI can leverage web-based context to:

- **Improve topic relevance**
  - Aligns explanations with up‑to‑date terminology, trends, and best practices.
  - Reduces the chance of obviously outdated examples or references.

- **Increase content depth**
  - Brings in relevant statistics, frameworks, or examples from across the web.
  - Helps long-form sections feel more like a researched article than a generic opinion piece.

- **Boost accuracy for trending or current topics**
  - Useful for blogs about recent events, product updates, policy changes, or platform features.
  - Lets you ask for “recent trends in…” or “latest best practices for…” and have the draft reflect that recency.

- **Enhance overall quality of generated blogs**
  - Produces more grounded, context‑aware drafts you can fact-check and adapt to your brand voice.

*Web context doesn’t replace human editorial review.* You should still scan the draft, verify key facts, and add proprietary insights or examples before publishing.

---

## **Multi-Language Blog Generation**

Multi-language support allows you to generate and localize blog content for different markets using the same Ask AI workflow. This is especially useful for agencies serving multi‑region clients or brands that maintain localized sites.

Ask AI can:

- **Generate full posts directly in another language**
  - Prompt in English and ask, for example: “Generate this blog in Spanish for a Mexico-based audience.”
  - Or prompt entirely in the target language.

- **Localize tone and examples**
  - Adjust phrasing, cultural references, and calls to action to feel more natural to local audiences (based on your prompt instructions).

- **Support translation workflows**
  - Translate an existing English draft into another language while preserving structure and intent.
  - Help align multiple language versions around the same outline.

Even with strong AI translation, plan to have a native or fluent speaker review high‑stakes content to confirm nuance, local terminology, and compliance.

---

## **URL & Image Referencing Support**

URL and image referencing gives Ask AI richer context about your brand, product, or topic—so blog drafts can better match your real‑world assets and positioning. Similar to Blog Post AI inside the Blog Editor, Ask AI can use URLs and images you provide purely as context when drafting content.

You can:

- **Provide URLs for contextual reference**
  - Product pages, documentation, feature landing pages.
  - Previous blogs you want to emulate or update.
  - Third‑party articles you want summarized or contrasted.

- **Attach or reference images**
  - Logos, product screenshots, diagrams, or campaign imagery.
  - Visuals that help AI infer industry, style, or use case.

Ask AI then uses this context to:

- Align terminology and messaging with what’s on your site.
- Suggest where images could be inserted in the blog (e.g., “include the dashboard screenshot here”).
- Better match the level of sophistication your audience expects.

Note: URLs and images are used as **input context**, not automatically embedded in your blog content. You still control which links and images actually appear when you format the article in Blogs or your page builder.

---

## **Working with Blog Draft Output**

The blog-ready draft you receive from Ask AI is intentionally flexible. You can use it as a complete first draft or break it into sections to feed other tools like Blog Post AI and the Blog Post Editor.

Typical workflow:

- **Copy the draft into your Blogs workflow**
  - Navigate to **Sites → Blogs**, choose your blog site, and create a new post.
  - Paste the Ask AI output into the content area and adjust heading levels as needed.

- **Refine with Blog Post AI or Edit with Ask AI**
  - Use **Blog Post AI** in the editor to expand, shorten, or rephrase individual sections, or to adjust for specific SEO keywords and internal links.
  - Use “Edit with Ask AI” style instructions (e.g., “tighten this section to 3 paragraphs” or “rewrite this intro for beginners”) to iteratively improve clarity and tone.

- **Add internal links, CTAs, and metadata**
  - Insert calls to action, lead magnets, or navigation to related posts.
  - Set slug, SEO title, meta description, cover image, and canonical URL in the Blog Post settings.

- **Preview and publish**
  - Use the Preview tools in Blogs to confirm layout, mobile rendering, and link behavior before going live.

---

## **How To Setup Ask AI Blog Post Generation**

A smooth setup ensures your team can reliably access Ask AI, track AI usage, and plug blog drafts into your existing Blogs and SEO workflows.

**1. Confirm Ask AI access and AI billing**

- Ensure Ask AI is enabled for your Agency and sub‑accounts. If you can see the **Ask AI** icon in your top or left navigation, the assistant is available.
- Verify that your Agency is on a plan that supports Ask AI (e.g., AI Employee Unlimited) or has pay‑per‑use Ask AI enabled in the AI Product Pricing settings.
- Optional: Use the **AI Usage Dashboard** to monitor Ask AI sessions and cost as blog generation ramps up.

---

**2. Open Ask AI in your preferred workspace**

- At the **Agency** or **Sub‑account** level, open **Ask AI**from:
  - The **top navigation bar** icon, or
  - The **left navigation menu** item for a full‑screen workspace.
  - Alternatively, you can go to **Sites-> Blogs** from the sub account navigation menu.

- Click **New chat** to start a fresh conversation dedicated to your blog draft.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155071523797/original/CBM2wCM54TultcMwbjzSAQDPyKZPjiByuQ.png?1779083274)

**3. Provide a clear blog prompt (topic + instructions)**

Give Ask AI enough context to generate a high-quality, on‑brand draft. For example:

- “Write a 1,500‑word blog post for small business owners on ‘How to use SMS marketing to boost appointment bookings’. Audience: local service businesses. Tone: friendly but professional. Include headings, subheadings, and a conclusion with a call to action.”

Helpful details to include:

- Target audience and expertise level
- Desired length (approximate word count or “short/medium/long”)
- Tone and brand style (or mention your configured Brand Voice, if applicable)
- Primary SEO keyword(s) or phrases
- Any offers, features, or CTAs the post should promote

---

**4. (Optional) Add URLs and images for richer context**

To help Ask AI better understand your offer and source material:

- Paste **URLs** (e.g., product pages, existing blogs, or reference articles).
- Add or reference **images** that capture your brand or feature set.

Then clarify how they should be used:

- “Use this URL as background on our product and ensure the blog aligns with this positioning.”
- “Use this screenshot as the main image and reference it when explaining the dashboard.”

---

**5. Generate and review the blog draft**

- Submit your prompt and wait for Ask AI to produce:
  - Title suggestions
  - Structured headings and subheadings
  - Long‑form body content
  - Optional bullet lists, numbered steps, or summaries.

- If the first result isn’t quite right, you can:
  - Ask for revisions (“shorten this section”, “make the intro more story‑driven”).
  - Request alternative angles (“focus more on ROI metrics”, “rewrite for non‑technical readers”).

---

**6. Move the draft into Blogs for formatting and publishing**

- Copy the final draft from Ask AI.
- Go to **Sites → Blogs → [Your Blog] → New Post** and paste the content into the Blog Post editor.
- Use Blog Post tools to:
  - Add images, embeds, and internal links.
  - Configure SEO fields (slug, title, description, canonical URL, keywords).
  - Preview, schedule, or publish.

For more advanced editor‑side AI, you can also use **Blog Post AI** to further optimize sections, translate content, or apply URL/image referencing from within the Blog Editor itself.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Does Ask AI automatically create a Blog Post in the Blogs area, or only the draft content?**

Ask AI Blog Post Generation produces a structured blog draft inside the Ask AI chat. You then copy that content into the Blog Post editor (Sites → Blogs) to create or update an actual Blog Post record, where you configure SEO, authors, categories, and publishing settings.

**Q: How is Ask AI blog generation different from Blog Post AI in the Blog Editor?**

Ask AI focuses on conversational, workspace‑style drafting—you can brainstorm, compare angles, and generate full posts without opening the editor. Blog Post AI runs inside the Blog Post editor and is optimized for in‑place drafting, refinement, translation, and URL/image‑aware tweaks. Many teams use Ask AI to get a strong first draft, then Blog Post AI for fine‑tuning and SEO polishing.

**Q: Does using web context guarantee 100% factual accuracy?**

No. Web context greatly improves freshness and relevance, especially around trending topics, but AI-generated content can still misinterpret or over‑generalize information. Treat the draft as a research‑assisted starting point and manually verify any critical facts, statistics, or claims before publishing.

**Q: How do I control length, tone, and SEO keywords in the generated blog?**

Specify these details directly in your prompt (e.g., target word count, tone like “authoritative but friendly,” and primary keywords). You can then ask Ask AI to revise sections—shorten, expand, adjust tone, or emphasize a keyword—until the draft meets your needs.

**Q: Are URLs and images automatically embedded into the blog draft?**

No. Ask AI uses URLs and images as **context** to shape the content (terminology, examples, structure), but you decide which links and images to embed in the final article when you format it in the Blog Post editor or page builder.

**Q: Can I generate blogs in multiple languages in the same chat?**

Yes. You can ask Ask AI to create one version in English and then request localized versions (e.g., Spanish, French, German) by specifying the target language and audience. It’s best to treat each language draft as a starting point and have a fluent reviewer confirm nuance and compliance before publishing.

**Q: Is there an additional cost for using Ask AI for blog generation?**

Ask AI usage is billed according to your AI plan: some accounts use **AI Employee Unlimited**, while others use **pay‑per‑use** pricing for Ask AI sessions. Blog generation typically counts as a richer Ask AI task, so you may see higher per‑session cost compared to very short queries. Always refer to the **AI Product Pricing** and **Ask AI Sessions Pricing Overview** articles for the latest pricing details.

**Q: Who can access Ask AI Blog Post Generation?**

Ask AI features are available wherever Ask AI itself is enabled. If a user can open Ask AI from the navigation, they should gain access to blog generation as it rolls out. Access at the sub‑account level still depends on your plan and user permissions (e.g., AI Employee Unlimited and supported roles).

**Q: How does this feature interact with existing blog import tools?**

Ask AI Blog Post Generation complements existing blog importers (URL scraper, CSV imports). Use Ask AI for net‑new content or rewrites; use importers when migrating an existing library from another platform into HighLevel Blogs, then refine posts with AI as needed.

**Q: Can Ask AI include tables, checklists, or diagrams in my blog content?**

Yes. Ask AI can return structured artifacts—tables, checklists, and other formatted outputs—and you can adapt those into your blog post layout. If you request Mermaid diagrams or other visual structures, they’ll appear in Ask AI as artifacts that you can convert into screenshots or reformat for your blog.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [Introduction to Ask AI Assistant](https://help.gohighlevel.com/a/solutions/articles/155000005327?portalId=48000045315)

- [Create Blog Posts with AI](https://help.gohighlevel.com/a/solutions/articles/155000007201?portalId=48000045315)

title_en: How to Use the Shopify Integration with Your Account
source_md:
Connect your Shopify store to HighLevel to bring ecommerce data into your sub-account and support follow-up, automation, and customer management. The Shopify integration helps sync supported Shopify data such as products, collections, contacts, orders, and transactions, making it easier to manage ecommerce activity from HighLevel. Use this guide to connect Shopify, choose what data to import, configure ongoing sync settings, and understand important limitations before setup.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is the Shopify Integration?](#What-is-the-Shopify-Integration?)
  - [Key Benefits of the Shopify Integration](#Key-Benefits-of-the-Shopify-Integration)
  - [Shopify Connection Methods](#Shopify-Connection-Methods)
  - [Import Elements](#Import-Elements)
  - [Sync Settings](#Sync-Settings)
  - [Contact Fields Added from Shopify](#Contact-Fields-Added-from-Shopify)
  - [Important Notes and Limitations](#Important-Notes-and-Limitations)
  - [How To Setup the Shopify Integration](#How-To-Setup-the-Shopify-Integration)
  - [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
  - [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is the Shopify Integration?**

The Shopify integration connects your Shopify store to a HighLevel sub-account so supported ecommerce data and events can be used inside HighLevel. Once connected, Shopify data can support ecommerce workflows, customer follow-up, product visibility, and order-related automation.

The current Shopify connection experience uses an OAuth App method, which allows users to authorize the connection through Shopify without manually creating a Shopify custom app and copying an Admin API access token. Existing stores connected through the older Custom App method may continue syncing unless the connection is disconnected.

---

## **Key Benefits of the Shopify Integration**

The Shopify integration helps ecommerce teams centralize Shopify activity inside HighLevel and use that data for better customer engagement, automation, and sales follow-up.

- **Simplified setup:** Connect Shopify using an app-based OAuth flow instead of manually creating a custom app and API token.
- **Historical data import:** Bring supported Shopify data into HighLevel during setup, including available products, collections, contacts, orders, and transactions.
- **Ongoing data sync:** Keep selected Shopify data syncing into HighLevel after the initial connection.
- **Ecommerce automation support:** Use synced Shopify activity with supported ecommerce workflow triggers, such as abandoned checkout and order-related automation.
- **Better customer follow-up:** Use Shopify customer and order activity to create more relevant email, SMS, and workflow experiences.
- **Centralized ecommerce visibility:** View and use supported Shopify information from inside the connected HighLevel sub-account.

- **Automatic contact enrichment:** Every contact synced from a connected Shopify store is enriched with purchase history data- lifetime spend, order count, first and last order date, and tax-exempt status. These fields are visible directly on the contact record, with no extra setup.

---

## **Shopify Connection Methods**

Shopify can be connected using the newer OAuth App method or the older Custom App method. Understanding the difference helps users choose the right path and avoid creating unnecessary duplicate connections.

| Connection Method | Best For | Setup Experience | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| OAuth App Method | New Shopify connections | Authorize Shopify through the app connection flow | Recommended for new connections because it reduces manual setup steps. |
| Custom App Method | Existing legacy Shopify connections | Create a Shopify custom app and use an Admin API access token | Older setup method documented in existing Shopify integration guidance. |

```
Important: Existing Shopify stores connected through the legacy Custom App method may continue working. However, Shopify Basic stores using this connection method must reconnect through OAuth to access supported protected customer data and the newly available Customer and Order sync capabilities.
Stores already connected through OAuth do not need to reconnect.
```

---

## **Import Elements**

Import Elements control which supported Shopify records are brought into HighLevel during the initial connection process. This is typically used for historical Shopify data that already exists before the integration is connected.

Available import options may include:

- Products
- Collections
- Contacts
- Orders
- Transactions

Choose the data types that are useful for your HighLevel workflows and customer management needs. For example, importing products and collections can help make Shopify catalog information available, while importing contacts and orders can support customer follow-up and ecommerce reporting workflows. HighLevel’s Shopify migration guidance confirms support for importing and syncing products, collections, contacts, orders, and transactions.

---

## **Sync Settings**

Sync Settings control which Shopify data continues syncing into HighLevel after the connection is active. These settings are different from the initial import because they apply to ongoing activity after setup.

Use Sync Settings to keep selected Shopify data updated in HighLevel. For example, enabling order sync can help new Shopify order activity become available for supported ecommerce workflows and follow-up actions.

Before selecting sync options, confirm which Shopify data your team needs in HighLevel. Turning off a sync option later may stop future syncing, but it may not remove records that were already imported or synced.

---

## **Customer and Order Sync for Shopify Basic Plans**

Shopify stores on the Basic plan can now access supported protected customer data and synchronize customer and order information through the HighLevel Shopify integration.

A Shopify plan upgrade is not required for these supported capabilities.

**For existing OAuth connections:**

If your Shopify store is already connected through OAuth, you do not need to reconnect.

Enable the following options in the Shopify integration's Sync Settings:

- Contact Sync

- Order Sync

Shopify Basic stores can also use supported Customer and Order webhooks to keep data synchronized with HighLevel.

**For legacy Custom App connections:**

If you connected your Shopify store using the legacy Custom App method, you must reconnect through OAuth to access supported protected customer data.

After reconnecting, you can enable the supported Contact and Order sync options.

For Shopify OAuth connection instructions, see the "How To Setup the Shopify Integration" section above.

---

## **Contact Fields Added from Shopify**

When a contact is imported or synced from a connected Shopify store, the integration automatically creates and keeps a set of fields updated on that contact's record. These fields update on their own after the initial sync- there's no per-field setup required.

Standard contact fields

These map to fields that already exist on every HighLevel contact. Shopify only fills them in if they're currently empty — it never overwrites a value you or another source already set.

| Field | Filled from Shopify |
| --- | --- |
| First name / Last name | Customer's name on Shopify |
| Email | Customer's default email (used to match the Shopify customer to the HighLevel contact — never overwritten) |
| Phone | Customer's default phone number |
| Address | Customer's default address |

New Shopify custom fields

| Field | Shows | Updates when |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Shopify Customer ID | Internal Shopify customer reference | Once, when the contact is first created |
| Shopify Store Name | Which connected Shopify store the contact came from | Once, when the store is connected |
| Shopify Lifetime Value | Total amount the customer has spent in that Shopify store | After each completed (paid) order |
| Shopify Order Count | Total number of completed orders | After each completed (paid) order |
| Shopify Last Order Date | Date of the customer's most recent completed order | After each completed order |
| Shopify Last Order Value | Value of the customer's most recent completed order | After each completed order |
| Shopify First Order Date | Date of the customer's first completed order | Once, after their first completed order |
| Shopify Tax Exempt | Whether Shopify has this customer marked as tax-exempt (a common signal for wholesale/B2B buyers) | Whenever the customer's Shopify record is updated |
| Shopify Email Consent   (Coming soon) | The customer's email marketing consent status on Shopify | Whenever consent changes in Shopify |
| Shopify SMS Consent  (Coming soon) | The customer's SMS marketing consent status on Shopify | Whenever consent changes in Shopify |

Shopify customer tags are synced to the existing tag field for a contact record. Use these fields as filters in Smart Lists (for example, "orders more than 90 days ago") or as conditions in Workflows to branch messaging by purchase behavior.

## 

## **Important Notes and Limitations**

Shopify sync behavior may vary depending on Shopify plan access, selected settings, and the type of data being synced. Reviewing these notes before setup helps prevent confusion after the connection is active.

- Shopify data that has already been imported or synced into HighLevel may remain in HighLevel even if the related sync setting is turned off later.
- Shopify Basic plan stores can access supported protected customer data and synchronize customer and order information through the OAuth-based Shopify integration. Legacy Custom App connections require OAuth reconnection to access these capabilities.
- Use the exact Shopify store name or store URL when prompted during setup.
- Existing Custom App method connections should not be disconnected unless the user is ready to reconnect using the current supported connection flow.
- Shopify workflow triggers may change over time. HighLevel’s workflow trigger list currently identifies some older Shopify-specific triggers as deprecating soon, including Shopify Abandoned Cart and Shopify Order Fulfilled, while newer ecommerce store triggers are available for current store connections.

- All Shopify contact fields sync automatically once a store is connected- there's currently no option to turn off or opt out of individual fields. For existing customers integrated with Shopify, updating the integration settings will sync these fields.
- A refund or cancelled order does not reduce Shopify Order Count, since the order was still placed; Shopify Lifetime Value updates automatically to reflect the refund.

- Draft orders in Shopify (for example, a manual quote) don't affect any contact field - only a completed, paid order does.
- Shopify Lifetime Value reflects Shopify purchases only.

---

## **How To Setup the Shopify Integration**

A proper Shopify setup ensures HighLevel receives the correct ecommerce data and keeps the right records syncing after connection. Review your import and sync choices before completing setup so your store data supports the workflows, reporting, and follow-up processes your team needs.

1. Open the sub-account and go to **Settings > Integrations > Shopify**.
2. Click **Connect**.   
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155072340981/original/MbVjKFRtjl7b9ZlQOS-wMcpKyXSTPWY2hg.jpeg?1779905353)
3. Enter your Shopify store URL or store name and click **Next**.![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155072340975/original/hEGVW6VHY8aiDUqXXGlRmJlYlHqdhbRUjA.png?1779905353)
4. On the **Import Elements**screen, select the Shopify data you want to import as a one-time historical import:
   - Contact Import
   - Order Import
   - Transaction Import
   - Product Import
   - Collection Import  
       
     ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155072340977/original/h_26ENT8-_Cso8B04qrtluZNHNIc4JPFeA.png?1779905353)
5. Click **Next** to proceed to the **Sync Settings**screen. Select the data and triggers you want to keep syncing going forward:
   - Contact Sync
   - Order Sync
   - Order Received Trigger
   - Transaction Sync
   - Payment Received Trigger
   - Product Sync
   - Collection Sync  
       
     ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155072340985/original/Dxu_qZS7mMPyp9Vzq7ESWevFJy5pmULW4w.jpeg?1779905354)
6. Click **Save**. This will initiate the OAuth authorization flow and redirect you to Shopify.
7. On the Shopify **Install app** screen, review the permissions requested and click **Install**.
8. Once approved, you will be redirected back and your Shopify store will be connected.

## ``` Tip: For a full Shopify store migration, select all available import and sync options unless your migration plan requires only specific data types. This helps ensure supported historical data is imported and future Shopify activity continues syncing. ```

```
Notes:

Taxes are not mapped in Products while importing or syncing the Products.

For each order, only one transaction is created in your sub-account.

Order statuses are marked as "Completed" or "Cancelled" when synced with Shopify.

Merged contacts in Shopify will have the primary contact updated in Sub-account.

If there are no changes to the SEO details in Shopify (default SEO settings), the data will be received as null in Sub-account.
```

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Do I need to create a Shopify custom app to connect Shopify?**  
A: New Shopify connections should use the OAuth App method when available. The older Custom App method requires creating a Shopify custom app and using an Admin API access token, but this should be treated as a legacy setup path unless specifically required.

**Q: What is the difference between Import Elements and Sync Settings?**  
A: Import Elements bring selected historical Shopify records into HighLevel during setup. Sync Settings control which selected Shopify data continues syncing into HighLevel after the connection is active.

**Q: Can I change my Shopify sync settings later?**  
A: Sync settings may be adjustable after setup, but changing them generally affects future syncing. Data that was already imported or synced may remain in HighLevel.

**Q: What Shopify data can be imported or synced?**  
A: HighLevel’s Shopify migration guidance lists supported Shopify data such as products, collections, contacts, orders, and transactions. Availability may depend on the connection flow, Shopify access, and selected settings.

**Q: Can Shopify data be used in workflows?**  
A: Yes. Synced Shopify activity can support ecommerce-related automation in HighLevel. For example, HighLevel supports an Abandoned Checkout trigger for native HighLevel ecommerce stores and connected external stores such as Shopify.

**Q: Should I use the Shopify Abandoned Cart trigger?**  
A: Use the newer ecommerce abandoned checkout trigger when building new abandoned checkout automations. HighLevel’s workflow trigger guidance identifies the Shopify Abandoned Cart trigger as deprecating soon.

**Q: What happens if I disconnect my existing Custom App Shopify connection?**  
A: Existing legacy Custom App connections may continue working while connected. If disconnected, users may need to reconnect using the current OAuth App flow.

**Q: Where do I find my Shopify store name?**  
A: Use the store name or Shopify store URL associated with the Shopify admin account you want to connect. Confirm the store details in Shopify before authorizing the connection.

Q: What contact fields get added when I connect Shopify? 

A: The integration automatically creates fields for lifetime spend, order count, last/first order date and value, customer tags, tax-exempt status, and email/SMS marketing consent (coming soon)- see "Contact Fields Added from Shopify" above for the full list.

Q: Can I choose which Shopify fields sync to the contact record?

A: No. All fields sync automatically for a connected store, and there isn't a field-by-field opt-in or opt-out in the current version.

Q: Does the Shopify lifetime value field include revenue from other sources?

A: No. Shopify Lifetime Value reflects only purchases made through the connected Shopify store and is kept separate from other revenue figures on the contact.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Automatic abandoned cart checkout emails for online store](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000001718)
- [Shopify Elements in HighLevel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001203897)
- [How To Use Shopify Variables](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001203898)
- [How to migrate Shopify stores to HighLevel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004056)

title_en: Voice AI: Agent Transfer
source_md:
Agent Transfer lets one Voice AI Agent hand off an active conversation to another Voice AI Agent during the same live call. Use this feature to route callers to specialized agents based on intent, such as sales, support, billing, booking, or language-specific needs. This keeps each agent focused while helping callers continue the conversation without starting over.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Voice AI: Agent Transfer?](#What-is-Voice-AI%3A-Agent-Transfer?)
- [Key Benefits of Agent Transfer](#Key-Benefits-of-Agent-Transfer)
- [Agent Transfer vs Call Transfer](#Agent-Transfer-vs-Call-Transfer)
- [Transfer Conditions and Handoff Messages](#Transfer-Conditions-and-Handoff-Messages)
- [Audit Agent Transfers in Call Logs](#Audit-Agent-Transfers-in-Call-Logs)
  - [Call Summaries](#Call-Summaries)
  - [Transcripts and Transfer Markers](#Transcripts-and-Transfer-Markers)
- [How To Set Up Voice AI: Agent Transfer](#How-To-Set-Up-Voice-AI%3A-Agent-Transfer)

  - [Step 1: Open the root Voice AI agent](#Step-1%3A-Open-the-root-Voice-AI-agent)
  - [Step 2: Add the Agent Transfer action](#Step-2%3A%C2%A0Add-the-Agent-Transfer-action)
  - [Step 3: Connect the destination agent](#Step-3%3A-Connect-the-destination-agent)
  - [Step 4: Add the transfer condition](#Step-4%3A%C2%A0Add-the-transfer-condition)
  - [Step 5: Configure the optional handoff message](#Step-5%3A-Configure-the-optional-handoff-message)
  - [Step 6: Review incoming transfers](#Step-6%3A-Review-incoming-transfers)
  - [Step 7: Review root agent settings](#Step-7%3A%C2%A0Review-root-agent-settings)
  - [Step 8: Save and test the transfer](#Step-8%3A%C2%A0Save-and-test-the-transfer)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions%C2%A0)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

## **What is Voice AI: Agent Transfer?**

Agent Transfer is a Voice AI action that lets one Voice AI agent hand off a live call to another Voice AI agent without leaving the original call. Instead of dialing a new number or starting a new conversation, the caller remains in one continuous live call while the agent changes behind the scenes.

Agent Transfer uses a root-and-destination model. The **root agent** is the agent the call starts with, and **destination agents** are the agents that can receive the transferred conversation.

During the call, the root Voice AI agent listens for the transfer conditions you define. For example, when a caller asks about pricing, the root agent can transfer the conversation to a pricing-focused destination agent. The destination agent then continues the conversation based on its own configuration, prompt, and purpose.

Agent Transfer is different from Call Transfer because it hands the call to another Voice AI agent instead of sending it to a person.

Key terms to know:

- **Root agent:** The Voice AI Agent that starts the call and evaluates whether the caller should be transferred.
- **Destination agent:** The Voice AI Agent that receives the transferred conversation and continues the interaction.
- **Transfer condition:** The caller intent or situation that tells the root agent when to transfer.
- **Handoff message:** An optional spoken message used to explain the transfer to the caller.

---

## **Key Benefits of Agent Transfer**

Agent Transfer helps teams design cleaner, more specialized Voice AI call flows. Instead of building one large prompt to handle every possible caller need, teams can route callers between focused agents that are each configured for a specific purpose.

- **Seamless caller experience:** The caller stays in the same live call while the conversation moves to another Voice AI agent.
- **Sharper, more accurate responses:**A focused agent is less likely to drift or mix up instructions from unrelated flows.
- **Lower token usage:**Each specialist carries only its own context, which can reduce the cost compared to using one large agent.
- **Reuse specialists across agents:**The same "pricing expert" agent can be the handoff destination for any number of parent agents.
- **Unified post-call experience:** Data extraction, workflows, and notifications from every agent involved in the call are merged automatically so downstream automations can use the combined post-call output.

---

## **Agent Transfer vs Call Transfer**

These are easy to mix up as both features move a live conversation forward but they are designed for different outcomes.

**Call Transfer** transfers the call to a human using a phone number. **Agent Transfer**hands the call off to another Voice AI agent with no phone number involved.

| Transfer Type | Destination | Requires Phone Number | Best Used When |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Agent Transfer | Another Voice AI Agent | No | A different AI agent should continue the conversation |
| Call Transfer | Human Representative | Yes | A person needs to speak with the caller |

Use **Agent Transfer**when:

- A caller asks about pricing and should speak with a pricing-focused AI agent.
- A caller wants to schedule an appointment and should move to a booking-focused AI agent.
- A caller has a support question and should move to a support-focused AI agent.
- A caller requests another language and should move to a language-specific AI agent.

Use **Call Transfer** when:

- A caller needs a live team member.
- A high-value lead should speak with a sales representative.
- A sensitive issue requires human judgment.

---

## **Transfer Conditions and Handoff Messages**

Transfer conditions tell the root agent when to move the caller to a destination agent. When configuring a destination agent, enter a natural-language condition in the **When to transfer to this agent** field. The condition should describe the caller intent that should trigger the handoff.

Each Agent Transfer configuration can include **up to three destination Voice AI agents**. Each destination agent needs its own transfer condition so the root agent knows when to send the caller there.

**Examples:**

- “When the caller asks about pricing.”
- “When the caller wants to schedule an appointment.”
- “When the caller needs help in Spanish.”
- “When the caller asks for technical support.”

```
Important: Avoid transfer loops. Agents should not transfer to each other in a circular pattern, as this can cause the call to fail.
```

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155070328054/original/oWfcv-4zgVOe4xHt_A2QN4gvS0YyCcJpkA.png?1777558835)

You can also enable **Speak During Execution** to have the agent say a short handoff message. This can make the transition clearer for the caller, especially when the conversation is moving to a different department, topic, or language.

**Example handoff messages:**

- “Let me connect you to our pricing specialist.”
- “I’ll transfer you to an agent who can help with scheduling.”
- “One moment while I connect you with the right specialist.”

If you leave **Speak During Execution** turned off for a destination, the transfer happens invisibly. The caller simply experiences a natural pause and continuation of the conversation, now powered by a different agent.

```
Note: Only the root agent greeting plays when the call starts. Destination agents do not play their standard greeting when they receive a transferred call.
```

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155070328143/original/p9E4fSPH0iz1OMWa-AQ29NhIKZDBJDg6bQ.png?1777558876)

---

## **Audit Agent Transfers in Call Logs**

After a call ends, you can use Call Logs to confirm whether an Agent Transfer took place and review how the conversation moved between agents. Call summaries, transcripts, data extraction, recap emails and workflow triggers include activity from all of the agents that participated in the call.

To view the call logs, go to **AI Agents > Voice AI**, then review the call log table for the completed call.

If Agent Transfer occurred, the **Actions Triggered** column displays **Agent Transfer**. If multiple transfers occurred during the same call, the column can show the transfer count, such as **Agent Transfer (2)**.

```
Note: Post-call workflows can be triggered for the root agent and any agent involved in the transfer chain.
```

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155070339178/original/yGNIgJYi8OHmIZDBRf4cZxjiBCLjHcFL3Q.png?1777564483)

### **Call Summaries**

From the call log table, click **Summary** on the call row to open the call summary.

The summary shows the call flow the agent followed during the conversation. When Agent Transfer occurs, the summary can show the transfer chain so you can see which Voice AI agents participated and how the caller moved through the flow.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155070339373/original/JEFBZD4Kukjxaot-bxgan4conkAw7U2S1Q.jpeg?1777564649)

Use the call summary and call-flow view to review:

- Which agent started the call.
- Which destination agent received the transfer.
- The sequence of agents involved in the conversation.
- Whether the caller moved through the intended transfer path.

You can hover over an agent in the call-flow diagram to review its details. If you need to inspect the agent configuration, click the agent from the diagram to open the agent details in a new tab.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155070338304/original/4sXSO0vWA9rJiq20cYAUjJIJctCNT1ivNA.png?1777563914)**

### **Transcripts and Transfer Markers**

From the call log table, click the transcript icon on the call row to open the **T****ranscript**.

The transcript shows how the transfer happened during the conversation. When Agent Transfer occurs, the transcript clearly marks the transfer point and updates the active agent name so you can see which agent handled each part of the call. This means that the transcript reflects the entire conversation, including every agent that handled part of the call.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155070339859/original/mRm5SV9JFMnrWDyd0CJsShSv2TWGFqy5rw.png?1777564823)

Use the transcript to review:

- The caller’s exact wording before the transfer.
- Whether the transfer condition matched the caller’s intent.
- Where the transfer occurred in the conversation.
- Which agent was active before and after the transfer.
- How the destination agent continued the conversation.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155070339948/original/ploJGspV9g-6wLsp5C9yxJ56qpuJS44gzg.png?1777564856)

---

## **How To Set Up Voice AI: Agent Transfer**

#### **Step 1:** Open the root Voice AI agent

Navigate to **AI Agents**> **Voice AI** > **Agent List**and select the Voice AI agent that should begin the call. This is the root agent.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155070333232/original/vf83-6QUWLGKo2XKS1z9Xo7gA24i3AGeNw.png?1777561611)

#### **Step 2:**Add the Agent Transfer action

Click **+ New****Action**and select **Agent Transfer** from the dropdown.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155070333567/original/fGbP1JbI52mRhTT1mhYgztxmKCnRXJN5Rw.png?1777561763)

#### **Step 3:** Connect the destination agent

In the Agent Transfer modal, click **Connect Agent**. Select the destination Voice AI agent that should receive the transferred call.

Repeat this process for additional destination agents, up to the supported limit of three destination agents.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155070333767/original/-GmWvr2n7Jiu1SPEI_gTAq5_hgP-oqltMA.png?1777561868)

#### **Step 4:**Add the transfer condition

Enter the transfer condition in the **When to transfer to this agent** field. Use clear, natural language that describes when the root agent should transfer the caller.

Repeat this step for each connected destination agent.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155070334132/original/SVr5IeH12AzQKUCkUjYMRbIGjPYqnXnnUg.jpeg?1777562049)

#### **Step 5:** Configure the optional handoff message

Enable **Speak During Execution** if you want the agent to say a handoff message during the transfer then enter the message the caller should hear during the handoff.

Leave **Speak During Execution** disabled if you want the transfer to happen without a spoken transition.

Repeat this step for each connected destination agent.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155070334191/original/QQ_Z3zQY0CrkfAJM485UkiMDr5w7EBnngQ.jpeg?1777562062)

#### **Step 6:** Review incoming transfers

Use **View Incoming Transfers** to review which agents are configured to transfer calls into the selected agent. This is helpful when multiple root agents use the same destination agent or when you are auditing a more complex transfer setup.

Hide this view when you want to return to the main transfer configuration.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155070334750/original/uEtkaNHo_pkhd9husbpmtHiOS9I0JEHuuA.png?1777562252)

#### **Step 7:** Review root agent settings

Review the root agent’s **Maximum Call Time**, **Working Hours**, and **AI Agent as a Backup** settings before saving.

These root agent settings control the transfer chain once the call is connected. Destination agent settings for call time, working hours, and backup behavior are ignored during the transfer chain.

#### 

#### 

#### **Step 8:**Save and test the transfer

Click **Save Changes**. Test the agent by calling or testing the Voice AI flow. Review the call log, summary, and transcript to confirm the transfer triggered as expected.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155070334955/original/Fc4UVcOm95BVFgi-tihjy1ISSb2CqyYxjg.png?1777562298)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: How many destination agents can I connect?**  
Each Agent Transfer configuration can include up to three destination Voice AI Agents.

**Q: Does Agent Transfer send the caller to a human?**  
No. Agent Transfer sends the caller from one Voice AI Agent to another Voice AI Agent. Use Call Transfer when the caller should be sent to a human representative or phone number.

**Q: Does the destination agent greeting play after transfer?**  
No. Destination agent greetings do not play during transferred calls. Use a handoff message if the caller needs an explanation before the transfer.

**Q: Which agent controls working hours and maximum call time?**  
The root agent controls connected-call settings such as Working Hours, Maximum Call Time, and AI Agent as a Backup.

**Q: Can a destination agent transfer the caller again?**  
A destination agent may be configured with its own transfer behavior, but transfer paths should be carefully tested to avoid loops or repeated transfers.

**Q: How do I prevent transfer loops?**  
Avoid configuring agents to transfer callers back and forth. Keep transfer conditions specific and review the full transfer chain during testing.

**Q: Will transfers appear in call logs?**  
Yes. Transfers can be reviewed in call logs, summaries, transcripts, and transfer markers when available.

**Q: Can Agent Transfer trigger post-call workflows?**  
Post-call workflows may trigger for the root agent and agents involved in the transfer chain, depending on workflow configuration.

**Q: Is Agent Transfer the same as inbound call routing?**  
No. Inbound call routing determines how the call reaches the root Voice AI Agent. Agent Transfer determines whether the active Voice AI conversation is handed to another Voice AI Agent.

**Q: Should I test Agent Transfer before going live?**  
Yes. Test each transfer condition separately and review logs, summaries, and transcripts before using Agent Transfer with live callers.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [How to Create Voice AI Agents](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004107)
- [Voice AI - Agent Logs](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000007687)
- [How to Edit a Voice AI Agents Voice](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005874)
- [Voice AI: Translation Service for Call Transcript & Summary](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005797)
- [AI Voice Agents Overview](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003911)
- [Appointment Booking in Voice AI](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005293)

title_en: Ask AI Multi-Threading: Run Multiple Tasks at Once
source_md:
AI AUTOMATION

# Ask AI Multi-Threading & Background Sessions

Run up to 10 AI conversations in parallel, keep work running in the background, and get notified when sessions complete or need your input — all while switching freely between accounts.

Ask AI Mobile also supports parallel chats, so you can start another question while an earlier response continues processing and monitor each session from Chat History.

What You'll Learn

This guide explains how Ask AI's multi-threading capabilities transform your workflow by allowing multiple simultaneous conversations, background processing, and intelligent notifications that keep you informed without interrupting your focus.

You'll discover how to run parallel tasks, monitor progress through visual indicators, respond to input requests, and seamlessly switch between accounts while maintaining complete conversation separation.

## What is Ask AI Multi-Threading?

Ask AI multi-threading transforms how you interact with HighLevel's AI assistant by enabling parallel conversation processing. Instead of waiting for one task to complete before starting another, you can initiate up to 10 simultaneous conversations that run independently.

Each conversation maintains its own context, scroll position, and history. You can draft a blog post in one conversation, generate a report in another, and schedule appointments in a third — all running concurrently. When you close the Ask AI panel or switch to different tools, your conversations continue processing in the background.

The system automatically saves completed conversations and notifies you when they finish or require your input, ensuring no work is lost and nothing fails silently.

## Key Capabilities

Multi-threading delivers several powerful capabilities that streamline your AI-assisted workflow:

**Parallel Conversation Execution** — Run up to 10 conversations simultaneously without waiting for sequential completion. Each conversation processes independently with its own context and state.

**Background Processing** — Close the Ask AI panel, navigate to other tools, or switch accounts while conversations continue running. Completed work is automatically saved and ready when you return.

**Completion Notifications** — Receive toast notifications when background conversations finish, displaying the conversation title and a clickable "Open to view" action that takes you directly to the completed chat.

**Error Transparency** — Failed sessions trigger clear "Background session failed" notifications instead of failing silently, ensuring you're always aware of processing issues.

**Persistent State Management** — Each conversation retains its scroll position, history, and context even when running in the background or after account switches.

## Understanding Background Notifications

Ask AI's background notifications are conversation-specific alerts that differ from standard platform notifications in several important ways:

Feature 1

Direct Conversation Navigation

Notifications are clickable and navigate directly to the specific conversation that triggered them. A notification reading "Done • Create launch blog post" takes you straight to that completed conversation when clicked.

Feature 2

Account-Specific Targeting

Notifications are tied to the account where the work was initiated. A conversation running in one sub-account will not trigger notifications while you're viewing a different sub-account.

Feature 3

Persistent Replay

If a conversation completes while you're away from Ask AI, the notification waits and replays when you return instead of disappearing. This ensures you never miss completed work.

Feature 4

Context-Aware Display

Notifications only appear when you're working outside Ask AI. If you're already viewing the Ask AI panel, notifications are suppressed to avoid redundant alerts.

How It Works

When a background conversation completes successfully, you'll see a toast notification like "Done • Create launch blog post" with an "Open to view" link. If a session encounters an error, you'll receive a "Background session failed" message instead, ensuring complete transparency about conversation status.

## How Input-Needed Notifications Work

Sometimes Ask AI reaches a point in a conversation where it requires additional information or a decision from you before it can proceed. Rather than stalling silently, the system surfaces an "Input needed" notification.

For example, if Ask AI is updating pipeline stages and needs clarification on stage names or settings, you'll receive a notification like "Update pipeline stages needs your response. Open it." Clicking the notification takes you directly to the waiting conversation where you can provide the required input.

Priority Handling

Input-needed notifications take priority over standard completion notifications. This ensures conversations requiring your attention are always surfaced before those that completed successfully on their own.

Cross-Account Alerts

Input-needed notifications work even when you're viewing a different sub-account than where the conversation originated. This ensures you're always alerted when Ask AI needs your input, regardless of which account you're currently working in.

Once you provide the requested information, Ask AI resumes processing the conversation automatically, continuing from exactly where it paused.

Stay Informed

Monitor Everything Without Keeping Ask AI Open

Live status indicators in your navigation bar and sidebar keep you updated on active conversations and completed work, even when you're focused on other tasks.

## Live Status Indicators

HighLevel provides visual status indicators throughout the interface so you can monitor Ask AI activity without keeping the panel open:

Indicator 1

Top Navigation Bar Pulse

The Ask AI button in the top navigation bar pulses gently while at least one conversation is actively processing. This provides immediate visual feedback that work is in progress.

Indicator 2

Red Completion Dot

When background conversations finish while you're working elsewhere in HighLevel, a red dot appears on the Ask AI button in the top navigation, signaling there's completed work ready to review.

Indicator 3

Sidebar Blue Icon

The Ask AI icon in the sidebar turns blue while conversations are actively running. This provides a secondary visual cue visible regardless of which navigation you're using.

Indicator 4

Sidebar Blue Dot

A small blue dot appears next to the sidebar Ask AI icon when background sessions complete and you haven't reviewed them yet. The dot disappears once you open Ask AI.

Indicator 5

### **Mobile Chat History Indicators**

Chat History on mobile shows which Ask AI conversations are still processing and which finished while you were viewing another chat.

- **Spinner**: The chat is still working on a response.
- **Dot**: The response finished while you were elsewhere and is ready to review.

Account-Specific Status

All status indicators are account-specific. The badges and dots you see reflect only the sub-account or agency view you're currently in. Switching accounts instantly updates the indicators to show the correct status for that account.

Note

When you're already viewing the Ask AI screen, status dots are hidden since you're already in context. They reappear when you navigate away to signal when new activity occurs.

## Account Switching & Conversation Isolation

Ask AI maintains complete conversation isolation across accounts, allowing you to switch freely between sub-accounts and agency views without mixing up work or losing context.

Each account maintains its own independent set of conversations, history, scroll positions, and error states. When you switch accounts, all active conversations in the previous account continue running in the background and finish there.

**Separate Conversation Histories** — Each account maintains its own conversation list. Switching to a different sub-account shows only that account's conversations.

**Persistent Scroll Positions** — When you return to an account, each conversation resumes at the exact scroll position where you left it, even if you've been working in other accounts.

**Account-Specific Errors** — Error messages and failed session notifications are tied to the account where the conversation originated. Errors in one account don't appear when viewing another.

**Independent Background Processing** — Conversations initiated in Sub-Account A continue running even when you switch to Sub-Account B. Completion notifications appear only when you return to the originating account.

Result

You can confidently manage multiple client accounts simultaneously, knowing that conversations and their results will never bleed across account boundaries. Each account operates as a completely independent workspace.

## Voice Mode Enhancements

Voice mode receives several improvements that make the experience more consistent and flexible when mixing typed and spoken input.

Enhancement 1

Typed Messages Read Aloud

When you type a message in voice mode instead of speaking it, Ask AI now reads its reply out loud. This maintains audio consistency throughout the conversation regardless of input method.

Enhancement 2

Graceful Response Completion

If you switch to another conversation while Ask AI is speaking a voice response, the system waits for the response to finish naturally instead of cutting it off mid-sentence.

Enhancement 3

Session Exit Confirmation

Ask AI now confirms before ending a live voice session, preventing accidental disconnections and giving you a chance to continue the conversation if needed.

Text Mode Behavior

Plain text conversations outside voice mode remain silent as before. Audio responses only occur when voice mode is active, ensuring quiet operation when you're working in text-only mode.

## How to Use Multi-Threading

Follow these steps to take advantage of Ask AI's multi-threading capabilities:

Step 1

Open Ask AI

Click the Ask AI button in your top navigation bar or sidebar to open the Ask AI panel.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078114363/original/7e74V4GL_B5OxFdiJvcQKJt0SRX8AeKUWA.png?1786444621)

Step 2

Start Your First Conversation

Type or speak your first request — for example, "Draft a blog post about email marketing best practices." Ask AI begins processing immediately.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078132400/original/_Q6AyTx40N119cvPAQLCYYsWZuvJ-YEvYw.png?1786453190)

Step 3

Create Additional Conversations

Start new conversations by clicking the "New conversation" button or using the keyboard shortcut. Each conversation runs independently. You can create up to 10 parallel conversations.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078132773/original/uw4BVagyrmGhNPHzXtylRauIdzGRDRVYpw.png?1786453292)

Step 4

Continue Your Workflow

Close the Ask AI panel, navigate to other HighLevel tools, or switch to different accounts. Your conversations continue processing in the background.

Step 5

Monitor Status Indicators

Watch for the pulsing Ask AI button (active processing) and red dot (completed work) in your navigation bar. The sidebar icon turns blue during active processing and shows a blue dot when conversations finish.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078133477/original/fB_scniDWC-GUO75RIgmtMwiDZreyAVC-A.png?1786453618)

Step 6

Respond to Notifications

When you see a "Done" or "Input needed" notification, click "Open to view" to jump directly to the relevant conversation. For input-needed notifications, provide the requested information to allow Ask AI to continue.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078134115/original/YWxFKWhaLP2ysrclBRNGQYeScr4AF0q51g.png?1786453776)

Step 7

Review Completed Work

Open Ask AI to review finished conversations. Each conversation preserves its full history and scroll position, so you can immediately see results without scrolling or searching.

## **Parallel Sessions in Ask AI Mobile**

Parallel sessions let you start another Ask AI request without waiting for the current response to finish. Each chat runs independently, so switching conversations does not cancel work that is already processing.

The mobile parallel-session experience is available in **version 4.23.0 and above** for the **HighLevel**, **LeadConnector**, and **WL App**.

### 

### **Run Multiple Ask AI Chats on Mobile**

Starting another conversation lets you keep asking questions while earlier requests continue processing.

1. Open the mobile app.
2. Open **Ask AI** from the **App Drawer**.
3. Send your first question.
4. Open **Chat History**.
5. Tap **New Chat**.
6. Send another question. The first chat continues processing independently.
7. Open **Chat History** whenever you want to move between conversations.
8. Look for a **spinner** to identify chats still processing and a **dot** to identify responses that finished while you were elsewhere.

Best Practice

Use descriptive conversation titles or opening messages to make it easy to identify conversations later. When you receive a notification like "Done • Create launch blog post," you'll immediately know which task completed.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: How many conversations can I run simultaneously?

Ask AI supports up to 10 parallel conversations at once. Each conversation runs independently with its own context, history, and state. You can freely switch between conversations, close the Ask AI panel, or navigate elsewhere while all active conversations continue processing.

Q: What happens to my conversations if I close the Ask AI panel?

All active conversations continue running in the background when you close the panel. Completed work is automatically saved and waiting for you when you return. You'll receive toast notifications when conversations finish, and status indicators in your navigation bar and sidebar show ongoing activity and completed work.

Q: How do I know when a conversation needs my input?

When Ask AI requires additional information to proceed, you'll receive an "Input needed" notification with the conversation title and a prompt to open it. These notifications take priority over completion notifications and work even when you're viewing a different sub-account, ensuring you're always alerted when Ask AI needs your input. Click the notification to jump directly to the conversation and provide the requested information.

Q: Do conversations mix up when I switch between sub-accounts?

No. Conversations are completely isolated per account. Each sub-account and the agency view maintain separate conversation histories, scroll positions, and background sessions. Work started in one account continues running there and finishes there, with notifications appearing only when you're viewing the originating account.

Q: What do the different status indicators mean?

The pulsing Ask AI button in the top navigation indicates active processing. A red dot on the top navigation button signals completed background work awaiting review. The sidebar Ask AI icon turns blue during active processing and displays a blue dot when sessions finish in the background. All indicators are account-specific and update instantly when you switch accounts.

Q: How does voice mode work with typed messages?

When voice mode is active and you type a message instead of speaking it, Ask AI reads its reply out loud to maintain audio consistency. Voice mode also waits for responses to finish before switching conversations and confirms before ending live voice sessions. Text-only conversations outside voice mode remain silent.

Q: What happens if a background conversation fails?

You'll receive a clear "Background session failed" notification instead of a standard completion notification. This ensures errors never fail silently. Click the notification to view the conversation and see error details, then retry the request or modify your approach as needed.

Q: Will I receive notifications if I'm already viewing Ask AI?

No. Notifications are suppressed when you're actively viewing the Ask AI panel to avoid redundant alerts. Status indicators also hide while you're on the Ask AI screen since you're already in context. Notifications and indicators reappear when you navigate away to signal new activity.

Facebook & Instagram comment automation allows you to instantly respond to comments made on your social media posts. This feature is powered by workflows that trigger based on new comments, letting you reply publicly, send a message, or even use AI to generate dynamic responses.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Facebook & Instagram Automation?](#What-is-Facebook-&-Instagram-Automation?)

- [Here is how the message will look in Facebook and Instagram](#Here-is-how-the-message-will-look-in-Facebook-and-Instagram)
