- [IMPORTANT: What all information and assets are not transferred over?](#IMPORTANT%3A-What-all-information-and-assets-are-not-transferred-over?)
- [Phone Number Transfers](#Phone-Number-Transfers)
- [Sub-Account Transfer FAQs](#Sub-Account-Transfer-FAQs)

---

# Steps to Eject a Sub-Account to a New Agency (Sender)

1. **Step-1:** Go to ***Agency Level > Sub-Accounts***. Go to ***Manage Client*** for the sub-account that needs to be ejected to a New Agency.    
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155032998542/original/TG4fKh8CtFpKC0Wn__uFyn7obgUpmLp7TA.jpeg?1726567855)
2. **Step-2:** Select ***Actions > Transfer Sub-account***![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155032998546/original/E201sZHWG-zKBD6avJRZq3_1FXiQSwibiA.jpeg?1726567855)
3. **Step-3:** You will be prompted with two options to either "Transfer to an Existing Agency" or "Eject to a New Agency . Select "***Eject to a New Agency"***to proceed.                                                                                              
   If you want to transfer to an existing agency instead, [click here](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000002031) for detailed guide.  
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155033682586/original/MAnai5Tm9gM9rMKlrZ6nIGsP9NKCyibGvg.png?1727439253)
4. **Step-4:** Nominate Agency Owner for the new agency .   
   Please note that the user selected here will be receiving an email with a signup link for setting up new agency account and also on successful signup the user will be marked as agency owner for the newly created agency account.![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155033000784/original/qPzIvJKRJW7MHUC3SgjSA40kwNd4MFDTXw.png?1726569252)
5. **Step-5:** Review the Sub-Account Ejection guidelines and click ***Confirm Transfer***![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155033000844/original/zZQoRaO0NM5sS-KYX8wsUoeIp8kBOlLSIA.png?1726569311)
6. **Step-6:** Enter your password to confirm the transfer. Upon confirming the action, an email will be sent to the nominee with instructions to set up the new agency account.![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155033000911/original/MDp5BR8xjYdjZmzMU33ZGElC_GzxXokOog.png?1726569341)
7. **Tracking:** In order to track your sub-account transfer requests, go to ***Agency Level > Sub-Accounts***. Select the ***Sub-account Transfers*** option. Navigate to the ***Eject***tab.![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155033650867/original/7bEJje8hMbFqnNXpjtqwhhR_eEyTIdKVhw.png?1727417054)

---

# Steps to Receive a Sub-Account and Sign Up for a New Agency (Nominee)

The nominee (new agency owner) will receive an email titled "Access your account." Click the button or link within the email to begin the setup process.

1. **Step-1:** Click on "`Location Eject request from - {Agency Name}`" and you will be redirected to the login page in a new window.![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155033340768/original/G-AjgDtsmqxR3tIAA2vEZ2X2Ch0NWxPDIQ.png?1727077451)
2. **Step-2:** Clicking on the link will redirect you to the login page in a new browser window. Log in using the email address and password associated with your Highlevel account.![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155033003850/original/YF5BRiNfCfBQ_eHr9P7d0RVoRpk0tIcugA.png?1726571251)
3. **Step-3:** Fill out the **Company Details** and **Billing Address** for the new agency account. Most details will be prefilled—review and make changes if necessary.![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155033003951/original/8zqp6Vfm6rfB9uAguynOBFxGjyTmagVZ6Q.png?1726571293)![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155033004009/original/ayMBw38RWYLBIWJNgeNfU73Vl9kSsFAvKg.png?1726571323)
4. **Step-4:** The setup process will default to the **$97/month plan**. Click ***Continue to Payment*** to proceed with entering your payment details.![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155033870147/original/1QHYjLT2Mwk2pKIxYOQvpxaQ2WutzhG0_g.png?1727781395)
5. **Step-5:**Review the order summary, enter your card details, and confirm to complete the signup.

   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155033340214/original/yqcRpXSZaC3jMg6V9xgdYe9dWjUzHx5HUg.png?1727077168)
6. **Step-6:**After successfully completing the payment and signup, you’ll receive a welcome email.This email will provide a link to set up your new account password and log in. ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155033340845/original/Xw7MgpWACdSjmcwCUdD9DrGfEwo1G9EKvw.png?1727077502)

```
Note : The sub-account that was ejected from original agency will automatically be transferred to your new agency account once its created.
```

---

# What all information and assets are transferred over?

- Websites and funnels will all be transferred.
- GHL calendars will get transferred over.  
  **Note:**The external calendar integrations will be disconnected.
- All automation will be transferred over.  
  **Note:**They will all be set to Draft.
- Contacts and their conversations, appointments, opportunities, and history will be transferred over.
- All users with User Type '***Account'***, and only assigned to that particular sub-account and no other sub-account will be transferred.
- Contacts will remain in the workflow.
- The workflow enrolled data remains as it is in workflows.
- Sub-account level API Keys will remain the same.

---

# IMPORTANT: What all information and assets are not transferred over?

- All auth connections will be deleted (ex: Google, FB, Instagram, Quickbooks, Clio, DrChrono, Yext)
- All Facebook and Google settings will be cleared
- Sub-Account-level Stripe fields will be cleared
- Any SaaS setting will not be transferred over.  
  **Note:** SaaS mode will automatically be disabled before the transfer takes place.
- Smartlists do not get transferred over with the sub-account currently
- Mailgun/SMTP won't get transferred.
- All active subscriptions like Wordpress, Yext, Whatsapp, Dedicated IP etc. won't get transferred. They'll have to be cancelled before the transfer can happen.

---

# Phone Number Transfers

**Both Agencies are on LeadConnector**

- If BOTH the releasing and receiving agencies along with the sub-account that needs to be transferred is on LC, then the phone numbers will automatically be transferred with the sub-account.
- A2P DLC status will be retained. Sub-accounts do not need to again register the phone numbers that are already registered.
- All the phone usage charges going forward will be accrued by the receiving agency.

**Both Agencies are not on LeadConnector (Either one or Both are Twilio)**

No phone numbers will be transferred over by HighLevel. It is your responsibility to work with the previous account owner as well as Twilio to move over any or all phone numbers that you may want to keep connected to the transferred sub-account.

Kindly reach out to [HighLevel Support](https://app.gohighlevel.com/support) for any concerns.

---

## **Domain Transfers**

Here’s how domains (including subdomains) are handled when you eject a sub-account to a new agency, based on the article and HighLevel’s domain setup flow:

1. **Domains are *not* automatically carried over.**  
   In the “What is the setup that new agency will need once the transfer is made?” section of the Eject Sub-Account article, HighLevel explicitly notes:

   > You will have to re-add your domains” help.gohighlevel.com  
   > This means any custom URLs—whether a root domain (e.g. mybusiness.com) or a subdomain (e.g. marketing.mybusiness.com)—must be reconfigured in the newly created agency. None of the old DNS records “move” automatically.
2. **“Domain” here includes both root domains and subdomains.**  
   In HighLevel, when you “connect a domain,” you can choose to enter either a root domain or a subdomain. The process for each is very similar:

- For a **root domain** (e.g. `mydomain.com`), you enter it exactly as-is into the Domain field, then update your DNS provider with the accompanying records (often an A record or a CNAME for `www` that points to HighLevel).
- For a **subdomain** (e.g. `funnels.mydomain.com` or `pages.mydomain.com`), you enter that full subdomain string into the Domain field. HighLevel then generates DNS records—almost always a CNAME—that you copy over to your DNS host.  
    
  In both cases, once your DNS propagates, HighLevel will validate and issue an SSL certificate automatically.

Because domains (and subdomains) are not “inherited” during the eject process, plan on reconfiguring them immediately after the sub-account is accepted by its new owner. This ensures that any existing funnels, websites, or branded links continue to resolve without downtime.

---

# Sub-Account Transfer FAQs

1. What is the prep that I have to do to the sub-account before ejecting?

- Set all users that you want to be transferred over are User Type ‘Account’ and only assigned to this specific sub-account being transferred.
- Any SaaS sub-account will need to have SaaS disabled.
- All active subscriptions like Wordpress, Yext, Whatsapp, Dedicated IP etc. will have to be cancelled before the transfer is requested.

2. What is the setup that new agency will need once the transfer is made?

- You will need to reconnect all auth connections (ex: Google, FB, Quickbooks, Clio, DrChrono)
- You will have to reintegrate Facebook and Google
- You will have setup the sub-account-level Stripe
- You will have to re-add LC Email, Mailgun/SMTP, and Twilio
- You will have to re-add your domains
- Any SaaS sub-accounts will have to have SaaS re-enabled.

3. Can I eject a HIPAA-enabled Sub-account?  
Yes, you can eject a HIPAA-enabled sub-account. However, the new agency will be required to purchase the HIPAAAdd-on during the signup process. This add-on will automatically be included in the order summary at checkout, ensuring the new agency maintains HIPAA compliance.

4. Will the deleted workflows be visible in the "Deleted" tab when a location is transferred?

 Deleted workflows from the old location will not be visible in the new location. Only the deleted workflows from  the new location will be displayed in the "Deleted" tab.

5. What about whitelabel (app) subdomains?  
If your agency has a whitelabel domain—commonly something like `app.yourbrand.com`—that also does *not* transfer automatically.

title_en: Calendar View Settings
source_md:
Calendar View Settings in HighLevel let you customize how appointments, staff schedules, and events appear in your Unified Calendar. You can adjust timezones, grid intervals, event colors, and display preferences from one centralized panel. You can also export your current calendar view to PDF or CSV. These settings only affect the calendar display and do not change booking availability, scheduling rules, or customer-facing booking pages.

Calendar View Settings are organized into two tabs:

- **General:** Manage timezone, grid intervals, event colors, working-hours shading, empty rows and columns, and buffer visibility.
- **Staff colors:** Allows admins to customize staff member colors for all users.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [Key Benefits of Calendar View Settings](#Key-Benefits-of-Calendar-View-Settings)
- [Calendar Display Preferences](#Calendar-Display-Preferences)
- [Timezone Preferences](#Timezone-Preferences)
- [Staff Colors and Event Color Display](#Staff-Colors-and-Event-Color-Display)
- [Exporting Calendar Views to PDF or CSV](#Exporting-Calendar-Views-to-PDF-or-CSV)
- [How to Set Up Calendar View Settings](#How-to-Set-Up-Calendar-View-Settings)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

## **Key Benefits of Calendar View Settings**

Calendar View Settings make it easier to manage appointments, identify staff schedules, and focus on important booking information without changing your scheduling configurations.

- **Centralized Preferences:** Customize your calendar display from one settings panel.
- **Personalized Timezones:** View appointments in your preferred timezone.
- **Flexible Calendar Grid:** Choose 15-, 30-, or 60-minute intervals.
- **Better Schedule Visibility:** Highlight non-working hours and appointment buffers.
- **Cleaner Calendar Layout:** Hide empty staff or resource rows and columns.
- **Custom Event Colors:** Quickly distinguish staff members, calendars, and services.
- **Convenient Exports:** Export the current filtered calendar view to PDF or CSV.

---

## **Calendar Display Preferences**

The General tab provides several options for controlling how scheduling information appears. Each user can save their own preferences without affecting other team members.

| Setting | Description |
| --- | --- |
| View appointments in | Display appointments in your selected timezone. |
| Default grid interval | Choose 15-, 30-, or 60-minute grid spacing. |
| Color events by | Display calendar/service or staff colors as the main event color. |
| Grey out hours outside working time | Shade hours outside staff working schedules. |
| Hide empty rows and columns | Hide staff or resources without scheduled events in Day view. |
| Show buffer time | Display configured appointment buffers in Day and Week views. |

**Default Grid Interval**

The grid interval determines how each hour is divided in Day and Week views.

- **15 minutes:** Four rows per hour for detailed scheduling.
- **30 minutes:** Two rows per hour.
- **60 minutes:** One row per hour for a simpler overview.

Changing the grid interval does not affect appointment durations or booking rules.

**Grey Out Hours Outside Working Time**

This setting shades hours when staff members are not scheduled to work, helping you identify available working periods at a glance. HighLevel combines the active schedules associated with a staff member's calendars and any applicable active custom schedule.

For example, if one schedule runs from 9 AM to 1 PM and another from 12 PM to 5 PM, the combined working period is 9 AM to 5 PM.

**Supported views:**

- **Day view:** Works with one or multiple selected staff members.
- **Week view:** Works when a single staff member is selected.
- **Filter requirement:** Available when using the Users (staff) filter.

Schedules not assigned to a calendar are considered inactive for this calculation, unless they are active as applicable custom schedules.

```
Note: Shading is visual only and does not modify appointment availability.
```

**Hide Empty Rows and Columns**

This setting removes staff or resource lanes without scheduled activity, keeping the calendar focused on relevant appointments.

- Works in **Day view only**.
- Hides staff members and rental listings without scheduled events.
- Considers appointments, blocked time, and busy events from linked calendars.
- Automatically displays hidden lanes when they contain events on another day.

If no selected staff members have scheduled activity, all their columns may be hidden.

**Show Buffer Time**

Buffer visibility displays reserved time before and after staff appointments in Day and Week views. Enabling or disabling this option only changes whether buffer blocks are visible. It does not modify the configured buffers or appointment availability.

To configure buffer durations, see [Pre and Post Buffers](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000001019-pre-and-post-buffers).  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084911464/original/F1NLhRCf9a3z-Xmu4WxwoX4vXADblmWhYQ.png?1793782720)

---

## **Timezone Preferences**

The View appointments in setting allows you to display appointments in your preferred timezone without affecting how customers book. Available selections include:

- **Recommended timezones**
- **Business timezone**
- **All timezones**

Selecting Business timezone automatically keeps your viewing timezone aligned with the business timezone if it changes. Your selected timezone applies to appointment times in supported HighLevel screens and appointment-related emails.

```
Important: Timezone preferences are user-specific and do not affect availability, other team members, or customer bookings.
```

The setting previously appeared in Meetings Preferences and Services/Rentals Global Settings. Existing timezone preferences automatically carry over to Calendar View Settings.

For additional information, see [View Calendar & Appointments in User Timezone](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000001693).

---

## **Staff Colors and Event Color Display**

Staff and event colors help you identify appointment ownership without opening individual bookings. Users can control how colors appear on appointment tiles, while admins manage staff color assignments.

**Color Events By**

Each appointment tile displays a primary background color and a wider color strip on the left.

| Preference | Main Tile Color | Left Color Strip |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Calendar/Service colors | Calendar or service color | Staff color |
| Staff colors | Staff color | Calendar or service color |

The available label may display Calendar colors or Service colors depending on the calendar context.

```
Note: Rental bookings retain their status-based colors regardless of this preference.
```

**Staff Colors (Admins Only)**

Admins can assign colors to individual staff members, making their appointments easier to recognize.

1. Open **Calendar view settings**.
2. Select the **Staff colors** tab.
3. Search for a staff member or scroll through the list.
4. Click the color swatch and select a color using the picker, presets, or HEX value.
5. Click **Save changes**.

Staff colors configured by admins apply to all users.

---

## **Exporting Calendar Views to PDF or CSV**

Calendar exports let you share schedules or work with appointment data outside HighLevel. Both formats reflect the currently applied filters and selected date range.

**Export to PDF**

PDF exports provide a visual representation of the current calendar view.

1. Navigate to **Calendars → Calendar view**.
2. Select the desired date range and filters.
3. Click **More options (⋮)** next to Manage view.
4. Select **Export to PDF**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084910750/original/67y1nhcWkI7U-4lR7NSlRfj-pnMtaEdcwQ.png?1793782393)

**Note:** Day view PDF exports support up to seven selected resources to maintain readability.

**Export to CSV**

CSV exports provide appointment information for spreadsheets and external analysis.

1. Open **Calendars → Calendar view**.
2. Apply the desired date range and filters.
3. Click **More options (⋮)**.
4. Select **Export to CSV**.

```
Important:

• CSV exports include appointments but exclude blocked slots.  
• Export to CSV is unavailable when the current view contains no appointments.  
• Both formats reflect the current view's applied filters and date range.
```

---

## **How to Set Up Calendar View Settings**

Saving your display preferences helps maintain a consistent calendar layout whenever you return to Calendar View. These settings are personal to each user, except for staff colors configured by admins.

1. Navigate to **Calendars → Calendar view**.
2. Click **More options (⋮)** next to Manage view.
3. Select **Calendar view settings**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084910186/original/vDJnSf-288JCoQyfOGwVyBqd9W3hTdGLbA.png?1793782120)
4. Under the **General** tab, choose your timezone and grid interval.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084910236/original/9znuFpyabblE2agk8mL1stM_tdHVXmsnBg.png?1793782144)
5. Select how event colors should appear.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084911029/original/0BAJcoRb3eAMk8Kmc5c-rTNUKbKBvS09rQ.png?1793782518)
6. Enable or disable working-hours shading, empty rows and columns, and buffer visibility.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084911091/original/oBi_h0aSCGezzoK8Rg1p_q9PmWvRQRTboA.png?1793782546)
7. Click **Save changes**.

Your preferences are saved for the next time you open Calendar View.

```
Note: Save changes is unavailable until a setting is modified. Clicking Close without saving discards unsaved changes. Admins can use the Staff colors tab to configure staff colors separately.
```

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Do Calendar View Settings change appointment availability?**

A: No. They only change how calendar information appears. Booking rules, availability, and configured buffers remain unchanged.

**Q: Why can't I see the Staff colors tab?**

A: The Staff colors tab is available only to admins.

**Q: Why aren't non-working hours shaded?**

A: Confirm that shading is enabled and that you're using the Users filter. Day view supports multiple staff members, while Week view requires one selected staff member.

**Q: Why are some staff columns missing?**

A: Hide empty rows and columns may be enabled. This setting hides staff members without scheduled events in Day view.

**Q: Does turning off Show buffer time remove appointment buffers?**

A: No. It only hides the buffer blocks. Configured buffers continue to affect availability.

**Q: Why is Export to CSV unavailable?**

A: CSV export is unavailable when the current calendar view contains no appointments to export.

**Q: Why are blocked slots missing from my CSV export?**

A: CSV exports include appointments but do not include blocked slots.

**Q: Do I need to reconfigure my timezone after the settings relocation?**

A: No. Previously saved viewing timezone preferences automatically carry over.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [View Calendar & Appointments in User Timezone](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000001693)
- [Pre and Post Buffers](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000001019-pre-and-post-buffers)
- [Calendar View Enhancements](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006757-calendar-view-enhancements)
- [In App Calendar View](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000001202-in-app-calendar-view)
- [Calendar View - Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006096)
- [Rentals - Calendar View](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006641)

title_en: Guide to Date/Time Formatter Workflow Action
source_md:
The Date/Time Formatter action is a versatile tool that allows users to reformat and compare dates or date-times within workflows. This feature enables easy conversion of date formats for compatibility with different applications, database storage, or communication channels like email, SMS, or Slack. It also facilitates the comparison of dates to calculate the difference in days, simplifying date-related calculations and decision-making.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is the Date/Time Formatter Workflow Action?](#What-is-the-Date/Time-Formatter-Workflow-Action?)
- [Key Benefits of Date/Time Formatter Action](#Key-Benefits-of-Date/Time-Formatter-Action)
- [How To Setup Date/Time Formatter Action](#How-To-Setup-Date/Time-Formatter-Action)
- [Use Cases](#Use-Cases)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)

---

# **What is the Date/Time Formatter Workflow Action?**

The Date/Time Formatter action is a simple tool that helps you work with dates and times in your automated tasks. Here are the three main features and their steps:

- Changing the format of dates (ex: 2024-12-09)
- Changing the format of date-times (ex: 2024-12-09 15:48)
- Comparing two dates to see their difference (ex: 2024-12-09 vs 2024-12-08)

With these features, you can easily change how dates and times look or compare two dates, making it simple to share or save information in the correct format.

---

## **Key Benefits of Date/Time Formatter Action**

The Date/Time Formatter action offers several benefits for users who need to work with date and time data in their workflows:

- **Consistency:**Ensures date and time data is formatted uniformly across different platforms and applications, improving readability and reducing confusion.
- **Compatibility:** Facilitates seamless data exchange and integration between various tools and systems by converting date and time formats as needed.
- **Decision-making:**Simplifies date comparisons and calculations, supporting informed decision-making in time-sensitive operations.
- **Flexibility:** Offers a wide range of format options to cater to specific requirements or preferences, making it adaptable to various use cases.

---

## **How To Setup Date/Time Formatter Action**

### **Access Workflow Builder**

Go to Automation > Create Workflow> + Start from Scratch. Alternatively, you can choose any of your existing workflow to use the Date/Time Formatter workflow action.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155043086464/original/AOYu8H9yQ2VumEc63huR39VmAM2B67tTkg.png?1741750190)

### **Select Date/Time Formatter Action**

Click the "+" icon to view the list of workflow actions, seect "Date/Time Formatter" from the list.

### 

### **Understanding Different Action Types**

The Date/Time Formatter action ensures workflows can properly format, store, and compare date values for automation. Once configured, it stores the reformatted or calculated values as dynamic variables, which can be used in later workflow actions like sending emails, updating CRM fields, or triggering conditional workflows. With the Date/Time Formatter action, you can also compare dates using the action.

There are three primary ways to use this action:

- **Format Date:**Convert a date into a different format.
- **Format Date-Time:** Change both date and time formatting.
- **Compare Dates:**Calculate the difference between two dates.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155043064532/original/kzSdz_vTyGk9OgGFsjIW428Egk6ctG5MDQ.png?1741707004)

### **Format DATE**

The Format Date function is a crucial feature of the Date/Time Formatter action, specifically designed to convert date structures from one format to another. Here's a more detailed breakdown of the Format Date function:

#### **Field Selection**

Choose the date field you want to reformat. You can select various sources such as a Specific Date, Current Date, Contact's date fields, date type custom fields, Appointment start/end date, Custom values, or even from an Inbound Webhook Trigger.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155043064633/original/c5y6pWoRV_BXXuqz3_pmcPpw1HnIn7VR1w.png?1741707067)

```
Currently, Contact Custom fields do not support the Date Time structure.
```

#### **From Format**

If you select a system field like Specific Date, Current Date, Contact's date type standard or custom fields, or Appointment start/end date, the tool will auto-detect the format and preselect it. You must manually select the matching format if you choose a Custom Value or an Inbound Webhook Trigger.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155043064837/original/N-gVpbSNXEkJ76O_cwyNdPCFjSXEJoHDzA.png?1741707112)

#### **To Format**

Select the desired format for the output date from the list of available formats. This is the format the original date will be converted to.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155043064972/original/gFsbZ2hBbNaXC7fvOwh7VVl2eQ9g1s8fRA.png?1741707182)

---

### **Format DATE-TIME**

The Format date-time function is an essential feature of the Date/Time Formatter action, designed to convert structures that include both date and time information to a different format. Here's a more detailed explanation of the Format Date and Time function:

#### **Field Selection**

Choose the date and time field you want to reformat. You can select various sources such as a Specific Date and Time, Current Date and Time, Appointment start/end date and time, Custom values, or even from an Inbound Webhook Trigger. Note that Contact Custom fields do not currently support Date Time structures.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155043085210/original/QfBq7h_U-0-ox4hOdBfaF4iUoi9xZwkalA.png?1741746520)

```
Currently, Contact Custom fields do not support the Date Time structure.
```

#### **From Format:**

The tool will auto-detect the format and preselect if you select a system field like Specific Date and Time, Current Date and Time, or Appointment start/end date and time. You must manually select the matching format if you choose a Custom Value or an Inbound Webhook Trigger.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155043085235/original/dDk15VGid2gSm1zfTK51IeJuowR3s8b5PQ.png?1741746552)

#### **To Format**

Select the desired output date and time format from the list of available formats. This is the format the original date and time will be converted to.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155043085239/original/iViu4OjOa6H_kHgDvM65p2ljHgoJg0-Y2g.png?1741746584)

---

### **Compare Dates**

The Compare Dates function is a valuable feature of the Date/Time Formatter action that allows users to compare two dates and obtain the difference in days. Here's a detailed overview of the Compare Dates function:

#### **Start Date Selection**

Choose the start date from various sources such as a Specific Date, Current Date, Contact's date fields, date type custom fields, Appointment start/end date, Custom values, or an Inbound Webhook Trigger.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155043086393/original/BMpIxErNiu7p2RxN-ivzSHrYTopTp4Vxbg.png?1741749979)

#### **Start Date Format**

If you select a system field like Specific Date, Current Date, Contact's date type standard or custom fields, or Appointment start/end date, the tool will auto-detect the format and preselect it. You must manually select the matching format if you choose a Custom Value or an Inbound Webhook Trigger.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155043086414/original/AJn---_UmwDK3ATEaKwKTjjqcAYrBn1sLw.png?1741750010)

#### **End Date Selection**

Choose the end date from the same sources as the start date (Specific Date, Current Date, Contact's date fields, date type custom fields, Appointment start/end date, Custom values, or from an Inbound Webhook Trigger).

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155043086424/original/oiwhL5F9dkcNN19ynLAhYESOb1LkLlL3tw.png?1741750049)

#### **End Date Format**

Like the start date format, the tool will auto-detect the format and preselect it if you choose a system field. You must manually select the matching format for Custom Value or Inbound Webhook Trigger.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155043086433/original/GQhQqrwdeT1M47-jKsb41yZRm9ErtQ9xsg.png?1741750074)

```
The difference is calculated as End Date - Start Date. You will get a negative value if the Start Date exceeds the End Date.  
  
The Compare Dates function is beneficial for users who need to perform date comparisons for various purposes, such as calculating due dates, determining the duration between events, or making decisions based on the time difference between two dates.
```

---

## **Use Cases**

The Date/Time Formatter action is helpful in various scenarios and for users who need to manage and manipulate date and time data. Here are some usage cases:

- **Event organizers:** Format event start and end dates and times received from different sources to maintain consistency and make the data more readable.
- **Marketing teams:** Use formatted date and time information in email campaigns, SMS, or Slack messages for personalized and time-sensitive communication.
- **Sales teams:** Compare the current date with invoice due dates to send automated reminders to clients with upcoming or overdue payments.
- **Customer support teams:** Reformat date and time data received via inbound webhook triggers to create support tickets or update CRM systems.
- **Project managers:** Compare project start dates and deadlines to calculate the time remaining and send notifications to team members.
- **Data analysts:**Store consistently formatted date and time data in spreadsheets or databases, making analyzing and generating reports easier.
- **Software developers:** Integrate formatted date and time data from various sources in their applications, ensuring compatibility and smooth data processing.
- **E-commerce businesses:** Reformat order and delivery date information for better tracking and customer communication.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q. How do I use the formatted date or time in other workflow actions?**

Once the Date/Time Formatter action processes a date or time, it stores the reformatted value in a dynamic variable (e.g., {{datetime\_formatter.1.date}}, {{datetime\_formatter.1.datetime}}). You can reference this variable in subsequent workflow actions, such as sending emails, updating CRM fields, or triggering conditional logic based on the date value.

**Q. What happens if I select the wrong format in the “From Format” field?**

If the selected From Format does not match the actual format of the input date, the workflow may fail to process the date correctly. This can result in missing or incorrect date values. Always ensure that the From Format accurately represents the original date structure before converting it.

**Q. Can I compare a date field from a contact’s record with the current date?**

Yes, the Compare Dates function allows you to compare a stored contact date (e.g., “Signup Date” or “Last Purchase Date”) with the Current Date. This can be useful for triggering reminders, follow-ups, or automated actions when a certain number of days have passed. The difference in days will be stored in {{datetime\_formatter.1.days}} for further use in workflows.

**Q. Can the Date/Time Formatter action handle time zone differences?**

The Date/Time Formatter action processes dates and times based on the system’s default time zone settings. If your workflow involves users across different time zones, ensure that you standardize all date/time values or convert them accordingly before applying formatting.

title_en: How to Create and Configure Voice AI Flows in HighLevel
source_md:
HighLevel's Flow-Based Builder lets you create AI-powered call workflows by connecting agents, routers, and actions on a visual canvas. You can configure each agent for a specific task, automate supported operations, and customize how calls are handled. This guide covers creating, configuring, testing, and deploying a Voice AI flow.

[동영상](https://www.loom.com/embed/42a7b59c2f39401eab0d29d451dcfb41)

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is a Voice AI Flow?](#What-is-a-Voice-AI-Flow?)
- [Key Benefits of Configuring Voice AI Flows](#Key-Benefits-of-Configuring-Voice-AI-Flows)
- [Before You Begin](#Before-You-Begin)
- [How to Set Up a Voice AI Flow](#How-to-Set-Up-a-Voice-AI-Flow)
  - [Step 1: Create a Flow-Based Voice AI Agent](#Step-1%3A-Create-a-Flow-Based-Voice-AI-Agent)
  - [Step 2: Configure the First AI Agent](#Step-2%3A-Configure-the-First-AI-Agent)
  - [Step 3: Add AI Agents and Configure Routing](#Step-3%3A%C2%A0Add-AI-Agents-and-Configure-Routing)
  - [Step 4: Configure Actions and Integrations](#Step-4%3A-Configure-Actions-and-Integrations)
  - [Step 5: Configure Voice and Call Settings](#Step-5%3A-Configure-Voice-and-Call-Settings)
  - [Step 6: Test the Voice AI Flow](#Step-6%3A%C2%A0Test-the-Voice-AI-Flow)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

## **What is a Voice AI Flow?**

A Voice AI flow is a sequence of connected nodes that determines how an AI-powered call progresses. Each node handles a particular responsibility, while connections and routing logic control what happens next.

For example, a lead qualification flow can follow this structure:

**Start Call → Greeter Agent → Router → Qualification Agent → CRM Action → End Call**

For an explanation of the available nodes and their capabilities, see **[Getting Started with the Flow-Based Builder for Voice AI.](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009134-getting-started-with-the-flow-based-builder-for-voice-ai)**

---

## **Key Benefits of Configuring Voice AI Flows**

Configuring a flow allows you to control the conversation at each stage while keeping individual agents focused on their assigned responsibilities.

- **Focused Agent Instructions:** Configure separate prompts, models, and tools for different tasks.
- **Conditional Routing:** Direct callers to appropriate agents based on their requests.
- **Automated Operations:** Perform supported actions through native tools, MCP, or Custom API integrations.
- **Custom Call Experience:** Configure voice, language, greetings, and call settings.
- **Reliable Deployment:** Test conversation paths and integrations before handling live calls.

---

## **Before You Begin**

Preparing the necessary resources helps prevent incomplete configurations and failed actions during testing.

Make sure you have:

- Access to a HighLevel sub-account with permission to manage Voice AI agents.
- A defined call scenario and the information each agent should collect or provide.
- Any required calendars, knowledge resources, API credentials, or MCP connections.
- An eligible phone number or Number Pool for live phone deployment.
- Applicable outbound calling verification and compliance setup if using outbound calls.

---

## **How to Set Up a Voice AI Flow**

A complete Voice AI flow needs connected conversation paths, configured agents, and working actions. Follow these steps to create a flow from scratch and prepare it for testing.

### **Step 1:** Create a Flow-Based Voice AI Agent

1. Navigate to **AI Agents → Voice AI → Agent List**.
2. Click **+ Create Agent**.
3. Select **Flow Based Builder**.
4. Click **Continue**.

The builder opens with a **Start Call** node connected to an **AI Agent** node.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083210171/original/6MRnO8ncwTM9e8QoIka072wHBwqN3Gt_6g.png?1791899514)**

**Note:** Save the agent to retain the starter flow.

### **Step 2:** Configure the First AI Agent

Each AI Agent node can have its own prompt, supported AI model, and tools. Begin by configuring the first agent to handle the opening conversation.

1. Select the existing **AI Agent** node.
2. Give it a descriptive name, such as *Greeter Agent*.
3. Enter a prompt defining its role, conversation goals, and expected responses.
4. Select the appropriate model from the available options.
5. Configure any tools required for this agent.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083210513/original/lct2gQ5lb_XFnIi-UNVidhydP17qce9J4w.png?1791899686)

For a Greeter Agent, the prompt should explain how to welcome callers, identify their needs, and guide them to the next conversation stage.

### **Step 3:**Add AI Agents and Configure Routing

Multiple AI Agent nodes let you separate tasks such as qualification, support, and appointment scheduling. Router nodes determine which path a caller follows.

1. Add another **AI Agent** node from the node library.
2. Configure its name, prompt, model, and relevant tools.
3. Add a **Router** node where the conversation needs to branch.
4. Connect the preceding agent to the Router.
5. Configure the routing conditions using the available controls.
6. Connect each route to the appropriate AI Agent or next node.
7. Add **End Call** nodes where conversations should conclude.

For example:

- **Sales inquiry:** Greeter → Router → Qualification Agent
- **Support request:** Greeter → Router → Support Agent

Ensure each route has a valid destination and accounts for requests that do not clearly match an expected path.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083210863/original/I2j6XZnA4ucVA8ixDycQ845oEUhJrqJ8kA.png?1791899804)**

### **Step 4:** Configure Actions and Integrations

Actions allow Voice AI agents to complete tasks during conversations, such as sending messages or updating information in connected systems.

1. Identify the operation your flow needs to perform.
2. Add the appropriate supported action or integration node.
3. Configure its required fields, connection details, and execution conditions.
4. Connect it to the relevant conversation path.
5. Save the configuration.

Depending on your builder's available options, you can use:

| Method | Use case |
| --- | --- |
| **Native Actions** | Supported built-in operations, including messaging and available CRM actions. |
| **Custom API** | Sending requests to external services through configured API endpoints. |
| **MCP Server** | Accessing supported tools for contacts, calendars, appointments, and other operations. |

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083211478/original/9QqXSRIUN1w_a3RlA1Rk5E1ky28LCguCeA.gif?1791900056)

**Updating Contacts and Booking Appointments**

Contact updates and appointment operations can be configured using supported native actions where available, or through appropriate MCP or API integrations.

For MCP integrations, configure the server connection, authentication details, permitted tools, and execution conditions before testing.

See [Model Context Protocol (MCP) Integration for Voice AI Agents](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008533-model-context-protocol-mcp-integration-for-voice-ai-agents) for detailed MCP configuration.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083211537/original/Dzab3UA3LtcZVhyfjstdnZ4de3G6dG4L0w.png?1791900090)

**Important:** Confirm that the CRM update or appointment was completed successfully before the agent tells the caller that the operation is finished.

### **Step 5:** Configure Voice and Call Settings

Voice and call settings control how the agent sounds and responds during conversations. Adjust these settings based on your audience and the type of calls the flow handles.

1. Open the available Voice AI settings.
2. Select the preferred **Language**.
3. Configure the **Inbound and Outbound Welcome Messages** as needed.
4. Choose a voice from **Voice Settings** and preview it.
5. Review **Call Settings**, including supported silence-handling and noise cancellation options.
6. Configure **Transcription & Speech** and **Translation** if required.
7. Review **Post-Call** settings and applicable **Outbound Settings**.
8. Save your changes.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083211602/original/SiskQqjZ6ByvlUKq8_T7x20Jv3NEyIxAxg.png?1791900138)**

### **Step 6:**Test the Voice AI Flow

Testing helps identify incorrect routing, missing instructions, and action failures before deploying the agent.

1. Save the latest flow configuration.
2. Open **Test Your Agent**.
3. Select **Web Call** or **Phone Call**.
4. Choose the available Inbound or Outbound scenario.
5. Start a test conversation.
6. Test each routing path and confirm that the correct agents respond.
7. Verify that configured actions execute and produce the expected results.
8. Review the available transcript, call log, and action details.
9. Make adjustments and retest.

**Web Call** is useful for testing conversation behavior directly in the browser. **Phone Call** testing is recommended for validating actual phone behavior.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083211762/original/Pk0tVvssfORskDi5N3_GBNQTD3wjhjiW-Q.png?1791900218)

**Note:** Call Transfer is not supported during Web Call testing. Use Phone Call testing when transfer functionality needs to be verified.

For more information, see [How to Test Voice AI Agents](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004108-testing-voice-ai-agents).

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Why is my new flow missing when I return to the builder?**

The initial starter flow must be saved. Save your agent after creating it and again after making configuration changes.

**Q: Why is a caller being routed to the wrong agent?**

Review the Router's conditions, the instructions of the preceding agent, and the connections between nodes. Test different caller phrases to confirm the routing works as intended.

**Q: What should I check if an MCP or API action fails?**

Verify the endpoint or server connection, authentication, permitted tools, request configuration, and execution conditions. Review available action results to identify the issue.

**Q: Why is a completed action not reflected in the CRM?**

Confirm that the action executed successfully, the required data was provided, and the integration has access to the intended record. Check the CRM activity and test logs before changing the configuration.

**Q: Can I test a flow before assigning a phone number?**

Yes. Web Call allows you to test conversations and supported actions from your browser without assigning a phone number.

**Q: Why is my deployed agent not answering calls?**

Check the assigned phone number, Call Routing mode, Working Hours, inbound call flow, forwarding, and voicemail settings.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [How to Create Voice AI Agents](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004107-how-to-create-voice-ai-agents)
- [How to Test Voice AI Agents](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004108-testing-voice-ai-agents)
- [Model Context Protocol (MCP) Integration for Voice AI Agents](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008533-model-context-protocol-mcp-integration-for-voice-ai-agents)
- [Build with AI for Voice AI Flows](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008311-build-with-ai-for-voice-ai-flows)
- [How to Use Voice AI Flow Builder Templates and Guided Setup](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008604-how-to-use-voice-ai-flow-builder-templates-and-guided-setup)
- [Snapshot Support for Flow-Based Voice AI Agent](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008490-snapshot-support-for-flow-based-voice-ai-agents)

title_en: Manage QR Codes with Search, Filters, Views, and Bulk Actions
source_md:
Managing a large QR Code library is easier with search, type filters, Grid and List views, quick actions, and bulk management tools. You can quickly find specific QR Codes, identify their type, access common actions, open individual analytics, and manage selected codes without opening each QR Code separately. This article explains how to find, organize, and manage QR Codes efficiently from the QR Codes listing.

---

[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/ZSsviiAkEXc?&wmode=opaque)

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [Overview of QR Codes Bulk Actions, Renaming & Copy Link Shortcut](#Overview-of-QR-Codes-Bulk-Actions,-Renaming-&-Copy-Link-Shortcut)
- [Key Benefits of QR Code Bulk Actions](#Key-Benefits-of-QR-Code-Bulk-Actions)
- [Search and Filter QR Codes](#Search-and-Filter-QR-Codes)
- [Switch Between Grid and List Views](#Switch-Between-Grid-and-List-Views)
- [Selecting QR Codes in Bulk](#Selecting-QR-Codes-in-Bulk)

  - [Step 1: Navigate to QR Codes](#Step-1%3A%C2%A0Navigate-to-QR-Codes)
  - [Step 2: Enable Select](#Step-2%3A-Enable-Select)
  - [Step 3: Select QR Codes](#Step-3%3A%C2%A0Select-QR-Codes)
- [Bulk Download (PNG, SVG, PDF)](#Bulk-Download-(PNG,-SVG,-PDF)%C2%A0)
- [Move to Folder (Bulk)](#Move-to-Folder-(Bulk))
- [Bulk Delete](#Bulk-Delete)
- [Quick Actions and QR Code Details](#Quick-Actions-and-QR-Code-Details)
- [Renaming QR Codes](#Renaming-QR-Codes)
- [Copy Link from the QR Code](#Copy-Link-from-the-QR-Code)
- [View Analytics for a QR Code](#View-Analytics-for-a-QR-Code)
- [Folder‑Level Actions: Download All / Rename](#Folder%E2%80%91Level-Actions%3A-Download-All-/-Rename)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

## **Overview of QR Codes Bulk Actions, Renaming & Copy Link Shortcut**

The QR Codes listing brings search, filtering, viewing options, quick actions, and bulk management into one place. These controls help you work with larger QR Code libraries while reducing the number of steps needed to find or manage a specific code.  
  
From the listing, you can search QR Codes by name, filter by one or more QR Code types, switch between Grid and List views, access frequently used actions, and manage selected QR Codes in bulk.

---

## **Key Benefits of QR Code Bulk Actions**

- **Find QR Codes faster:** Search by name and filter by one or more QR Code types to narrow the listing.

- **Choose your preferred view:** Switch between Grid and List views based on how you want to browse and manage QR Codes.

- **Access common actions faster:** Use quick actions for Edit, Copy link, and Analytics without opening each QR Code.

- **Identify codes more easily:** Type tags help distinguish QR Codes directly from the listing.

- **Manage multiple codes efficiently:** Select QR Codes and use bulk actions such as Download, Delete, and Move to Folder.

- **Open analytics directly:** Go from a QR Code card or row to that code's scan analytics without locating it again in the Analytics area.

---

## **Search and Filter QR Codes**

Search and filters help narrow a large QR Code library so you can quickly find the codes you need before viewing or managing them.  
  
1. From the Sub-Account, go to Sites → QR Codes.  
  
2. Enter a QR Code name in the search field to narrow the listing.  
  
3. Open the Type filter.  
  
4. Select one or more QR Code types you want to display.  
  
5. Use search and Type filters together when you need to narrow the results further.  
  
6. Review the active filter count to see how many QR Code types are currently applied.

## **Switch Between Grid and List Views**

Grid and List views give you different ways to browse the same QR Code library. Use the view that makes it easiest to identify and manage the QR Codes you are working with.  
  
1. Go to Sites → QR Codes.  
  
2. Use the view toggle on the QR Codes listing.  
  
3. Select Grid to browse QR Codes as cards, or select List to review them in rows.  
  
4. In List view, use the available row-level actions to manage an individual QR Code.

---

## **Selecting QR Codes in Bulk**

Selection enables the bulk toolbar. Choose specific QR Codes or select all visible to run a mass action.

#### **Step 1:**Navigate to QR Codes

From the sub-account dashboard, go to **Sites**→ **QR Codes**  
  
**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055358752/original/yKf-DJPYTSMieiKhRWq2eRqDL4jd_3HM6A.png?1759775165)**

#### **Step 2:** Enable Select

Click **Select** (top right) to enable checkboxes on each card.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055358901/original/q-XNPkqZX2k15Hns8QwZpaQJoFp6NwIaSw.png?1759775260)

#### **Step 3:**Select QR Codes

Check the items you want to manage. A counter (e.g., **“3 Selected”**) appears with bulk action icons in the top-right corner.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055358934/original/qTRKn5Ietr2O4i8P65mA5SBCJVZk4UtVEg.png?1759775326)

---

## **Bulk Download (PNG, SVG, PDF)**

Export many QR Codes at once. HighLevel generates ZIP files in the background and starts the download when ready.

1. With items selected, choose **Download** from the bulk toolbar, then pick **PNG**, **SVG**, or **PDF**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055359324/original/s4LyslSFKHW3EBIWzelXq0S8xx8TCyHmQw.jpeg?1759775805)
2. Confirm the download in the pop-up.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055359966/original/_vbJRRD6DIDImaH1jATjuYgkPdxCqQENVg.jpeg?1759776514)
3. If a QR Code’s requested format isn't available, you'll be offered alternative formats to choose from.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055360006/original/eHbUN_rz__i9S43n1Xl-C3m20hXxfqUrfw.png?1759776575)

---

## **Move to Folder (Bulk)**

Keep your library tidy by moving many QR Codes into a folder at once.

1. With items selected, click the **Move to Folder** icon.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055359207/original/nZm0pZnDN0sp3X5fmKAgG5aC2OJLDZHFZw.png?1759775631)
2. Choose a destination folder from the dropdown and click **Move** to complete.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055359252/original/mWGSLoOe0dLrwLFfqM09A2Rjqum1OWm3BA.png?1759775711)

---

## **Bulk Delete**

Remove unwanted QR Codes safely. A confirmation helps prevent accidental loss.

1. With items selected, click the **Delete** icon.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055359463/original/3m1FnzjXa1u_KD-rrynu2z89EcrQYgar4g.png?1759775894)
2. Review the confirmation message and click **Delete** to proceed.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055359479/original/0zYFHeGcOnNgYZH7BmYCjYZHsoQ6g7CGqA.png?1759775922)

---

## **Quick Actions and QR Code Details**

Frequently used actions are available directly from the QR Codes listing, reducing the need to open each code or navigate through additional menus.  
  
**Quick Actions in Grid View**  
Hover over a QR Code card to access the available quick actions:

- **Edit:**Open the QR Code editor.
- **Copy link:**Copy the QR Code link.
- **Analytics:** Open analytics for that specific QR Code.

Use the 3-dot menu when you need additional actions that are not shown as quick actions.

**Identify QR Codes by Type**  
Each QR Code card displays a type tag to help you identify the type of code without opening it. Hover over the type tag to view additional information about the QR Code.

## 

## **Renaming QR Codes**

Rename items without leaving the page. Use consistent naming to improve searchability and reporting.

1. Hover any QR Code card and click the ⋯ menu → **Rename**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083586116/original/9NLh3AO0WHP3LHgpNr3IjfVnjl2xAm0znQ.png?1792290853)
2. Enter the new name and click **Save**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055359640/original/WQnumTxXTEv5o5MMAYdZV5GaAtPsOHWVbw.png?1759776084)

---

## **Copy Link from the QR Code**

Instantly copy a direct link to the QR Code for sharing in emails, docs, or print workflows.

Hover a QR Code card, click **Copy Link**. alternatively, you can copy link from three dots menu and select copy link option.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083586082/original/WX75TQqAmoFcRTxzINqhOA-csuHrBoZK1g.gif?1792290549)

---

## **View Analytics for a QR Code**

You can open analytics directly from the QR Code listing to review the performance of a specific QR Code.

1. Navigate to **Sites → QR Codes**.
2. Locate the QR Code you want to analyze.
3. Hover over the QR Code card and select **Analytics**.
4. Review the available scan metrics and insights.

## 

The QR Code Analytics dashboard provides the following information:

- **QR scans and Unique QR scans:** Review scan activity over the selected period.
- **Scans by device type:** Understand which device categories are associated with QR Code scans.
- **Top browsers:** Identify the browsers used to access QR Code destinations.
- **Geographic analytics:** View visitor distribution by country, state, or city.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084317891/original/yNciZjAr9mhWh_O0_1CanlLNZ77azhOgAw.png?1793109122)**

For more information about these reports, see [How to Use Site and Funnel Analytics in HighLevel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000003094-how-to-use-site-and-funnel-analytics-in-highlevel).

---

## **F****older‑Level Actions: Download All / Rename**

Manage whole folders quickly—download everything inside or rename the folder. To make folder-level edits, click the**3 dot icon** on the folder.

- Click the **Download** icon on a folder to export all contained QR Codes (ZIP, async).
- Click the **Rename** icon on a folder to change its name.
- Click the Delete icon to remove all QR Codes in a folder.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055359903/original/J4tWyQ9jsQ8fzgu_oXt6dnTb4VdNg-JC_w.png?1759776365)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Where can I find these bulk actions?**  
In Sites → QR Codes, click Select to enable the bulk toolbar at the top right.

**Q: Which formats can I download?**  
PNG, SVG, or PDF. Large batches are delivered as ZIP files.

**Q: I chose SVG, but I see an “SVG Format Not Available” message. What now?**  
Some older QR Codes may not support SVG. Use the dialog to switch to PNG or PDF for those items.

**Q: Can I download everything inside a folder at once?**  
Yes. Click the Download icon on the folder to export all codes (async ZIP).

**Q: Is delete permanent?**  
Yes. Bulk delete is irreversible. Download any needed codes before deleting.

**Q: Are there selection limits?**  
You can select many items at once; very large batches may be split into multiple ZIPs. (If you encounter limits, reduce the selection and repeat.)

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Bulk QR Code Creation](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005441)
