title_en: Import Contacts and Automatically Create Associate Companies
source_md:
At the moment, Contacts and Companies are imported separately. However, you can still successfully create and associate them using the workflows below.

This guide covers all possible scenarios:

1. Contacts exist + Companies exist (but not associated)
2. Contacts exist + Companies do not
3. Neither Contacts nor Companies exist
4. Companies exist + Contacts do not

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What Is Contact Business Name Automation](#%E2%80%8B%E2%80%8BWhat-Is-Contact-Business-Name-Automation)
- [Key Benefits of Contact Business Name Automation](#Key-Benefits-of-Contact-Business-Name-Automation)
- [How to Configure Contact Business Name Automation](#How-to-Configure-Contact-Business-Name-Automation)
- [Enable Contact Business Name Automation](#Enable-Contact-Business-Name-Automation)
- [Prepare Your Contacts CSV File](#Prepare-Your-Contacts-CSV-File)
- [Start a Contact Import](#Start-a-Contact-Import)
- [Upload the Contact CSV File](#Upload-the-Contact-CSV-File)
- [Choose How Contacts Should Be Imported](#Choose-How-Contacts-Should-Be-Imported)
- [Map Contact Fields Correctly](#Map-Contact-Fields-Correctly)
- [Verify Company Creation and Association](#Verify-Company-Creation-and-Association)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)

---

# **What Is Contact Business Name Automation**

The Contact Business Name automation enables the system to automatically create and associate company records based on the Business Name field on contact records. When this automation is enabled at the Company object level, the platform uses the Business Name value to determine whether a company should be created or updated. This removes the need to manually create company records or link contacts to companies. The automation helps keep company data consistent when managing contacts at scale.

This automation is applied whenever contacts are created or updated, including during bulk contact imports. For imported contacts, the Business Name field in the CSV file acts as the trigger for creating and associating company records. The automation also works retroactively for existing contacts that already have a Business Name value. By relying on a single contact field, this approach ensures company associations are created automatically without additional configuration or manual intervention.

---

## **Key Benefits of Contact Business Name Automation**

- **Automatic company creation:**Company records are created automatically using the Business Name field on contact records, removing the need for manual company setup.

- **Built-in contact–company association:**Contacts are automatically linked to the appropriate company at the time of creation or update, eliminating manual association steps.

- **Supports bulk and ongoing updates:**The automation works during contact imports as well as when existing contacts are updated, making it suitable for both initial setup and ongoing data management.

- **Consistent company data:**Using a single source field for company creation helps maintain consistency across company records and reduces duplicate or mismatched data.

- **Reduced manual effort:**By handling company creation and association automatically, the automation streamlines workflows and minimizes repetitive administrative tasks.

---

## **How to Configure Contact Business Name Automation**

This section walks through how to enable and configure the Contact Business Name automation at the Company object level.

**Enable Contact Business Name Automation**

To use this feature, enable the automation from Settings → Objects → Companies within the sub-account. Select the option to automatically create and associate companies from contact business names and save the changes. This setting must be enabled per sub-account, and saving is required for the automation to take effect.

**Open the Companies Object**

Navigate to **Settings** and select **Objects** to access all standard and custom objects available in the sub-account. From the list of standard objects, open **Companies** to manage company-related settings. This is where the Contact Business Name automation is configured and enabled.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155062129192/original/W8_Gsi82Ht7OGykH0lXMkPVwx9S8ZAQNFg.png?1767793670)

### **Enable Contact Business Name Automation**

In the **Companies** object settings, locate the automation that allows companies to be created and associated from contact business names. Enable this option by selecting the checkbox, then save your changes to activate the automation. This step is required for the system to automatically create and link company records during contact creation or updates.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155062129457/original/hZHF_vT23lbCm1-1VlUltCP-vjnYfhUI6g.png?1767793760)

### **Prepare Your Contacts CSV File**

Your CSV file must include a column named Business Name, as this field triggers automatic company creation and association. The column name must match exactly, while other contact-related fields can be included as needed. No company-specific fields are required in the CSV file.

### 

### **Start a Contact Import**

After enabling the automation and preparing the CSV file, import contacts from the Contacts section using the standard import flow. During the import, the system reads the Business Name value on each contact and automatically creates or updates company records while associating them with the imported contacts.

Go to the **Contacts** section and select **Import** to begin uploading contact data.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155062129556/original/eLvSTExtNo16FLPPn6me6S5uO3FAUDO2pg.png?1767793839)

### 

**Select Contacts as the Import Object**

On the import start screen, select **Contacts** as the object to import. This step is important because the Contact Business Name automation runs only when contacts are created or updated. Choosing Contacts ensures the Business Name data is processed correctly to trigger automatic company creation and association.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155062130598/original/rjdSqLDqX7axqdCPqR4cnY3wYemE98hqeA.png?1767794333)

### **Upload the Contact CSV File**

On the upload screen, select your CSV file or drag and drop it into the upload area. This file should include the **Business Name** column, as it provides the data required to trigger automatic company creation and association. Uploading the correct file ensures the automation can be applied during the import process.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155062130798/original/liMEDCybPzAL-7tT6KJSmWzWgRzj6adp0g.png?1767794490)

```
Adding Business Name Column to Your CSV File

Ensure your contact CSV file includes a column named Business Name, which is required for the automation to work. This column defines the company name that will be created and associated with each contact during import. The column name must match exactly to be recognized by the system.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155062131250/original/SjLxkgLWQR5BnSTbk0X9CZsgFUxNwghn1A.png?1767794767)
```

### **Choose How Contacts Should Be Imported**

Select **Create and update contacts** to allow the import to add new contacts and update existing ones. This option ensures the Contact Business Name automation is applied to both newly created contacts and existing contacts with a Business Name value. Choosing the correct import behavior helps apply the automation consistently across your contact data.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155062131467/original/AqE7lG4Tcd6Iwucs0Lce7jrTy86XIeVv4Q.png?1767794912)

### **Map Contact Fields Correctly**

During the import process, confirm that the Business Name column from the CSV file is mapped to the Business Name field on the Contact object.

This mapping is critical, as the automation relies on the contact-level Business Name value to create and associate company records. Incorrect mapping can prevent the automation from working as expected.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155062131724/original/qqggFSMT0UkshpWWntPyzOvSuZJDO9rfFQ.png?1767795012)

### **Verify Company Creation and Association**

Once the import is complete, verify the results by opening a contact record to confirm the Business Name is populated and associated with a company. You can also review the Companies section to see the automatically created company records based on the imported contact data.

**On Contact Records**

Open a contact record and review the **Companies** section under Associations to confirm the linked company. The presence of a company marked as the primary company indicates that the Contact Business Name automation successfully created and associated the company record. 

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155062136520/original/7bhh-tBwUP6eQQQY1nKCYu_UAWY42bHJBw.png?1767796489)

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155062136659/original/TzJU-G5a3rlw-_QW2DxE9kfcMW_xZZ_neA.png?1767796598)

**Verify On Company Records**

Open the **Companies** tab to review the company records created or updated as part of the contact import. The presence of company names from the CSV file confirms that the Contact Business Name automation ran successfully. This step helps validate that company records were created automatically without manual setup.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155062136291/original/zu-11_0bKq1uoSFNSMaIDLDnNFFVfogVLA.png?1767796373)

After this step - if you also want to update the companies and add custom field values to the same - you can do so by exporting these companies and then adding the remaining values and importing it back to the table - this allows you to have the updated company values in the companies table too.  
You can learn more about importing companies [here](https://help.gohighlevel.com/a/solutions/articles/155000007403?portalId=48000045315).

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Does this feature allow me to import companies directly?**

No, this feature does not support importing companies as a standalone object. Company records are created and updated automatically only when contacts are created or updated with a Business Name value. Contact imports are used to apply the automation, but companies themselves are not imported directly.

**Q: Which field is required to trigger company creation and association?**

The Business Name field on the contact record is required for this automation to work. The column name in the CSV file must match Business Name exactly, as this value is used to create or update company records and associate them with contacts. Other field names or variations will not trigger the automation.

**Q: Will this automation work for existing contacts?**

Yes, the automation works for both newly created contacts and existing contacts. When enabled, the system retroactively creates and associates company records for existing contacts that already have a Business Name value. This allows company records to be created without re-importing all contacts.

**Q: How can I confirm that companies were created and associated successfully?**

You can verify the results in two ways. First, open a contact record and check the Companies section under Associations to confirm the linked company. Second, navigate to the Companies tab to review the company records created or updated during the import. Seeing company names from the CSV file confirms the automation ran successfully.

title_en: Round Robin Calendars: Setup, Distribution & Availability Explained
source_md:
[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/USsHmqXI6lE?&wmode=opaque)

Round Robin Calendars allow businesses to distribute appointments evenly among multiple team members. This feature ensures that scheduling is **efficient, fair, and optimized** based on availability or workload balance. This guide will walk you through the steps to set up **Round Robin Calendars**, configure **distribution settings**, and customize **team member assignments**.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What Are Round Robin Calendars and how do they work?](#What-Are-Round-Robin-Calendars-and-how-do-they-work?)
- [Why Use Round Robin Calendars?](#Why-Use-Round-Robin-Calendars?)
- [Creating the Round Robin Calendar](#Creating-the-Round-Robin-Calendar)
- [Additional Resources & Support for HighLevel Calendars](#Additional-Resources-&-Support-for-HighLevel-Calendars)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)

---

## **What Are Round Robin Calendars and how do they work?**

A **Round Robin Calendar** is a scheduling system that automatically distributes appointments among assigned team members. It ensures **fair workload distribution** and **optimizes availability** by automatically checking which team member is available at the requested time. Some key points about **Round Robin Calendars**:

- **At least one team member** must be assigned to a Round Robin Calendar during setup.
- When a customer **requests an appointment**, the system first checks the **availability of the first assigned team member**.
- If the first team member is **not available**, it automatically moves to the **next team member**.
- This continues until an **available team member** is found.
- If **no team members** are available at the selected time, the system **prevents customers from booking an empty slot**, ensuring they only see valid appointment options.

**Key Benefit:** Customers only book appointments when a team member is actually available, eliminating scheduling conflicts and reducing manual intervention.

### **How Slot Capacity Is Calculated**

If your Round Robin calendar allows multiple appointments per slot, availability is determined by slot capacity limits. Each confirmed appointment reduces slot capacity by 1. If an appointment overlaps multiple time slots, the system reduces the availability by 1 in each affected slot. A slot is blocked only when its defined capacity limit is fully reached. Overlapping appointments no longer fully block all affected slots prematurely.

---

## **Why Use Round Robin Calendars?**

Round Robin Calendars provide several advantages, especially for teams that **share appointments** or handle **client interactions collectively**. Some key benefits are as follows:

- **Efficient Scheduling** – Automates appointment assignments, saving time and reducing manual effort.
- **Balanced Workload** – Distributes appointments evenly, preventing one team member from being overloaded.
- **Faster Response Times** – Ensures the **next available** team member gets assigned, improving customer experience.
- **Flexibility for Clients** – Customers can choose **any available slot**, increasing scheduling convenience.
- **Ideal for Scaling Teams** – Helps growing businesses manage high volumes of appointments without bottlenecks.

---

## **Creating the Round Robin Calendar**

Creating a Round Robin Calendar ensures that appointments are automatically distributed among available team members. This step involves selecting the calendar type, configuring the appointment distribution logic, and assigning at least one team member.

**Step 1**: Navigate to **Settings → Calendars** in HighLevel, click on **Create Calendar,** and select the **Round Robin** as the calendar type.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155041483729/original/snsUAoeI0jXrawvKNPCS0U_HWtTPkjxQTA.gif?1739375415)

```
You can also Click on the Calendars Tab in the Subaccount, click on Calendar Settings and then click on Create Calendar and select the Round Robin as the calendar type.
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155041483845/original/rKM8KM6Iq9udR3tBzWCRL9tg2w_LN5-DKg.gif?1739375508)
```

**Step 2: Calendar Name and Description:** Here, you can assign a name to the calendar and add a description based on your requirements. The description helps clarify the purpose of the calendar, making it easier to remember its intended use or the reason it was created.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155041484643/original/iz5he2aAOvGRPnvYMbqM8aSrbNKlNjf3cg.png?1739376288)**

**Step 3: Select Team Members:**Choose one or more team members who will be assigned appointments through the Round-Robin scheduling system.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155041484869/original/WafregsoVAPBerKYhGF0_Jf0uKHtFi7Z5A.png?1739376493)

**Step 4**: **Custom URL**: A unique URL slug is automatically created based on your calendar name. If needed, you can edit it manually. When edited, the system will check the URL availability. If the URL is already taken, you’ll see a message and can modify it until you find an available one.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155041485231/original/nWi1ronf3urcKqDdyPxCHA2Mu64Ib_m80A.png?1739376814)

**Step 5: Meeting Duration and Booking Availability:** HighLevel allows you to **customize meeting durations** in both **minutes and hours**, ensuring flexibility based on your business needs. You can set up your calendar based on **team member preferences** or **company-wide scheduling policies**. You can configure **specific dates and exceptions**, ensuring precise control over when appointments can be scheduled.

For detailed steps on customizing availability, refer to[Calendar Availability - Weekly Working Hours & Date-Specific Hours](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000001716-calendar-availability-weekly-working-hours-date-specific-hours?utm_source=chatgpt.com).

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155041486443/original/cWQ8bXHu38oMrFFrVY0aHz5oip6ikzS7Iw.png?1739377639)

**Step 6: Accept Payments:**The **Accept Payments tab** allows you to enable payments directly through your calendar. If your services or products require payment, you can toggle this option to accept payments seamlessly during the booking process.

HighLevel also provides a variety of currency options, allowing **Multiple Currency Support**. You can add a **C****ustom Description** under the Payment Information section. This helps customers understand the payment terms, pricing details, or any special instructions before completing their booking.

For detailed steps on customizing availability, refer to[Collecting Payments in Calendars](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000000875-collecting-payments-in-calendars)

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155041487283/original/6Db1jW9CQ6yCg_YDAJm3RkjsLNdxB9ES1g.png?1739378259)

**Step 7: Save the Calendar**: Once all the settings have been customized, click on **Save** to **Create**your **Round-Robin Calendar.**

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155041487667/original/ulEJ6ONGiZ3Ejx4e8VCmpRkHbF9n2YmjhA.png?1739378535)**

```
You can now Priview the calendar or if you wish to reset some settings, please navigate to the Calendar → Click on 3 dots on the right side of the Calendar → Edit.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155041487927/original/LD3pY33tuVpR4Y9ylvFQTtKdbfenmgbEYg.png?1739378796)
```

---

## **Additional Resources & Support for HighLevel Calendars**

These resources provide **comprehensive support for setting up, managing, and troubleshooting calendars in HighLevel**. Whether you're configuring **Round Robin appointments, collecting payments, troubleshooting booking issues, or embedding your calendar**, these guides will help you optimize your scheduling.

### **1. Calendar Setup & Customization**

- [Round Robin Calendars Appointment Distribution Logic](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000001484-round-robin-calendars-appointment-distribution-logic) – Learn how Round Robin schedules appointments based on availability or equal distribution.
- [Team Member Assignment in Round Robin Calendars](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000002711-team-member-assignment-round-robin-calendar-) – Configure how team members are assigned to appointments and rescheduling preferences.
- [How to Configure Staff Selection in Round Robin Calendars](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001239842-how-to-configure-staff-member-selection-in-round-robin-calendars-) – Enable invitees to choose their preferred team member while booking.
- [Setting Up Linked & Conflict Calendars](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000002374-setting-up-linked-calendars-conflict-calendars) – Prevent double bookings by syncing HighLevel with external calendars like Google or Outlook.

### **2. Calendar Availability & Scheduling**

- [Adjusting Availability Settings for Individual Calendars](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001155718-adjusting-availability-settings-for-individual-calendars) – Set working hours, buffer times, and appointment slot durations.
- [Calendar Availability - Weekly Working Hours & Date-Specific Hours](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000001716-calendar-availability-weekly-working-hours-date-specific-hours) – Customize team availability by selecting specific days and times.

### **3. Payment Collection in Calendars**

- [Collecting Payments in Calendars](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000000875-collecting-payments-in-calendars) – Enable payments for appointments, choose payment gateways, and add pricing details.

### **4. Calendar Troubleshooting & Management**

- [Troubleshooting Tool for Calendar](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000003358-troubleshooting-tool-for-calendar) – Identify and fix issues preventing bookings or causing scheduling conflicts.
- [Deactivating Calendar Groups](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000003551-deactivating-calendar-groups) – Disable or remove calendar groups while maintaining records.
- [Embedding HighLevel Calendars using HTML Code](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48000982201-embedding-highlevel-calendars-using-html-code) – Share and embed your calendar on websites or landing pages for easier booking access.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q. What happens if no team members are available?**  
The invitee will be prompted to select another date/time.

**Q. Can I manually assign appointments to team members instead of using Round Robin?**  
Yes, you can override automatic assignments in the appointment settings.

**Q. Can I prioritize specific team members for certain clients?**  
No, Round Robin currently only supports **availability-based or equal distribution settings**.

**Q. Can I charge clients when they book an appointment?**  
Yes, you can enable **Accept Payments** to require payment when clients book a service.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Why Appointment Time Slots Are Missing on Your Calendar](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001181711)
- [Show Seats Per Slot for Class Booking](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000000956)
- [Adjusting Availability Settings for Individual Calendars](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001155718)

title_en: What is the Knowledge Base Retrieval Tester?
source_md:
[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/sxlUj4\_9Uvw?&wmode=opaque)

The Knowledge Base Retrieval Tester helps you validate how well your HighLevel Knowledge Base responds to test questions before it is used in live AI experiences. It gives you a safe way to confirm that uploaded, crawled, rich-text, document, and table-based content can be found and used by AI tools.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is the Knowledge Base Retrieval Tester?](#What-is-the-Knowledge-Base-Retrieval-Tester?)
- [Key Benefits of the Knowledge Base Retrieval Tester](#Key-Benefits-of-the-Knowledge-Base-Retrieval-Tester)
- [When to Use the Knowledge Base Retrieval Tester](#When-to-Use-the-Knowledge-Base-Retrieval-Tester)
- [Understanding Retrieved Sources and Chunks](#Understanding-Retrieved-Sources-and-Chunks)
- [How To Setup the Knowledge Base Retrieval Tester](#How-To-Setup-the-Knowledge-Base-Retrieval-Tester)
- [Best Practices for Testing Your Knowledge Base](#Best-Practices-for-Testing-Your-Knowledge-Base)
- [Troubleshooting Retrieval Results](#Troubleshooting-Retrieval-Results)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#[H3]-Related-Articles)

---

# **What is the Knowledge Base Retrieval Tester?**

HighLevel Knowledge Bases can include multiple source types, including documents, rich-text content, tables, and web-based sources. Existing Knowledge Base articles explain that HighLevel extracts, structures, chunks, and indexes content so AI agents can retrieve relevant information when answering questions. The Retrieval Tester adds a focused way to check whether that retrieval process is working as expected before customers interact with it.

Use the Retrieval Tester to ask sample questions, review which sources are returned, spot missing or irrelevant content, and retest after making Knowledge Base updates.

---

## **Key Benefits of the Knowledge Base Retrieval Tester**

The Retrieval Tester helps you move from guessing to validating. Instead of assuming your Knowledge Base is ready, you can test real customer-style questions and review the content HighLevel retrieves.

- **Real-Time Knowledge Base Testing:**Ask a question and instantly see how your Knowledge Base responds.
- **Source Level Transparency:**Review the content sources or chunks used to generate the test result.
- **Faster Troubleshooting:** Identify missing, irrelevant, outdated, or poorly structured content before going live.
- **Improved Knowledge Base Quality:**Use test results to refine documents, tables, rich-text entries, and crawled sources.
- **Safe Validation:**Run read-only tests without changing your Knowledge Base or affecting live conversations.
- **Faster Iteration:** Update Knowledge Base content and retest to confirm the improvement.

---

## **When to Use the Knowledge Base Retrieval Tester**

Testing your Knowledge Base is most useful when you need confidence that AI tools can find the right information. A strong test process helps prevent incomplete answers, irrelevant source usage, and customer-facing confusion.

Use the Retrieval Tester hen:

- You add a new document, PDF, DOC, DOCX, rich-text article, CSV table, or website source.
- You update existing Knowledge Base content.
- You want to confirm that important business information is retrievable.
- You are preparing an AI Employee, Conversation AI bot, or Voice AI agent for launch.
- You notice AI responses using the wrong source or missing expected details.
- You want to compare how different questions retrieve different chunks of content.
- You need to confirm whether duplicate or conflicting content is affecting retrieval.

---

## **Understanding Retrieved Sources and Chunks**

Retrieved sources show which Knowledge Base content HighLevel found relevant to your test question. Reviewing these results helps you understand whether your source content is clear, complete, and structured in a way AI tools can use.

A Knowledge Base may break source content into searchable pieces, often referred to as chunks. For example, document support extracts headings and text so AI agents can find relevant passages, while table support semantically indexes records so plain-English questions can retrieve matching rows.

When reviewing test results, look for:

- Whether the expected source appears in the results.
- Whether the returned chunk directly answers the question.
- Whether irrelevant or outdated content is being retrieved.
- Whether similar sources contain duplicate or conflicting information.
- Whether the content is too broad, too vague, or missing important terms customers may use.

---

## **How To Setup the Knowledge Base Retrieval Tester**

A proper setup helps you test the same content your AI tools will rely on. Before testing, make sure the Knowledge Base contains the sources you want to validate and that indexing or processing is complete.

1. Navigate to **AI Agents > Knowledge Base**.  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155069903368/original/khNY3HXTWddbT4BnRNs7xaDyHcSPAlfeGg.png?1777040279)
2. Open the Knowledge Base you want to test.
3. Confirm the Knowledge Base includes the sources you want to validate, such as:  
     
   - Documents
   - Rich-text content
   - Tables
   - Website or web crawler content
   - Other supported Knowledge Base source types
4. Wait for newly added or updated content to finish processing or indexing.
5. Open the **Knowledge Base Retrieval Tester**.  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155070024558/original/RCft-P6ODDcQ0gTBl4Yq_IvWTWby4whecg.png?1777290947)
6. Enter a realistic customer-style question.  
     
   Example: “What is your refund policy?” or “Which customers have overdue invoices?”
7. Review the answer and retrieved sources.
8. Check whether the retrieved sources match the content you expected HighLevel to use.
9. Update your Knowledge Base content if results are missing, incomplete, outdated, or irrelevant.
10. Retest the same question to confirm the updated content is now retrieved correctly.

---

## **Best Practices for Testing Your Knowledge Base**

A good test uses the same types of questions your customers, leads, or internal users are likely to ask. Testing only one perfect question may miss gaps that appear when users phrase things differently.

Use these Best Practices:

- Test simple, direct questions first.
- Test natural customer wording instead of internal terminology only.
- Ask the same question in multiple ways.
- Include questions that should return a specific document, table row, or policy.
- Test edge cases, exceptions, and high-impact customer questions.
- Review sources, not just the generated answer.
- Remove or update outdated content that competes with newer content.
- Break very long or unclear content into cleaner sections when retrieval results are poor.
- Retest after every major Knowledge Base update.

---

## **Troubleshooting Retrieval Results**

Retrieval testing is most valuable when it helps you find and fix weak spots. If the results are not what you expected, use the retrieved sources to identify whether the issue is missing content, unclear wording, poor structure, or conflicting information.

| Issue | What It May Mean | Recommended Action |
| --- | --- | --- |
| No source is retrieved | The content may not be indexed, available, or phrased similarly enough to the question. | Confirm indexing is complete, then add clearer wording that matches how users ask the question. |
| Wrong source is retrieved | Another source may appear more relevant or contain overlapping terms. | Update, remove, or clarify competing content. |
| Answer is incomplete | The source may not include all required details. | Add missing details to the relevant Knowledge Base entry. |
| Outdated source is retrieved | Old content may still exist in the Knowledge Base. | Remove or update outdated content. |
| Table data is not returned | The table may still be processing or the relevant columns may not be indexed. | Confirm CSV setup, selected columns, and processing status. |
| Document content is missing | The document may not have been parsed clearly. | Review headings, formatting, and source quality, then re-upload or revise the content. |
| Results improve after rewording the question | The Knowledge Base may not include common customer phrasing. | Add natural-language terms, synonyms, and clearer headings. |

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Does the Knowledge Base Retrieval Tester change my Knowledge Base?**No. The tester is a read-only simulation. It does not edit, delete, or update your Knowledge Base content.

**Q: Does testing affect live customer conversations?**No. Testing does not send messages to customers or trigger live conversations.

**Q: Can I use the Retrieval Tester before going live?**  
Yes. The tester is designed to help you validate Knowledge Base quality before connecting content to live AI experiences.

**Q: Is this the same as testing my Conversation AI bot?**  
No. Retrieval testing checks whether Knowledge Base content can be found and returned. Bot testing checks the broader conversation experience, including bot goals, prompts, actions, and response behavior.

**Q: Why is the wrong source being retrieved?**  
The wrong source may contain similar wording, duplicate information, outdated details, or broader content that appears more relevant to the test question. Review overlapping sources and make the correct source clearer.

**Q: Why is expected content missing from the results?**  
The content may still be processing, may not be indexed, may be formatted in a way that is hard to parse, or may not contain wording that matches the question closely enough.

**Q: Can I retest after updating my Knowledge Base?**  
Yes. After updating your Knowledge Base and allowing processing or indexing to complete, run the same test question again to confirm the results improved.

**Q: What types of Knowledge Base content can I test?**  
Use the tester to validate supported Knowledge Base content such as documents, rich-text content, tables, and web-based sources.

**Q: Does the tester show the exact answer customers will receive?**  
The tester helps validate Knowledge Base retrieval and source usage. Final customer-facing responses may still depend on the connected AI tool, prompt, bot setup, conversation context, and channel.

**Q: What should I do if the retrieved source is technically correct but the answer is weak?**  
Improve the source content by adding clearer headings, direct answers, examples, and customer-friendly wording. Then retest the same question.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Knowledge Base Overview](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007313-knowledge-base-overview?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- [Knowledge Base - Document & Rich-Text Support](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006671-knowledge-base-document-rich-text-support?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- [AI Employee - Knowledge Base Tables](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006637-ai-employee-knowledge-base-tables?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- [Conversation AI - New Knowledge Sources & Quality Upgrades](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006456-conversation-ai-new-knowledge-sources-quality-upgrades?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- [View & Edit AI Response Info in Conversations](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004183-view-edit-ai-response-info-in-conversations?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- [Knowledge Base Integration for Voice AI Agents](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005266-knowledge-base-integration-for-voice-ai-agents?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

title_en: How to Create Custom Profile Card QR Codes
source_md:
Create a personalized Profile Card QR code in HighLevel to share your professional details, social links, and important destinations from one mobile-friendly page. Visitors can save your contact information, submit their own details through an Exchange Contact form, and connect with you more easily. Both the digital profile card and the QR code can be customized to match your branding.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What Is a Profile Card QR Code?](#What-Is-a-Profile-Card-QR-Code?)
- [Key Benefits of Profile Card QR Codes](#Key-Benefits-of-Profile-Card-QR-Codes)
- [Built-In and Custom Links](#Built-In-and-Custom-Links)
- [Save Contact](#Save-Contact)
  - [Automatically Download My Contact Info](#Automatically-Download-My-Contact-Info)
- [Exchange Contact](#Exchange-Contact)
  - [Open Exchange Contact Form by Default](#Open-Exchange-Contact-Form-by-Default)
- [How to Set Up a Profile Card QR Code](#How-to-Set-Up-a-Profile-Card-QR-Code)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What Is a Profile Card QR Code?**

A Profile Card QR code opens a mobile-friendly digital profile when scanned. It gives individuals one convenient place to share professional details, contact information, social profiles, booking links, portfolios, and other important resources.

Visitors can use the card to call, email, visit a website, open shared links, or save the profile owner’s contact information directly to their device. The card can also include an Exchange Contact form, allowing visitors to submit their own details and become contacts in the CRM. This makes Profile Cards useful for networking, events, sales conversations, email signatures, printed materials, and other situations where someone needs a fast way to connect.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077737673/original/oQKnSfHmR3vNIWQLHPR0tC0vvmFJ5RUFwg.png?1785959697)

---

## **Key Benefits of Profile Card QR Codes**

- **Professional digital presence:** Present your professional information through a modern, mobile-friendly page.
- **Faster contact sharing:** Let visitors save your contact details directly to their device.
- **Built-in lead capture:** Collect visitor information through an Exchange Contact form and create contacts in the CRM.
- **Flexible branding:** Customize images, colors, text, icons, and buttons to match your personal or company brand.
- **Centralized links:** Share websites, booking calendars, portfolios, payment pages, social profiles, and landing pages.
- **Customizable QR design:** Match the QR code’s colors, frame, logo, background, and supporting text to your campaign.
- **Flexible sharing:** Download the QR code or copy the direct link for use in digital and printed materials.

---

## **Built-In and Custom Links**

Links turn the Profile Card into a central destination for professional actions such as booking an appointment, viewing a portfolio, making a payment, or connecting on social media. Add only the most useful destinations and arrange them in the order visitors should see them.

Built-in social link options include X, Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok and Pinterest.

Custom links can be used for destinations such as Booking calendars, Portfolios, Landing Pages or Additional social profiles.

Use the built-in link dropdown to add supported social platforms. Select **Add custom links** to enter another destination, name the link, and choose a matching icon.

---

## **Save Contact**

The Save Contact button gives visitors a faster way to add your professional information to their device. It appears on Profile Cards by default and does not require Exchange Contact to be enabled.

When a visitor selects **Save Contact**, their device begins the process of adding your contact information. The confirmation or save experience may vary by browser, operating system, and device settings.

### **Automatically Download My Contact Info**

Starting the contact-download experience automatically makes it easier for visitors to save your information without locating the Save Contact button.

Enable **Automatically Download My Contact Info** to initiate the contact-saving experience when the Profile Card opens. The visitor’s browser or device may still require confirmation before downloading or saving the information.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077737688/original/Yrwr-kV2QXQGdwpcVYH8ulickWKzTp2GHQ.png?1785959771)

---

## **Exchange Contact**

Exchange Contact allows visitors to submit their own information from your Profile Card. This turns the card into a lead-capture tool while still allowing visitors to view and save your details. When Exchange Contact is enabled, an **Exchange Contact** button appears on the card. Selecting the button opens a form where the visitor can enter their information.

When the visitor submits the form, a contact is created in the CRM. Contact activity identifies the Profile Card as the origin of the lead.

### **Open Exchange Contact Form by Default**

Opening the form automatically places lead capture at the beginning of the visitor experience. This is useful when collecting visitor information is the primary purpose of the Profile Card.

Enable **Open Exchange Contact Form by Default** to display the form as soon as the Profile Card opens. Visitors do not need to select the Exchange Contact button first.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077737599/original/Zac0IMKnyz1iXxf0ZLoO_ClBevXEpVAc9w.png?1785959567)

---

## **How to Set Up a Profile Card QR Code**

#### **Step 1:**Open the QR Code Builder

1. Click **Sites** in the left navigation menu.
2. Click **QR Codes** in the top navigation bar.
3. Click **Create QR Code** in the upper-right corner.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077736980/original/2JOmqUOHsYphSIBdgyXxM1FvyqzFp8RccQ.png?1785958390)**

#### **Step 2:**Configure QR Code Details

1. Enter a recognizable name in the **QR name** field.
2. Select **Profile card** from the available QR types.
3. Click **Next**.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077737022/original/1dEzbzk3RyxX3fGDBIrOXsTRgY3gCPFEEg.png?1785958502)**

#### **Step 3:** Enter Your Profile Information

1. Open the **Info** tab and click **Select** to add a profile picture then select the opacity level (%).
2. Enter your full name, company name, designation, email address, website, phone number, and address as needed.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077737149/original/jVBHDo8jQI2DTcaat-uOK8fTT7CQfhVt-Q.png?1785958707)

#### **Step 4:** Customize the Profile Card Style

1. Open the **Styles** tab and select a cover-image template, or click **Browse** to add a custom image.
2. Adjust the image opacity and choose the page, text, icon, button, and button-text colors.
3. Turn **Show icon label** on or off, then review the card in the live preview.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077737166/original/gEIbPOrJWrWIuE1SG8OMUn1ex94lBlB0rw.png?1785958782)**

#### **Step 5:**Add and Organize Links

1. Open the **Links** tab and select the built-in social platforms you want to display, then enter the corresponding URLs or usernames.
2. Click **Add custom links** to add another destination, enter its name and URL, and choose a matching icon.
3. Use the drag handles to reorder links or the trash icon to remove them, then review the links in the live preview.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077737232/original/uPulLj9FCOi9YTEuWCXnsL3r8F_dCVNE5A.png?1785958933)**

#### **Step 6:** Configure Exchange Contact

Exchange Contact turns your Profile Card into a lead-capture tool by letting visitors submit their own contact information. When they complete the form, a new contact is created in the CRM and contact activity identifies the Profile Card as the lead origin.

1. Open the **Exchange contact** tab and turn on **Exchange contact**.
2. Choose **New form** to create a form for the card, or **Use an existing form** to select a HighLevel form you already created.
3. Click **Edit form** to update the form without leaving the QR Code Builder, then customize the button text as needed.
4. Review the Exchange Contact button and form in the live preview.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077737372/original/2x2uoVdXteTDm5f4d7yOGPG5LP43TUUCew.png?1785959026)

#### **Step 7:** Configure Contact Options

1. Turn on **Open Exchange Contact Form by Default** when the form should appear as soon as the Profile Card opens.
2. Turn on **Automatically Download My Contact Info** when the contact-saving experience should begin automatically.
3. Test both settings on a mobile device before sharing the card. Then click **Next.**

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077737409/original/50dPWTLlW4Jls6Nb2H0Rur72rUm2obGUGQ.png?1785959087)

#### **Step 8:** Customize the QR Code Design

Customize the QR code so it matches your brand while remaining easy to scan. The design tools control the appearance of the scannable code, not the Profile Card page.

1. Customize the QR code’s colors, dots, markers, border, and frame.
2. Add a built-in or custom center logo, adjust the logo background, and choose a page background image with the preferred transparency.
3. Add supporting text, such as “Scan Me” or your name, then choose the font and text color.
4. Once all customizations have been made, click **Save.**

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077737460/original/0_CEnIsbNduLCsTGsNHJL7bdxvQ5-agYLQ.png?1785959200)

#### Step 9: Download or Share the Profile Card

1. Open the saved QR code from **Sites > QR Codes**.
2. Download the QR code in PNG, SVG, or PDF format, or copy the Profile Card’s direct link.
3. Add the QR code or link to email signatures, printed materials, websites, presentations, text messages, or digital campaigns.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077737500/original/zrhjd4C9M3-DPfXa7MKohfXsXmOF9Bhm5A.png?1785959299)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Is Exchange Contact required?**

No. Leave Exchange Contact turned off when visitors only need to view and save your contact information.

**Q: What is the difference between Save Contact and Exchange Contact?**

Save Contact gives the visitor your information. Exchange Contact asks the visitor to submit their information to you through a form.

**Q: Can I use an existing HighLevel form?**

Yes. Enable Exchange Contact and choose **Use an existing form** to select an available form.

**Q: Can I change the Exchange Contact button text?**

Yes. You can rename the call-to-action to better match your branding or intended action.

**Q: Can I add a booking calendar, portfolio, or payment page?**

Yes. Add the destination as a custom link, enter its URL, and choose a matching icon.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [QR Code Generation and Download Guide](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004583)
- [QR Code Builder Redirect Options](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005489)
- [How to Create vCards in the QR Code Builder](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005640)
- [How to Create Custom Business Card QR Codes](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005740)

title_en: HighLevel Meetings: Reusable Links for One-Time & Recurring Calls
source_md:
Video Meetings

# HighLevel Meetings: Reusable Links for One-Time & Recurring Calls

Use a single meeting link for all your sessions — no more creating new URLs, resending invites, or managing expired links.

What You'll Learn

Meetings is HighLevel's native video meeting experience built on reusable links. Instead of generating a new URL for each call, you create one link and use it across multiple sessions — whether that's a single consultation or a year-long coaching series.

This guide covers how reusable links work, the benefits of one-time and recurring meetings, and how to set up a Meeting that your clients or team can join from the same URL every time.

## What is Meetings?

Meetings is HighLevel's native, link-based meeting experience that lets you create a reusable URL for live video sessions, instead of generating a new link every time you meet. It's designed for coaching calls, client check-ins, team huddles, and any recurring touchpoint where you want a simple, consistent way for people to join.

Under the hood, Meetings uses HighLevel's real-time video capabilities (the same foundation that powers Interactive Video Rooms and other live experiences) so hosts and attendees can see, hear, and collaborate in a browser without extra software.

## Key Benefits of Meetings

Understanding the core benefits makes it easier to decide when to use Meetings versus a traditional calendar invite or third-party tool.

**One link, every time** — Share a single meeting URL with clients or team members and reuse it for every session, avoiding confusion with constantly changing links.

**Supports both one-time and recurring sessions** — Use the same experience for a single strategy call or a weekly coaching program, without changing the link from one meeting to the next.

**Ready whenever you are** — Hosts can start a meeting at any time, and attendees join from the same link—no extra configuration or re-creation required.

**Frictionless attendee experience** — Guests simply click the link, wait for the host to start (if they're early), and join instantly once the room opens.

**Clear meeting history** — Past sessions are tracked in one place so you can see when you met, how long sessions ran, and who attended—supporting better follow-up and record-keeping.

**Fewer tools to manage** — Because Meetings is native to HighLevel's video stack, you can rely less on external meeting providers and keep more of your workflow in one system.

## Reusable Meeting Links

Reusable meeting links give you a persistent "room" that can be opened and closed as often as you like, without generating a new URL for each call. This solves one of the biggest sources of meeting friction: guests not knowing which link is the right one.

When you create a Meeting:

- HighLevel generates a single URL you can reuse indefinitely.
- You can share it once with your clients, students, or internal team.
- The same link works for today's call, next week's follow-up, and future check-ins or office hours (as long as you continue to use that meeting space).

In contrast, many calendar-based tools generate a new meeting URL for each occurrence in a recurring series by default, which can lead to multiple different links being used over time. Meetings is intentionally designed to behave more like a persistent room: one address, many sessions.

Practical Examples of Reusable Links

- A coach runs "Client A – Weekly Coaching Room" and sends that one link at onboarding.
- An agency runs "Design Team Standup" and pins the link in Slack or a community.
- A consultant adds the same link into multiple reminder emails, funnels, and automations.

[Screenshot: Example Meetings list showing each meeting name and its reusable link, with an icon to copy the URL.]

## One-Time & Recurring Meetings

One-time and recurring options let you match how you actually work—whether that's a single strategy session or a long-term series with the same group. Meetings applies the same philosophy HighLevel uses for recurring calendars and webinars to live calls.

One-Time Meetings

Single Sessions or Events

Ideal for single consultations, onboarding calls, audits, or special events. You still benefit from a clean, reusable link if you decide to meet again in the future, but you organize it as a single occurrence.

Recurring Meetings

Ongoing Series with One Link

Perfect for weekly syncs, cohort coaching, mastermind groups, or ongoing client retainers. All sessions in the series use the same Meeting link, giving your audience a consistent place to show up—similar to how recurring webinars use one broadcast URL across the series.

By separating the link from the schedule, Meetings lets you update appointment times, adjust cadence, or change reminders without having to regenerate or replace the core URL.

[Screenshot: New Meeting setup panel with options for Meeting Name, Type (One-time vs Recurring), and scheduling details.]

## Start Anytime, Join Instantly

Start-anytime behavior makes Meetings feel less like a fragile calendar invite and more like a dedicated "room" that's always ready when you are.

**Hosts can start at any time** — Open the Meeting from your chosen entry point in HighLevel. There's no strict dependency on a calendar start time before the room can be used.

**Attendees join from the same link** — Participants click the URL and are guided into the live Meeting experience. The underlying video room uses HighLevel's real-time video engine, so multiple participants can collaborate with audio, video, chat, and other interactive controls.

**No repeated configuration** — You don't need to re-set host controls or reconfigure the room each time you meet. As with Interactive Video Rooms, the same environment can be reused call after call.

This Flexibility is Especially Helpful For:

- Ad-hoc check-ins (e.g., "Can we jump into our usual Meeting link?")
- Office hours where the host may start slightly early or late
- Internal teams who want a standing "war room" or daily standup link

## Simple, Frictionless Joining

The joining experience is designed so that both tech-savvy and non-technical users can get into the room with minimal effort.

**Attendees only need the link** — No need to create an account with a third-party tool. No app downloads required when joining from modern browsers, similar to other HighLevel live video experiences.

**Clear state before the host arrives** — If participants click the link early, they'll see clear guidance that the meeting hasn't started yet instead of an error or expired-link message. Once the host starts the Meeting, attendees can join instantly from the same page.

**Consistent expectations** — Because the link doesn't change from session to session, attendees can bookmark it, save it in notes, or pin it in a shared channel.

Tip

You can combine Meetings links with your existing HighLevel tools—for example, sending links via email/SMS campaigns or including them in membership areas and Communities posts where live sessions are expected.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077810726/original/5CAJxXecnGwmS49vpgI0KZHfYQpSyAWJOQ.png?1786026168)

## Track Your Meeting History

Meeting history helps you keep a record of what has already happened so you can follow up effectively, analyze engagement, and maintain an audit trail when needed.

**View past sessions in one place** — See a list of completed sessions tied to a specific Meeting link. Quickly scan which days you met and which sessions ran as scheduled.

**Review session details** — Check high-level information such as session duration and participation. Align this data with your notes, CRM interactions, or billing records.

**Support analytics and compliance** — HighLevel's live-video infrastructure tracks metrics like participant counts and join/leave timestamps, which are used for reporting and resource protection across live video features. Meetings can take advantage of these capabilities to provide more accurate usage and engagement information over time.

This visibility is especially important for recurring programs where you want proof of delivery—for example, coaching packages that promise a certain number of sessions or internal training meetings that need attendance logs.

## Built to Just Work

The main goal of Meetings is to remove the hidden "link management" work that often sits between you and a smooth call.

Key Behavior 1

Links Don't Automatically Expire

Unlike one-time links that are specifically created to be used once and then disabled, Meeting links remain usable for future sessions so long as you keep using that Meeting.

Key Behavior 2

Recurring Meetings Stay Available Long-Term

The same URL works across multiple sessions, so you don't have to recreate or rotate the meeting link every week or month.

Key Behavior 3

Fewer Broken or Outdated URLs

Because the link is persistent, guests are far less likely to click an old calendar invite with a now-invalid URL or end up on an error page because a previous occurrence has passed.

Key Behavior 4

Plays Nicely with Calendars and Policies

You can still use HighLevel calendars, cancellation/reschedule rules, and notifications to manage when people meet with you, while pointing all of those reminders to a single Meeting link. This combination—persistent links plus HighLevel's scheduling tools—gives you both reliability (the room always works) and control (you still decide who can book and when).

## How to Access Your Personal Meeting URL

Every user in HighLevel automatically gets a personal Meeting URL that you can share with clients or team members. This reusable link allows others to join your meetings without needing to create new URLs for each session.

Step 1

Navigate to Account Settings

- In the left navigation menu, go to **Memberships**.
- Click on the Communities tab at the top of the page.
- Select the community where you want to access your meeting settings.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077811158/original/9xH0ead1vvTwZw_lJxgrXRdTKjSiPRtQsg.png?1786026294)

- Click on your profile icon (usually in the bottom-left corner) and select **Profile Settings**.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077811505/original/fKyIn56UoIoHbwpSZTR2-MOSWpvTI6bf9w.png?1786026399)

Step 2

Go to the Meeting Section

- In the Account Settings sidebar, click on **Meeting**.
- You'll see a section titled "Your Meeting URL" with your personal, reusable meeting link.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077811620/original/aPMdq8fGuDSGUMLaPytyzeiXEl6atdIdag.png?1786026453)

Step 3

Copy and Share Your Meeting Link

- Click the **Copy** icon next to your Meeting URL to copy it to your clipboard.
- Share this link with clients, team members, or anyone you want to meet with.
- You can use the same link for all future meetings—no need to generate new URLs for each session.

Tip

Add your personal Meeting URL to your email signature, calendar invites, or automated workflows so clients always have an easy way to join your meetings.

Step 4

View and Manage Your Meeting Recordings

- In the same Meeting section, you'll see a **Recordings** card.
- Click **View recordings** to review and manage recordings from your personal meetings.
- This is helpful for reviewing past sessions, sharing replays with attendees, or keeping records for compliance or training purposes.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077811848/original/GiRSiuWH_m1o4PyosukDiF48g5iFgx6SfA.png?1786026557)

Launch these shortcuts using your iPhone's Action button, Siri, or Spotlight to get assistance whenever you need it.

- [Key Benefits of Ask AI Shortcuts](#Key-Benefits-of-Ask-AI-Shortcuts)
- [Available Ask AI Shortcuts](#Available-Ask-AI-Shortcuts)
- [Requirements and Availability](#Requirements-and-Availability)
- [How to Set Up Ask AI Shortcuts Using the iPhone Action Button](#How-to-Set-Up-Ask-AI-Shortcuts-Using-the-iPhone-Action-Button)
- [How to Launch Ask AI Shortcuts Using Siri](#How-to-Launch-Ask-AI-Shortcuts-Using-Siri)
- [How to Access Ask AI Shortcuts Through Spotlight](#How-to-Access-Ask-AI-Shortcuts-Through-Spotlight)
- [Microphone Permissions and Active Sessions](#Microphone-Permissions-and-Active-Sessions)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What Are Ask AI Shortcuts on iPhone?**

Ask AI iOS shortcuts are built-in actions that let you launch specific Ask AI experiences directly from your iPhone. Instead of opening the mobile app and navigating to Ask AI manually, you can use a shortcut to start a new conversation, dictate a message, or begin a voice interaction.

These shortcuts integrate with supported iOS features, including the iPhone Action button, Siri, and Spotlight. Three shortcuts are available:

- **New Chat:** Opens Ask AI and starts a new conversation.
- **Dictation:** Opens a new Ask AI conversation with the microphone activated for spoken input.
- **Voice Mode:** Opens a new Ask AI conversation in Voice Mode for natural, two-way voice interactions.

The shortcuts can launch the mobile app even when it is not already open. Microphone activation remains subject to the required permissions and access checks.

```
Note: Ask AI iOS shortcuts are different from the existing Ask AI Home Screen Widget and in-app Quick Actions. These features provide additional ways to access Ask AI but have different configurations and available actions.
```

---

## **Key Benefits of Ask AI Shortcuts**

Ask AI shortcuts reduce the steps required to access AI assistance on your iPhone. Whether you need to capture an idea between meetings, dictate an update, or ask a question while multitasking, these shortcuts help you get started faster.

- **Instant Access to Ask AI:** Open a new Ask AI conversation directly from your iPhone without navigating through multiple app screens.
- **Faster Voice Interactions:** Launch Dictation or Voice Mode with the microphone ready for input, provided the necessary permissions are granted.
- **Hands-Free Convenience:** Use Siri to launch Ask AI shortcuts when tapping through your phone is inconvenient.
- **Separate Conversations:** Start fresh conversations for different questions or tasks without returning to the previous chat.
- **Flexible Launch Options:** Access shortcuts through the Action button, Siri, or Spotlight based on your device and preferences.
- **Session Protection:** Existing voice or dictation sessions are protected from interruption when another shortcut is triggered.
- **Permission-Based Access:** Existing Ask AI access controls and microphone permissions continue to apply when using shortcuts.

## 

---

## **How to Set Up Ask AI Shortcuts Using the iPhone Action Button**

Assigning an Ask AI shortcut to your iPhone's Action button provides quick access to your preferred interaction. Once configured, pressing and holding the Action button launches the selected shortcut without requiring you to navigate manually through the mobile app.

Follow these steps to configure the Action button:

**Step 1:** Open the **Settings** app on your iPhone.

**Step 2:** Scroll down and select **Action Button**.

**Step 3:** Swipe through the available Action button options until you reach **Shortcut**.

**Step 4:** Tap **Choose a Shortcut** to open the shortcut selection interface.

**Step 5:** Find **HighLevel**, **LeadConnector**, or your white-label application's name in the available app shortcuts.

**Step 6:** Select one of the following shortcuts:

- **New Chat**
- **Dictation**
- **Voice Mode**

**Step 7:** Return to the Action button settings and confirm that your selected shortcut is assigned.

**Step 8:** Press and hold the **Action button** to launch the shortcut. Depending on your selection, Ask AI opens a fresh chat, activates dictation, or starts Voice Mode.

```
Tip: Choose Dictation or Voice Mode if you regularly use Ask AI through speech. Choose New Chat if you prefer to enter your instructions manually.
```

---

## **How to Launch Ask AI Shortcuts Using Siri**

Siri provides a voice-based way to launch Ask AI shortcuts without assigning them to the Action button. This is useful when you want to access Ask AI without navigating through your phone's screen.

To launch an Ask AI shortcut through Siri:

**Step 1:** Confirm that you are using a supported iPhone with iOS 16.6 or later and an eligible version of the mobile app.

**Step 2:** Activate Siri using your device's supported activation method.

**Step 3:** Speak the shortcut command using the installed application name.

For example:

- **New Chat:** "Start a new chat in HighLevel."
- **Voice Mode:** "Start voice mode in HighLevel."

If you are using LeadConnector or a white-label mobile application, replace HighLevel with the appropriate application name.

**Step 4:** Allow Siri to launch the application and initiate the selected Ask AI experience.

---

## **How to Access Ask AI Shortcuts Through Spotlight**

Spotlight provides another way to find and launch Ask AI shortcuts directly from your iPhone. This option is helpful when you do not have an Action button or prefer searching for an action instead of navigating through the app. To find Ask AI shortcuts using Spotlight:

**Step 1:** Open **Spotlight Search** on your iPhone by swiping down from the middle of the Home Screen.

**Step 2:** Enter the name of the shortcut you want to launch, such as:

- New Chat
- Dictation
- Voice Mode

**Step 3:** Find the matching shortcut associated with HighLevel, LeadConnector, or your white-label app in the search results.

**Step 4:** Tap the matching shortcut to launch Ask AI. The mobile app opens the corresponding Ask AI experience.

```
Tip: Include your application's name in the Spotlight search if multiple shortcuts or apps have similar names.
```

---

## **Microphone Permissions and Active Sessions**

Ask AI shortcuts follow existing application permissions and session protections. Understanding these safeguards helps you know what to expect when starting voice interactions or switching between conversations.

**Microphone Permissions**

Dictation and Voice Mode require microphone access to receive spoken input. If permission has not been granted, the app must complete the applicable permission checks before recording begins.

```
Important: Using a shortcut does not bypass microphone permission requirements or Ask AI account access controls.
```

**Handling Existing Voice or Dictation Sessions**

Ask AI shortcuts are designed to preserve active voice and dictation sessions rather than unexpectedly interrupting them. Although shortcuts normally initiate fresh conversations, triggering another shortcut while a voice or dictation session is already running does not interrupt the existing session.

For more information about managing ongoing voice conversations, see [How to Use Ask AI Voice Mode](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008022-how-to-use-ask-ai-voice-mode).

**New Conversations and Chat History**

Launching a new Ask AI conversation keeps the new discussion separate from an existing chat. Previous conversations remain available through Ask AI Chat History. Starting a fresh conversation does not mean deleting previous chats or clearing saved Ask AI memory.

For more information, see [Ask AI Multi-Threading: Run Multiple Tasks at Once](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008420-ask-ai-multi-threading-run-multiple-tasks-at-once).

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I use Ask AI shortcuts without an iPhone Action button?**

Yes. You can launch Ask AI shortcuts using Siri or Spotlight on supported iPhones running iOS 16.6 or later.

**Q: Why can't I find Ask AI shortcuts in my iPhone settings?**

Confirm that the mobile app is updated to version 4.27.0 or later and that Ask AI is enabled for your account. Check that you are selecting shortcuts from the correct installed application. If you use a white-label app, verify that its installed build supports the feature.

**Q: Can I assign all three Ask AI shortcuts to the Action button?**

The Action button supports one selected action at a time. You can change which Ask AI shortcut is assigned by returning to **Settings → Action Button → Shortcut** and selecting a different shortcut. The other shortcuts remain accessible through supported alternative launch methods.

**Q: What happens if I launch a shortcut when HighLevel is closed?**

The shortcut can open the installed mobile app and initiate the selected Ask AI experience, subject to the required authentication, permission, and access checks.

**Q: Will starting a new conversation delete my previous Ask AI chats?**

No. Starting a new conversation does not delete your previous Ask AI chat history. You can access earlier conversations through Chat History.

**Q: Why doesn't Dictation or Voice Mode activate my microphone?**

The app may not have permission to access your microphone. Check microphone access in your iPhone settings and verify that Ask AI is available for your account. If another application is using your microphone, check for an audio-input conflict.

**Q: Can I use Ask AI shortcuts in a white-label mobile application?**

Yes. The feature supports eligible white-label mobile applications running version 4.27.0 or later, provided Ask AI is enabled. The application's name may appear instead of HighLevel when selecting or invoking shortcuts.

**Q: Are Ask AI iOS shortcuts the same as the Ask AI Home Screen Widget?**

No. iOS shortcuts can be launched through the Action button, Siri, or Spotlight and provide New Chat, Dictation, and Voice Mode actions. The Ask AI Home Screen Widget is a separate feature that provides Chat, Voice, and Camera actions directly from the Home Screen.

---

title_en: Labs Features - Complete Overview
source_md:
HighLevel Labs gives users early access to new and evolving features, so you can test changes, share feedback, and prepare teams before features reach general availability. This guide explains where to find Labs, how toggles work, who can enable them, how to assign sub-accounts, and how to submit feedback. 

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Labs?](#What-is-Labs?)
- [Key Benefits of Labs](#Key-Benefits-of-Labs)
- [Agency Labs vs Sub-Account Labs](#Agency-Labs-vs-Sub-Account-Labs)
- [How to Interpret Labs Features](#How-to-Interpret-Labs-Features)
- [Visibility vs Enablement Controls (Sub-Account Labs features)](#Visibility-vs-Enablement-Controls-(Sub-Account-Labs-features))
- [How To Use Labs](#How-To-Use-Labs)
- [Submit Feedback](#Submit-Feedback%C2%A0)
- [Labs Changes Are Auditable](#Labs-Changes-Are-Auditable)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Labs?**

Labs is HighLevel’s early-access program where selected features can be turned on before they’re released to everyone. Features in Labs may change as development continues, and your feedback helps shape final behavior and timelines. Labs includes items that apply to Agency accounts and items that apply to sub-accounts.

Understanding Labs helps you evaluate upcoming changes in a controlled way. By enabling features in a test environment, validating impact, and sending feedback, you reduce risk during rollouts and influence product direction.

---

## **Key Benefits of Labs**

These benefits focus on how Labs improves your day-to-day operations, speeding up your ability to adopt improvements while safeguarding production sub-accounts.

- **Early Access:** Try upcoming features before general release to plan processes and training.
- **Targeted Rollout:** Enable only for selected sub-accounts to run controlled pilots.
- **Faster Feedback Loops:** Send direct feedback (with screenshots/video) to inform product improvements.
- **Change Readiness:** Update SOPs and assets ahead of General Availability to minimize disruption.
- **Risk Reduction:** Validate behavior, performance, and compatibility before enabling for all clients.

---

# **Agency Labs vs Sub-Account Labs**

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078738152/original/xfONxxcQO7ElvvuuzJYNyp_uwrj8f2_6bQ.png?1787082800)**

|  | **Agency Labs** | **Sub-Account Labs** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **What does it affect?** | Agency-level features and, when applicable, features assigned to selected sub-accounts. | Only the current sub-account. Other sub-accounts are not affected. |
| **Who can enable it?** | Agency Owners and Agency Admins. | Sub-Account Admins and Agency users with the appropriate access while working inside the sub-account. |
| **Where do I find it?** | **Agency View → Settings → Labs**. Use the **Agency**or **Sub-account** tab depending on the feature. | **Sub-Account View → Settings → Labs**. |
| **How is the feature enabled?** | Agency-only features can be toggled on from the **Agency** tab. For assignable sub-account features, use the **Sub-account** tab and **Manage** to select the applicable sub-accounts. | Supported features can be toggled on directly within the current sub-account. Some features may first require access or visibility to be granted by the Agency. |
| **Can I control which sub-accounts receive a feature?** | Yes. For supported sub-account Labs features, Agency Owners/Admins can use **Manage** to control visibility and/or enablement for selected sub-accounts. | No. Changes made here apply only to the sub-account you are currently viewing. |
| **When should I use it?** | Best for centralized control, testing a feature across selected sub-accounts, and managing broader rollouts. | Best for testing or enabling a feature for one specific sub-account without affecting others. |

---

## **How to Interpret Labs Features**

Every Labs feature appears as a “card.” Knowing each element helps you enable features confidently and communicate timelines to stakeholders.

Each card commonly includes:

1. **Title:** Feature name.
2. **Description:** What changes or capabilities the feature provides.
3. **Live in X Days:** Estimated days until general availability (subject to change).
4. **Toggle ON/OFF:** Enable/disable the feature in the current context.
5. **Submit Feedback:** Send comments, issues, or requests directly to the product team.
6. **Change Log URL:** Access release details.
7. **Support Doc URL:**Help and documentation on the feature.
8. **Media URLs:** Visuals, demos, or walkthroughs

```
Note: Labs features are still being tested and refined, so their functionality, design, availability, or release timeline may change. If a feature card shows Live in X Days, it indicates the estimated time remaining before the feature is expected to become generally available. This timeline is an estimate and may change.
```

  

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/0gA5RjVESCtDpTToTXj8+/Universal+Agency+Inc+2025-09-03+at+10.28.06+PM.png)

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155069648640/original/0L6wpFM4AezlWtlId086mJoUzNGo8Cwg8w.png?1776804278)

**Agency Labs Exclusive**

- **Manage:** (Agency → Sub-account tab only, when applicable) – Assign the feature to specific sub-accounts.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/G7WaAIaZJgWyuuoDjPqY+/Universal+Agency+Inc+2025-09-03+at+10.39.32+PM.png)

---

## **Visibility vs Enablement Controls (Sub-Account Labs features)**

Labs controls use two different settings:

1. Visibility: Whether a Labs feature appears in Sub-account view → Settings → Labs.
2. Enabled: Whether the feature is turned ON for that sub-account.

```
Important: Unlimited and Pro Plans support visibility and enablement defaults and per-sub-account visibility and enablement management. 
Starter Plan keeps Labs features visible by default and does not show visibility or enablement controls.
```

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155064178284/original/_lyXouZNCWkLXYkZks0wq-x1eYYU5ZnzTg.png?1770209216)

A feature can be visible but not enabled. This helps you introduce features for discovery without activating them.

### **Default visibility and overrides (Agency view)**

On eligible plans, agency admins can:

- Set the default visibility for new Labs features (Visible or Hidden).
- Override visibility per sub-account when needed.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155064178404/original/wqn04XHF8YfLS1E0hD2MYYxjlvgCmPlOkw.png?1770209281)

---

## **How To Use Labs**

Using Labs in the correct workspace is essential. Agency view exposes Agency-level features and tools for assigning sub-account features, while sub-account view shows features you can enable locally.

### **1:** Enable an Agency‑only feature (Agency view)

1. Login to your**Agency**account**.**
2. Navigate to **Settings** → **Labs** → **Agency** **tab**.
3. Locate the feature card and review the **Description** and **Release** **Timeline**.
4. Toggle **ON**.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/txIBztOpI4GLQo1U1lUA+/GIF+Recording+2025-08-12+at+12.03.52+AM.gif)

### **2:** Enable a Sub‑account feature via Agency assignment

```
Note: Some sub-account features must be granted by the Agency before they can be used. The Manage control lets Agency Admins/Owners choose which sub-accounts get early access.
```

1. Login to your **Agency** account.
2. Go to **Settings** → **Labs** → **Sub-account** tab.
3. Locate the feature card and review the **Description** and **Release** **Timeline**.
4. Click **Manage** and **select the sub-account(s)** to give access for Visibility and/or Enable.
5. Click **Save**.
6. Switch to the assigned sub-account(s) and refresh the relevant area to confirm the feature appears and/or is Enabled.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155064179682/original/ypYnjb8wnXAoH9HBaTUlEcCaU15WlA0ACw.gif?1770209920)

### **3:** Enable a Sub‑account feature directly

Some sub-account features can be enabled directly within the sub-account without Agency assignment.

1. In the target sub-account, open **Settings** → **Labs**.
2. Find the feature card and toggle **ON**.
3. Refresh or re-open the relevant module (builder, CRM, etc.) to see changes.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/5KUEORHRlnYiDNfFANZw+/GIF+Recording+2025-08-12+at+12.16.19+AM.gif)

---

## **Submit Feedback**

Feedback provided from Labs goes straight to the product team, helping prioritize fixes and improvements. High-quality feedback accelerates outcomes for everyone.

To submit feedback:

1. Click on **Settings**(Agency or sub-account).  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/MiaKBmexb4ZQb4Rlwcqz+/Screen+Shot+2025-08-12+at+12.28.49+AM.png)
2. Click on**Labs.**
3. On the relevant feature card, click **Submit Feedback**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/DXKBF80DUqjfywcUkzFE+/Screen+Shot+2025-08-12+at+12.30.48+AM.png)
4. Add a **Subject** and a **clear Message.**
5. Optionally upload **screenshots** or **videos** to illustrate your use case or issue.
6. Click **Submit**.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/nK7g4skJbDR3xcsDLQco+/Screen+Shot+2025-08-12+at+12.36.20+AM.png)

---

## **Labs Changes Are Auditable**

Changes to Labs feature flags are now recorded in **Audit Logs**. This includes updates made at the company level, location level, and through Support Portal tools.

Use Audit Logs when you need to confirm when a Labs feature was changed, who changed it, or whether the update came from Support Portal.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Who can access Labs?**All Agency Admins and Sub-account Admins, plus any users who have the **View & Manage Settings** permission.
