**Q: Is the fee the same for every domain?**A: Not always. Pricing can vary depending on the registrar, registry, domain extension, and recovery requirements.

**Q: What is the typical redemption fee amount?**A: A common range may be about $44 to $50 at some registrars like Cloudflare, while HighLevel’s standard fee is typically around $55.50. Final costs may vary.

**Q: Do I also need to pay for renewal?**A: In some cases, yes. Recovery during redemption may involve both a redemption fee and the standard renewal cost.

**Q: Does paying the fee guarantee recovery?**A: Recovery is often possible during the redemption window, but it remains time-sensitive and depends on the domain still being eligible for restoration.

**Q: What happens if I do not recover the domain in time?**A: The domain may be deleted and could become available for someone else to register, which may result in permanent loss of the domain.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [How to Purchase Domain Step by Step](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003610)
- [Configure & Connect Purchased Domains](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004674)
- [Enable & Rebill Domain Purchase in HighLevel SaaS Mode](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003454)
- [Domains - Transfer-In Process](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006329)
- [Connecting Your Domain on HighLevel - A Guide](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005132)
- [LC Domain: Multiple Year Domain Purchase](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005705)

title_en: How to use the Inbound Webhook Workflow Premium Trigger
source_md:
[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/1wxkzYS3vPI?&wmode=opaque)

Inbound Webhooks enable seamless CRM integration by allowing external systems to automatically send data using various HTTP request methods like GET, POST, and PUT. This real-time data transfer capability enhances CRM functionality and streamlines workflows, facilitating efficient communication and collaboration across various platforms and tools.

```
- Agencies on Any Plan  ($97, $970, $297, $2970, $497, $4970) can access LC Premium Triggers & Actions.  
  
- Once Premium Actions & Triggers are enabled via the Agency settings, EXISTING and New Sub-Accounts will have 100 free executions.  
   
- For agencies to avoid accruing execution costs for EXISTING Sub-Accounts, rebilling will need to be enabled manually for each Sub-Account within the Agency view (more info).   
  
- If premium actions are enabled on the SaaS Configurator, new Sub-Accounts generated will automatically be enrolled in LC Premium Actions & Triggers, no further action is required by the agency.
```

#### **Covered in this Article**

#### [**What is an Inbound Webhook?**](#What-is-an-Inbound-Webhook?)

#### [What are some excellent usage cases for this?](#What-are-some-excellent-usage-cases-for-this?)

#### [**How to use the Inbound Webhook Workflow Trigger?**](#How-to-use-the-Inbound-Webhook-Workflow-Trigger?)

#### [Step 1](#Step-1)

#### [Step 2](#Step-2)

#### [Step 3](#Step-3)

#### [In your communication Actions:](#In-your-communication-Actions%3A)

#### [In If/Else Actions:](#In-If/Else-Actions%3A)

#### [Important points to be considered:](#Important-points-to-be-considered%3A)

---

## **What is an Inbound Webhook?**

An Inbound Webhook is a robust feature that facilitates the automatic data transfer from external systems to your CRM, improving integration and interoperability. When an event occurs in an external system, an HTTP request (POST, GET, or PUT) is sent to a specific URL linked to a trigger within your CRM, initiating a workflow. This real-time data transfer capability enhances your CRM's functionality and streamlines workflows across various platforms and tools.

By leveraging Inbound Webhooks, businesses can automate processes, reduce manual tasks, and minimize human error, increasing efficiency and productivity. Furthermore, it enables better collaboration between teams, as critical data is readily available and synchronized between different systems. This seamless integration ultimately improves decision-making, customer satisfaction, and business performance.

### **What are some excellent usage cases for this?**

Inbound Webhooks can be used in various scenarios to enhance CRM functionality and automate workflows. Here are a few practical usage cases with examples:

**eCommerce Order Integration:**

Suppose you have an online store and want to update your CRM with new order information when a customer orders. You can set up an Inbound Webhook in your CRM to receive data from your eCommerce platform whenever a new order is created.

Example: Your eCommerce platform sends an HTTP POST request to the webhook URL with order details such as customer name, email, phone number, and order value. Your CRM then creates or updates the customer's contact information and adds the order details to their record.

**Customer Support Ticketing System Integration:**

Your company may use a separate support ticketing system to handle customer issues. When a customer creates a support ticket, you can use an Inbound Webhook to send the ticket details to your CRM, ensuring the support team has all the necessary information.

Example: Your support ticketing system sends an HTTP POST request to the webhook URL with the ticket details, including customer email, ticket title, and description. Your CRM then associates the ticket with the corresponding customer record, allowing your support team to access the ticket information directly from the CRM.

**Event Registration Integration:**

If you host events and use an event registration platform, you can use an Inbound Webhook to send attendee registration information to your CRM.

Example: Your event registration platform sends an HTTP POST request to the webhook URL with attendee information such as name, email, phone number, and event name. Your CRM then creates or updates the attendee's contact information and adds the event registration details to their record, allowing your event team to manage and communicate with attendees effectively.

**Lead Capture from Web Forms:**

Inbound Webhooks can capture leads from web forms on your website or landing pages and send the data to your CRM.

Example: When a visitor submits a form on your website, your web form sends an HTTP POST request to the webhook URL with the lead's information, such as name, email, and phone number. Your CRM then creates a new lead or updates an existing contact, allowing your sales team to follow up with the lead promptly.

These are just a few examples of how Inbound Webhooks can automate workflows, streamline processes, and enhance CRM functionality in different business scenarios.

## **How to use the Inbound Webhook Workflow Trigger?**

Briefly, bring your data to the system in 3 simple steps using the Inbound Webhook Trigger.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48296396414/original/5xlRF80hbq19hXS2IeQjhZ5GlPK6xGxPLQ.png?1683557063)

#### **Step 1**

Retrieve the webhook URL and use it in your application or system. Next, send the data to the webhook URL using the appropriate HTTP request method (POST, GET, or PUT) and click the "Test Trigger" button.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48296396436/original/IlVVYc7eyGT9KdCkdq9wlbT68qjQH71BzA.jpeg?1683557066)

#### **Step 2**

Choose the data received from your application or system using the supported HTTP request method (POST, GET, or PUT) and save it as sample data for future reference. Click on "Load More" to view additional recent data. Once you've selected the desired data, save the trigger.

In this step, you can save the data reference for custom variables, which can be treated similarly to other contact custom fields or Location Custom Variables.

The next step and examples below provide more information on utilizing this reference.

Step 2.1: Send a supported HTTP request (POST, GET, or PUT) to the copied webhook URL and copy the ID in the response.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48296396447/original/HBssN92Dcn7RELV0WfeiQvdzyYoVWnZesA.jpeg?1683557067)

Step 2.2: Copy the unique ID obtained from the supported HTTP request (POST, GET, or PUT) and use it to search for the relevant mapping reference within your webhook trigger.

Please note that the most recent request will always be at the top of the list.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48296396689/original/1GOfBLW8pVhtm0-4jBOU-djexnqbxJUQhg.gif?1683557143)

Step 2.3: Select the correct reference and verify the body.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48296396424/original/jE6MPEf9WpVPFFQ0ahHfacR6JsSdqJRmyQ.png?1683557064)

### 

#### **Step 3**

You will be directed to the "Create Update Contact" action after saving the trigger. "Create Update contact From there, you can select the necessary fields and map the incoming data you received from the trigger. Please note that to create a new contact or map data to an existing one, you must provide either an email or phone field. If your trigger data is not carrying email or phone you can remove this action from workflow and workflow will continue to execute contactless.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48296396430/original/dLt6e4aBJ-RSHELvUaJx6MD8J6i5jOaOKw.jpeg?1683557066)

---

By completing the above steps, you can now use the data you received within the workflow as custom values in email, sms, if/else, etc.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48296396440/original/WDyICG5QVeEo1X5iv-AAmEjLhl6HhJKn1Q.png?1683557067)

---

**Example:**

The custom values of Inbound Webhook can be utilized in all of the actions within your workflow. Some examples of how to do this are provided below.

### **In your communication Actions:**

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48296396872/original/Y_f4vN7W6D0Af8UpHCCStiQq-BLwJiMb0g.gif?1683557198)

#### **In If/Else Actions:**

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48296396946/original/HMKEQnrIHJvwPHaAiEUA2z2sjFgjgBELvA.gif?1683557230)

As shown above, you can use the values from the Inbound Webhook inside all other actions as you see fit.

## **Can workflow execute without contact?**

- Workflow can run contactless without any Contact data dependency so you can send any payload data via Inbound Webhook Triggers and use it in workflow.
- You can proceed without contact and use actions that are not dependent on contact information. Custom Webhook, Google Sheet, Slack, ChatGPT and all Internal Tools can be executed without contact.
- If necessary, you can use the Create/Update or Find Contact actions to retrieve the contact data to the workflow.  
    
  **Example:**
- Send order data via inbound webhook and add the order information to google sheet, use if/else to categorize based on order value and send a slack notification.
- Retrieve the contact with Contact ID using Find contact action

---

#### Important points to be considered:

- Always send the request using a supported method (POST, GET, or PUT) when interacting with the webhook.
- Ensure the data is sent as a JSON object, the only supported data format.
- To compile correctly, keys must be a single string without space separations; consider using CamelCase or snake\_case instead of separating key names with spaces.
- Providing an Email or Phone number in the payload is mandatory, as the workflow requires contact information. An Email or Phone is required to Find or Create the Contact.
- List or array values received through an Inbound Webhook can be used in supported workflow text fields when the workflow detects the list in the current execution context. Selecting a list from the Custom Value picker opens the list formatter, where you can choose a field to extract and how the values should be displayed.
- If your data structure changes, re-select the Mapping Reference inside the Inbound Webhook Trigger setup to address those fields in other actions correctly.
- If your Inbound Webhook Trigger URL gets compromised or leaked and you want to prevent unwanted requests, Delete the existing Inbound Webhook Trigger and Add a New Inbound Webhook Trigger. A new URL with a different ending ID will be generated; update your integrations to match the new URL. Once saved, incoming requests from the old URL won't enter your workflow; only requests from the new URL will.

title_en: How to Submit and Track Port-In Number Requests
source_md:
Porting lets you transfer existing US phone numbers from another carrier into HighLevel so you can manage calling and messaging from one place.

Agency Owners and Admins can submit eligible port-in requests directly in HighLevel, upload the required documentation, and track each request through the Port-In Numbers dashboard.

```
Important: This feature is available only to Agency Owners and Agency Admins through Labs.
```

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Port-In Numbers in HighLevel?](#What-is-Port-In-Numbers-in-HighLevel?)
- [Key Benefits of Port-In Numbers](#Key-Benefits-of-Port-In-Numbers)
- [Before You Start](#Before-You-Start)
- [Auto-Generated Letter of Authorization](#Auto-Generated-Letter-of-Authorization)
- [How To Setup Port-In Numbers](#How-To-Setup-Port-In-Numbers)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)

---

## **What is Port-In Numbers in HighLevel?**

Port-In Numbers allows eligible agencies to request the transfer of existing US phone numbers from an external carrier into HighLevel. Once submitted, the request can be tracked inside the Phone Numbers section, giving agency teams a centralized place to monitor carrier review, progress, completion, or rejection.

Porting is useful when a business wants to keep an existing phone number while managing calls, SMS, and related phone activity through HighLevel’s Phone System. The new in-app workflow reduces manual steps by collecting request details inside HighLevel, generating the LOA automatically, and showing status updates without requiring users to leave the platform.

---

## **Key Benefits of Port-In Numbers**

The in-app Port-In Numbers workflow simplifies the porting experience by replacing manual form submission with a guided request flow. This helps agencies prepare cleaner requests, reduce back-and-forth, and stay informed as carriers process the transfer.

- **In-app Submission:** Submit eligible US port-in requests directly from Phone System → Phone Numbers.
- **Guided Request Flow:** Complete the request through a structured four-step process that collects acknowledgements, number details, contact information, and documents.
- **Auto Generated LOA:** HighLevel creates the Letter of Authorization from the request details and sends it to the authorized representative for digital signature.
- **Simpler Document Requirements:**Upload only the billing statement, as a PDF or image file up to 10 MB.
- **Bulk Number Support:**Enter multiple landline numbers in a comma-separated format and add multiple wireless numbers using + Add New Number.
- **Inline Status Tracking:**Track each request from the Port-In Numbers tab, including status, Request SID, created date, and carrier action details.
- **Reduced Support Dependency:**Eligible agencies can submit and monitor US port-in requests without relying on a separate form.

---

## **Before You Start**

Preparing accurate carrier and account information before starting the request helps prevent delays or rejections. Carriers review port-in requests against the account details they have on file, so mismatched information may cause the request to be rejected.

Before submitting a port-in request, prepare the following:

- Current carrier account number
- Landline numbers being ported, entered as comma-separated values when submitting multiple numbers
- Wireless numbers being ported
- Wireless PIN or last four digits of SSN, when required
- Authorized representative name
- Authorized representative email address
- Full service address, including state and postal code
- Billing statement as a PDF or image file
- Billing document file size of 10 MB or less

Keep the numbers active with the current carrier until the port is fully completed. Canceling service too early may interrupt the transfer or cause the request to fail.

---

## **Auto-Generated Letter of Authorization**

The Letter of Authorization confirms that the authorized representative approves the phone number transfer. HighLevel now generates the LOA from the request details, reducing manual document preparation and helping users avoid uploading an incorrect LOA.

After the request is submitted:

1. HighLevel generates the LOA using the request details.
2. The LOA is emailed to the authorized representative.
3. The authorized representative signs the LOA digitally.
4. The porting process continues based on carrier review and approval.

Users should confirm that the authorized representative has access to the email address entered in the request. If the LOA is not signed, the port request may not move forward.

```
The authorized email address is important because HighLevel sends the auto-generated Letter of Authorization to that representative for digital signature.
```

---

## **How To Setup Port-In Numbers**

Proper setup ensures that the request is submitted with complete carrier details, a valid billing statement, and the correct authorized representative. Reviewing each step before submission helps reduce delays and improves the chance of a successful port.

Follow these steps to submit a port-in request:

1. Log in as an Agency Owner or Agency Admin.
2. Confirm the feature is enabled through Labs.  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155073461895/original/dAXDniOb1hUSi_fvI6rfoUeTubaT45HE_A.png?1781179829)
3. Go to Phone System → Phone Numbers.  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155073462036/original/IYW_1qoRXQK876IOrFhP279-pDw3V8JUPQ.png?1781179944)
4. Click Add Number to add numbers to the system.  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155073462156/original/XORNAEB-9trzfthEAPgDnH-7gQf9x0yZ8g.png?1781180034)
5. Select Port-in Numbers.  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155073462436/original/zXgu09tdwwbYMm9I06GWuDPJR9SGolTCTA.png?1781180210)
6. Review and complete the Agreement Checklist.  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155073462637/original/FKrxhZqa6nM0RiLDiTAWH10_osYdyzmIBQ.png?1781180289)
7. Enter the carrier account number. Add the landline numbers, wireless numbers, or both. Add wireless PIN or last four digits of SSN where required.  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155073462808/original/9eFIzI3R0fMVW90yioAsekGNpm6QHKXpmw.png?1781180387)
8. Enter the port request name, if needed. Select Residential or Business. Enter the authorized contact name and email address. Enter the full service address, state, and postal code.  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155073463317/original/hdquQ0y_LSEWPWOVVH1kLD_u5gHIMTgm8w.jpeg?1781180658)
9. Upload the billing statement as a PDF or image file up to 10 MB. Review the request details. Submit the request.  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155073463479/original/e-KGDTv6MFuRqUInNN-xJFzPGWf2VRCLng.png?1781180715)
10. Copy or save the Request SID from the confirmation modal.  
      
      
    ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155073463637/original/JnyqR-bp8G5yHWkXUYCViwoGN9JZi_2Sfw.png?1781180776)
11. Ask the authorized representative to check their email and sign the LOA.
12. Track the request from Phone Numbers → Port-In Numbers.

After submission, HighLevel displays a confirmation modal with the Request SID. The request also appears in the Port-In Numbers tab, where status updates are shown as the carrier processes the request.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can sub-account users submit port-in requests?**

No. The in-app Port-In Numbers workflow is currently available only to Agency Owners and Agency Admins.

**Q: Can I port multiple numbers in one request?**Yes. Landline numbers can be entered as comma-separated values, and multiple wireless numbers can be added using + Add New Number.

**Q: What document do I need to upload?**  
Upload the billing statement only. The file can be a PDF or image and must be 10 MB or less.

**Q: Should I cancel my current carrier service after submitting the request?**  
No. Keep the numbers active with the current carrier until the port is fully completed.

**Q: Where can I track my port-in request?**  
Go to Phone System → Phone Numbers → Port-In Numbers to view request history, status, Request SID, created date, and carrier action details.

**Q: What does Rejected mean?**

A rejected request could not continue through the porting process. Common causes include a service address that does not match the current carrier's records, an incorrect account number, an invalid wireless PIN, an unsigned Letter of Authorization (LOA), a suspended carrier account, or invalid billing documentation.

Rejected requests cannot be edited. Review the rejection reason in the **Port-In Numbers** tab, verify the correct information with the current carrier, then delete the rejected request and submit a new one with the corrected details.

**Q: What should I do after the port is completed?**

Confirm that the number appears in the correct HighLevel location and test inbound and outbound calling. If you plan to use SMS or MMS, test messaging and confirm that any applicable messaging registrations are complete.

US local numbers may require the appropriate A2P 10DLC registration, while toll-free numbers may require Toll-Free Verification before messaging. Keep the previous carrier active until the port is confirmed complete and the number is working as expected

**Q: How long does a port-in request usually take?**

Porting timelines vary by carrier and request complexity. Current HighLevel guidance indicates that external carrier ports involving fewer than 50 numbers generally take approximately 2–4 weeks after the required documentation is submitted. Larger or more complex ports may take approximately 6–8 weeks.

Carrier processing times can vary, so do not cancel service with your existing carrier until the transfer is confirmed complete.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Porting Options: US In-App vs International Manual Process](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001211919)
- [Moving Phone Numbers: Migration Guide](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006369)
- [Moving Phone Numbers across accounts (US and International)](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001240107)
- [Moving Numbers across Sub-Accounts (Same Agency)](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001203968)
- [Phone System Pricing & Billing Guide](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001223556)
- [Overview of Phone Number Configuration Options](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001229976)

title_en: How to Use the Client Portal File Uploaded Workflow Trigger
source_md:
HighLevel’s **Client Portal File Uploaded** workflow trigger helps businesses respond automatically when a contact submits a document through the Client Portal. Use it to acknowledge uploads, notify team members, create review tasks, or begin the next stage of an onboarding or approval process. This removes the need to monitor contact records manually and helps document-based processes move forward without unnecessary delays.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is the Client Portal File Uploaded Workflow Trigger?](#%E2%80%8B%E2%80%8BWhat-is-the-Client-Portal-File-Uploaded-Workflow-Trigger?)
- [Key Benefits of the Client Portal File Uploaded Workflow Trigger](#Key-Benefits-of-the-Client-Portal-File-Uploaded-Workflow-Trigger)
- [How Client Portal File Uploads Work](#How-Client-Portal-File-Uploads-Work)
- [Supported File Types](#Supported-File-Types)
- [Share a File with a Client Through the Client Portal](#Share-a-File-with-a-Client-Through-the-Client-Portal)
- [Upload a File as a Client Portal User](#Upload-a-File-as-a-Client-Portal-User)
- [How to Set Up the Client Portal File Uploaded Workflow Trigger](#How-to-Set-Up-the-Client-Portal-File-Uploaded-Workflow-Trigger)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

## **What is the Client Portal File Uploaded Workflow Trigger?**

The Client Portal File Uploaded workflow trigger starts a workflow when a contact uploads a file through the Shared Documents experience in the Client Portal. The uploaded file is connected to the contact’s CRM record, allowing teams to manage the document and coordinate follow-up from one location.

After a client completes an upload, the workflow can run actions such as sending a confirmation, notifying an internal user, creating a task, updating a contact, or moving an opportunity forward. Uploaded files remain accessible under **Contacts → Documents → Received → Client Portal**.

---

## **Key Benefits of the Client Portal File Uploaded Workflow Trigger**

- **Eliminate manual monitoring:** Start the appropriate workflow as soon as a contact submits a file instead of repeatedly checking the contact record.
- **Reduce processing delays:** Notify reviewers or create internal tasks immediately after documents arrive.
- **Improve client communication:** Send an automatic acknowledgment or next-step message after an upload.
- **Support faster onboarding:** Begin the next onboarding or approval stage without waiting for a team member to identify the new document.
- **Prevent missed submissions:** Use workflow actions to make uploaded documents visible to the appropriate team members.
- **Create consistent processes:** Apply the same review and follow-up steps to every qualifying Client Portal upload.

---

## **How Client Portal File Uploads Work**

Understanding the upload flow helps you identify the event that starts the workflow and locate the file after the automation begins.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155076273038/original/ZV5PphxelSm2kbVPd3sbo4TcPYDhCNl7KQ.png?1784305031)

---

## **Supported File Types**

Using a supported format helps ensure the client’s document uploads successfully and can be stored on the contact record.

The Client Portal supports the following document and image formats:

**Documents**

- PDF: `.pdf`
- Microsoft Word: `.doc`, `.docx`
- Microsoft Excel: `.xls`, `.xlsx`
- Microsoft PowerPoint: `.ppt`, `.pptx`
- Plain Text: `.txt`
- Rich Text Format: `.rtf`

**Images**

- JPEG: `.jpg`, `.jpeg`
- PNG: `.png`
- GIF: `.gif`

Video formats such as MP4, MOV, AVI, MKV, and WMV are not supported for Client Portal document uploads.

---

## **Share a File with a Client Through the Client Portal**

Sharing a document from the contact record can provide the client with instructions, a checklist, or a reference file before they submit their own documents. This creates a centralized exchange instead of relying on email attachments or separate file-sharing tools.

**To share a new file with a client:**

1. Go to **Contacts**. Select the particular contact.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155076271046/original/RRSODHNr7g25MIabJLVKMImKlc5YiHjE7A.png?1784303629)
2. Open the contact’s **Documents** area.
3. Click the option to add or upload a new file.
4. Select the file from your device.
5. Enable **Shared Documents on Client Portal** or the available Client Portal sharing option. Save the file.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155076271108/original/bNxGiNDAlGw9xPL6i28e3Fi2ZiaM4AGaiA.gif?1784303665)

**To share an existing file:**

1. Locate the file in the contact’s Documents area.
2. Click the three-dot menu. Select **Share to Client Portal**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155076271638/original/9Th6Zx3pGTkdOI9i-dF-oHs_JZ0izuOhyw.png?1784303931)
3. Confirm the sharing action.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155076271664/original/mo6swdgW6bkVthbOGMu8zt8HA98A-ME2Pg.png?1784303950)

The shared file becomes available to the contact in the Client Portal’s Shared Documents area.

For additional file-sharing and management instructions, see [How to Share and Manage Documents via Client Portal and CRM](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005199-how-to-share-and-manage-documents-via-client-portal-and-crm-).

---

## **Upload a File as a Client Portal User**

The client must upload the file from the Client Portal for the action to match the Client Portal File Uploaded event. Reviewing the client experience also helps you provide accurate instructions when requesting documents.

1. Log in to the Client Portal.
2. Click **+ Add Files** in **Shared Files**section.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155076271784/original/xP4mRYyjl8WuficptF3ZQ_Q4P9FbNeqi4A.png?1784304027)
3. Select one or more supported files from the device. Click **Upload**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155076271854/original/XazaHEFX8fIPNcjR0Czp3g3LQuAitroEPQ.png?1784304067)

```
Note: The client can select up to 10 files in one upload. After the upload completes, the file becomes available under the contact’s received Client Portal documents and the workflow trigger fires automatically.
```

---

## **How to Set Up the Client Portal File Uploaded Workflow Trigger**

A published workflow is required to respond to live Client Portal uploads. Configure the trigger and follow-up actions, then complete a live test using a contact who has access to the Client Portal.

1. Confirm that the contact you plan to use has access to the Client Portal and can open the **Documents** or **Shared Documents** area.
2. Navigate to **Automation → Workflows**. Click **Create Workflow**, or open an existing workflow.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155076272156/original/_ZFk0nu60dLe0_To7S8yHwT09Fl1JtJHXw.png?1784304267)
3. At the beginning of the workflow, click **Add New Trigger**. Search for and select **Client Portal File Uploaded**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155076272212/original/td8ViNZ9tbyYk7yPSQLJYCbt3UU1nXmudw.png?1784304318)
4. Complete any trigger settings / filters needed
5. Click the plus button beneath the trigger to add the action that should occur after the upload.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155076272413/original/25H4Fbk1NIw7FstmQwTC7N9-LinDQEEqwQ.png?1784304471)

   Common options include:
   - Send an email or SMS confirming that the file was received.
   - Send an internal notification to the appropriate team member.
   - Create a task for document review.
   - Add a tag such as **Documents Received**.
   - Update a contact field used to track document status.
   - Update an opportunity or move it to the appropriate pipeline stage.
   - Send information to another system through a webhook.
6. Add any additional actions, waits, or conditions required by your process.  
     
   For example:

   - Notify an onboarding specialist when intake documents arrive.
   - Create a review task for an application or approval process.
   - Update a project or opportunity after a client submits requested assets.
   - Begin a renewal process when updated documents are uploaded.
7. Save the workflow.

A live Client Portal upload is the most reliable way to test the complete process because it validates the trigger, document storage, and follow-up actions together.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: How is Client Portal File Uploaded different from the Documents & Contracts trigger?**

Client Portal File Uploaded responds to a file submitted by a contact through the Client Portal’s document-upload experience. The Documents & Contracts trigger responds to lifecycle events for HighLevel documents and contracts, such as when a document is sent, viewed, signed, completed, or declined.

**Q: Does sharing a file from the CRM start this workflow?**

The trigger is designed for files uploaded by contacts through the Client Portal Shared Documents experience. Sharing a file from the CRM makes it available to the client but is a separate document-sharing action.

**Q: Should I use Test Workflow or perform a live upload?**

A live upload from a test contact is recommended because it verifies the Client Portal event, document storage, and workflow actions together.

**Q: Where can I troubleshoot a workflow that did not run?**

Open the workflow and review **Execution Logs** and **Enrollment History**. Also confirm that the workflow is published, the contact has Client Portal access, the file type is supported, and the upload completed successfully.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Upload Documents Through the Client Portal](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008172-upload-documents-through-the-client-portal)
- [How to Share and Manage Documents via Client Portal and CRM](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005199-how-to-share-and-manage-documents-via-client-portal-and-crm-)
- [How to Set Up the Client Portal](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000000193-how-to-set-up-the-client-portal-)
- [Getting Started with Workflows](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000002288-getting-started-with-workflows)
- [Workflow Builder Walkthrough](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000001254-workflow-builder-walkthrough)
- [Workflow Trigger – Documents & Contracts](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000001491-workflow-trigger-documents-contracts)

title_en: Build with AI for Voice AI Flows
source_md:
Voice AI · Flow Builder

# Build with AI for Voice AI Flows

Create and edit Voice AI conversation flows through natural language chat. Describe the experience you want, and Build with AI generates optimized flow graphs in minutes.

What You'll Learn

Build with AI transforms how you create Voice AI experiences in HighLevel. Instead of manually connecting nodes and configuring actions, you describe what you want your Voice AI to do, and Build with AI generates the complete flow graph for you.

This article explains what Build with AI is, its key capabilities, how to use it to create or modify flows, and includes ready-to-build use cases for common business scenarios.

## What is Build with AI?

Build with AI is an intelligent assistant within HighLevel's Flow-Based Builder that allows you to create and modify Voice AI conversation flows using natural language. Instead of manually dragging nodes and configuring actions, you simply describe the Voice AI experience you want to create through chat, and Build with AI generates the complete flow graph for you.

Whether you're starting from scratch or updating an existing flow, Build with AI helps you go from idea to implementation in minutes. The AI understands Voice AI-specific requirements, asks clarifying questions when needed, and creates flows optimized for voice interactions.

Build with AI is purpose-built for Voice AI experiences and understands the capabilities available in Flow-Based Builder, including native actions, Knowledge Base integrations, Web Search, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and other supported tools.

## Key Capabilities

Build with AI combines natural language understanding with deep knowledge of Voice AI workflows to deliver powerful flow creation capabilities.

**Action & Tool Aware** — Build with AI understands the capabilities available in Flow-Based Builder and intelligently orchestrates supported actions and tools, including native actions, Knowledge Base, Web Search, MCP, and more.

**Designed for Voice AI** — Unlike generic AI builders, Build with AI is purpose-built for voice experiences. It understands the nuances of Voice AI conversations and generates flows optimized for voice interactions.

**Powered by AI** — The AI understands your requirements, asks follow-up questions when needed, and creates a build plan for your review before generating the flow.

**Review Before You Apply** — Preview the generated graph, request changes if needed, and apply it to your canvas only when you're satisfied with the result.

**Create or Edit Existing Graphs** — Start from scratch to build a completely new flow, or modify an existing graph—all through chat.

**Understands Your Workflow** — There are no fixed templates or predefined architectures. Build with AI understands your unique workflow requirements and generates a graph that matches your desired conversation logic and business process.

## How Build with AI Works

Build with AI follows a collaborative process to ensure you get exactly the Voice AI flow you need. The workflow includes understanding your requirements, creating a build plan, generating the flow, and allowing you to review before applying.

Step 1

Describe Your Requirements

You chat with Build with AI and describe the Voice AI experience you want to create. Explain what the Voice AI should do, what information it should collect, and how it should respond to different scenarios.

Step 2

AI Asks Follow-Up Questions

If needed, Build with AI asks clarifying questions to better understand your workflow requirements. This ensures the generated flow matches your specific business process and conversation logic.

Step 3

Review the Build Plan

Build with AI creates a build plan outlining the flow structure, actions, and conversation logic it will implement. You can review this plan and request changes before the flow is generated.

Step 4

Preview the Generated Graph

Build with AI generates the complete flow graph based on your requirements and the approved build plan. You can preview the generated graph and see all nodes, connections, and configurations.

Step 5

Apply to Canvas

Once you're satisfied with the generated flow, apply it to your canvas. Build with AI adds the flow to your Flow-Based Builder workspace where you can further customize it or immediately start using it.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077254718/original/ze7nQgVVjhWGjDw4-fbQ1dF426gMdhfY-w.png?1785420175)

## How to Use Build with AI

Build with AI is integrated directly into the Flow-Based Builder interface with a split-screen layout that makes it easy to describe your requirements and see the generated flow in real time.

Understanding the Interface

The Build with AI interface features a two-panel layout:

**Left Panel (Chat)** — The conversational interface where you describe your Voice AI requirements, review build plans with checkmarks showing completed steps, and interact with the AI to refine your flow.

**Right Panel (Canvas)** — The visual flow builder where you see the generated graph with all nodes, connections, and routing logic. You can zoom, pan, and inspect nodes before applying the flow to your workspace.

### Creating a New Flow

When creating a new flow, describe the Voice AI experience you want to build in the chat panel. Be specific about what the Voice AI should do, what information it should collect, and how it should handle different caller scenarios. Build with AI will generate a complete flow graph that appears in the canvas panel for your review.

Pro Tip

The more specific you are in your description, the better Build with AI can match your requirements. Include details about caller types, information to collect, decision points, and what actions to take based on caller responses.

### Editing Existing Flows

To modify an existing flow, describe the changes you want to make in the chat panel. You can add new capabilities, modify conversation logic, update actions, or restructure parts of the flow. Build with AI understands your current flow and applies the requested changes while preserving the rest of your configuration.

### Reviewing and Applying Your Flow

After Build with AI generates your flow:

- Review the build plan in the chat panel (marked with green checkmarks when approved)
- Examine the flow graph in the canvas panel to see all nodes and connections
- Click on individual nodes to inspect their configurations and actions
- Request changes through the chat if you want to modify the flow
- Apply the flow to your workspace when you're satisfied with the result

Remember

The flow is not applied to your workspace until you explicitly choose to apply it. You can preview, request changes, and iterate as many times as needed before committing the flow to your canvas.

Build Smarter

Turn Ideas into Voice AI Flows in Minutes

Build with AI understands your workflow requirements and generates optimized conversation flows—no manual node configuration required.

## Ready-to-Build Use Cases

Build with AI can create Voice AI flows for a wide range of business scenarios. Below are common use cases you can describe to Build with AI to quickly generate functional flows for your business.

Use Case

Dental Office

Answer clinic FAQs, identify emergency versus routine calls, transfer urgent callers to the right team, and send office information via SMS after hours.

Use Case

Home Services Business

Collect the service type and ZIP code, determine serviceability, update the contact record, and trigger an estimate workflow automatically.

Use Case

SaaS Sales Line

Qualify callers based on company size and use case, tag the contact, and route enterprise prospects directly to the sales team.

Use Case

Agency & Support Desk

Answer common questions using your Knowledge Base, identify whether the issue is billing or technical support, and transfer callers to the appropriate team.

Use Case

Healthcare & Clinics

Schedule appointments, answer frequently asked questions, capture patient information, and seamlessly hand off complex inquiries to staff.

Use Case

Real Estate

Qualify buyers and sellers, collect property requirements, answer listing questions, and trigger follow-up workflows for your sales team.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Can Build with AI modify existing flows, or only create new ones?

Build with AI can both create new flows from scratch and modify existing flows. When editing an existing flow, describe the changes you want to make, and Build with AI will apply those updates while preserving the rest of your flow configuration.

Q: What actions and tools can Build with AI use in generated flows?

Build with AI understands all capabilities available in Flow-Based Builder, including native actions, Knowledge Base integrations, Web Search, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and other supported tools. It intelligently orchestrates these actions based on your workflow requirements.

Q: Do I have to accept the flow as generated, or can I request changes?

You can request changes at any point in the process. After reviewing the build plan or the generated flow graph, you can ask Build with AI to make modifications. The flow is only applied to your canvas when you explicitly choose to apply it.

Q: How does Build with AI understand Voice AI-specific requirements?

Build with AI is purpose-built for Voice AI experiences and trained to understand the nuances of voice conversations. It generates flows optimized for voice interactions, including appropriate conversation logic, response handling, and caller experience patterns specific to voice communication.

Q: Does Build with AI use templates, or does it create custom flows?

Build with AI does not use fixed templates or predefined architectures. It understands your unique workflow requirements and generates a custom graph that matches your specific conversation logic and business process. Each flow is tailored to your described requirements.

Q: Can I manually edit a flow after Build with AI creates it?

Yes. Once Build with AI applies a flow to your canvas, it becomes a standard Flow-Based Builder flow that you can manually edit, customize, or expand using the visual flow editor. You have full control to make any additional changes after the AI generates the initial flow.

Q: What happens if Build with AI asks follow-up questions?

If Build with AI needs more information to accurately create your flow, it asks clarifying questions in the chat. Answer these questions to help Build with AI better understand your workflow requirements. This ensures the generated flow matches your specific business process and conversation logic.

Q: How do I access Build with AI?

Build with AI is available directly within the Flow-Based Builder interface. Access it from your Flow-Based Builder workspace to start creating or modifying Voice AI flows through the chat interface.

title_en: How to Provide Feedback on Ask AI Responses
source_md:
Ask AI feedback helps HighLevel understand which responses are helpful and which ones need improvement. By rating individual Ask AI answers with thumbs up or thumbs down, users can share clear feedback while they work. When feedback is specific and constructive, it gives HighLevel better signals to improve Ask AI’s accuracy, instruction following, response quality, and overall usefulness.

This article explains how Ask AI feedback works, when to use thumbs up or thumbs down, how to provide additional feedback about a response, and how to review feedback you previously submitted.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Ask AI Feedback?](#What-is-Ask-AI-Feedback?)
- [Key Benefits of Ask AI Feedback](#Key-Benefits-of-Ask-AI-Feedback)
- [When to Use Thumbs Up or Thumbs Down](#When-to-Use-Thumbs-Up-or-Thumbs-Down)
- [How Feedback Applies to Full Ask AI Responses](#How-Feedback-Applies-to-Full-Ask-AI-Responses)
- [Adding Reasons and Comments](#Adding-Reasons-and-Comments)
- [How To Provide Feedback on Ask AI Responses](#How-To-Provide-Feedback-on-Ask-AI-Responses)
- [Best Practices for Constructive Feedback](#Best-Practices-for-Constructive-Feedback)
- [Frequently Asked QuestionsQ: Can I update or clear my feedback after submitting it?](#Frequently-Asked-QuestionsQ%3A-Can-I-update-or-clear-my-feedback-after-submitting-it?)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Ask AI Feedback?**

Ask AI feedback is a rating system that lets users evaluate individual Ask AI responses inside a conversation. Users can select **thumbs up** when a response is helpful or **thumbs down** when a response does not meet expectations.

Feedback is tied to a single Ask AI answer. If that answer includes text plus structured content, such as a card, table, diagram, or artifact, the rating applies to the full response. This helps HighLevel understand the quality of the complete answer rather than only one part of it.

After rating a response, users can provide additional details about their rating. Thumbs up feedback can include an optional reason explaining what worked. Thumbs down feedback can include a reason explaining what was wrong and an optional note with more details.

---

## **Key Benefits of Ask AI Feedback**

- **Better Response Quality:** Feedback helps identify answers that are useful, accurate, and aligned with user expectations.

- **Clearer Improvement Signals:** Reason selections and comments help explain why a response missed the mark.

- **Support for Rich Responses:** Ratings apply to the full Ask AI response, including related text, cards, diagrams, tables, or artifacts.

- **More Accurate Product Improvements:** Feedback gives HighLevel clearer insight into response issues such as accuracy, tone, instruction following, or unnecessary refusals.

- **Easy Correction:** Users can update or clear their feedback if they change their mind.

- **Faster In-Workflow Feedback:** Thumbs controls let users share feedback directly inside the Ask AI conversation without leaving the chat.
- **Persistent Feedback:** Submitted ratings stay connected to the response when users return to the conversation, making it easy to review feedback they already provided.

---

## **When to Use Thumbs Up or Thumbs Down**

Choosing the right feedback option helps HighLevel understand whether an Ask AI response was successful or needs improvement. Use thumbs up when the response was helpful, and use thumbs down when the response missed the mark or needs correction.

|  |  |  |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Feedback Option** | **Use When the Response…** | **Example** |
| **Thumbs Up** | Answered your question clearly Followed your instructions Used the right tone or format Provided accurate and useful information Helped you complete the taskIncluded helpful structure, such as steps, lists, or tables Produced a useful artifact, card, or diagram | You ask Ask AI to create a follow-up email, and the response is accurate, well-written, and ready to use with minimal edits. |
| **Thumbs Down** | Was inaccurate  Did not follow your instructions  Missed important context  Was off-topic  Used the wrong tone  Was too vague or incomplete  Refused when it should have helped  Produced an artifact or structured output that did not match the request | You ask Ask AI for a professional email, but it creates a casual social media caption. Select thumbs down and choose a reason related to instruction following or relevance. |

After selecting a rating, provide additional feedback when available. For thumbs up, you can optionally indicate what worked well. For thumbs down, select the reason that best describes the issue and add a note when more context would help explain the problem.

---

## **How Feedback Applies to Full Ask AI Responses**

Ask AI responses may include more than plain text. A single answer can include written content, structured cards, tables, diagrams, artifacts, or follow-up text that belongs to the same response.

When you rate an Ask AI response, your feedback applies to the full answer. This means you are rating the complete response experience, not just one sentence, card, or visual element.

For example:

- If Ask AI provides an explanation and a table, the rating applies to both.

- If Ask AI generates a diagram with supporting text, the rating applies to the full answer.

- If Ask AI returns a card or artifact as part of the response, the rating applies to that complete response.

This helps keep feedback connected to the full context of what Ask AI provided.

---

## **Adding Reasons and Comments to Feedback**

Reasons and comments make negative feedback more useful. A thumbs down rating tells HighLevel that something was wrong, but reasons and comments help explain what should be improved.

When selecting thumbs down, users can choose one or more reasons. These options may vary based on the product experience and language settings.

Helpful comments should be short, specific, and focused on the issue.

Helpful negative feedback examples:

- “The answer ignored my request to keep the email under 100 words.”

- “The response used the wrong contact name.”

- “The steps were missing the setup step for permissions.”

- “The tone was too casual for a legal client.”

- “The table was helpful, but the dates were incorrect.”

Less helpful feedback examples:

- “Bad.”

- “Wrong.”

- “Did not like it.”

- “Fix this.”

Constructive comments help HighLevel better understand what happened and what a better response should have included.

---

## **How To Provide Feedback on Ask AI Responses**

You can rate an Ask AI response directly from the conversation without leaving the chat.

1. Open Ask AI and review the response you want to rate.  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081848623/original/nsgMWQ280UB3nfG8czjaoJrOQdKxbkr8yQ.jpeg?1790331741)

2. Select the thumbs up icon if the response was useful or the thumbs down icon if the response did not meet your expectations.

3. If you select thumbs up, you can optionally provide additional feedback about what worked well.

4. If you select thumbs down, select the reason that best describes the issue and add an optional note if you want to provide more context.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081848656/original/GD0CpLlysB7vFRnxHeC0yCoXAG-ce6k7rg.jpeg?1790331759)

5. Submit your feedback.

```
You can provide feedback on Ask AI responses when using Ask AI from either the Agency or Sub-Account view. Feedback applies to the response you rated, regardless of which view you used to access Ask AI.
```

  

### **Review Previously Submitted Feedback**

Your rating stays connected to the Ask AI response after you submit it. When you return to the conversation, the response continues to show that it has already been rated.

You can open a previous rating to review the feedback you submitted. Ask AI does not ask you to rate the same response again after feedback has already been submitted.

---

## **Best Practices for Constructive Feedback**

Use these best practices when leaving feedback:

- Be specific about what was wrong.

- Mention whether the issue was accuracy, tone, format, relevance, or instruction following.

- Include the expected outcome when possible.

- Keep comments short and focused.

- Rate the full response, including any artifacts or structured content.

- Use thumbs up when Ask AI gets it right, not only thumbs down when something is wrong.

- Update or clear feedback if your opinion changes.
- When giving positive feedback, select the option that best describes what worked when additional feedback is available.

**Example of constructive feedback:**

“The response was helpful overall, but it did not follow my request to format the answer as a checklist.”

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Why do some Ask AI conversations not show feedback controls?**  
Feedback is available in new Ask AI conversations created after the feature release. Older conversations may not show thumbs up or thumbs down controls.

**Q: Can I change my rating after submitting it?**  
Yes. You can update your feedback by choosing a different rating.

**Q: Does feedback immediately change the next Ask AI response?**  
No. Feedback helps HighLevel identify where Ask AI responses are helpful or need improvement, but ratings do not necessarily change the next response in the same conversation.

**Q: Should I leave thumbs up feedback too?**  
Yes. Positive feedback helps identify responses that are accurate, helpful, and aligned with user expectations.  
  
**Q: Can I update or clear my feedback after submitting it?**

Yes. You can change your rating or clear your feedback if you selected the wrong option, changed your mind, or no longer want to rate that response.

**Q: Will my rating still appear if I return to the conversation?**

Yes. After you rate an Ask AI response, the rating stays connected to that response when you return to the conversation. You can open the previous rating to review the feedback you submitted.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [Overview of Ask AI Assistant](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005327)
- [Ask AI Artifacts and Mermaid Diagrams in HighLevel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007812-using-ask-ai-artifacts-and-mermaid-diagrams-in-highlevel)
- [How to Generate and Edit Images Using Ask AI](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005764-how-to-generate-and-edit-images-using-ask-ai)
- [Conversational Editing of Content with Ask AI](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005765-conversational-editing-of-content-with-ask-ai)
- [Thumbs Up/Down Feedback for Content AI](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005517-thumbs-up-down-feedback-for-content-ai)

title_en: Manage Service Appointments in the Appointment Modal
source_md:
Manage Service bookings more efficiently with the Appointment modal. Review booking details, edit and duplicate appointments, generate reschedule links, create blocked slots, and view assigned resources. You can also review intake forms attached during Service booking creation.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What Is the Appointment Modal for Service Appointments?](#What-is-the-Appointment-Modal-for-Service-Appointments?)
- [Key Benefits of Managing Service Appointments](#Key-Benefits-of-Managing-Service-Appointments)
- [How to Access the Appointment Modal](#How-to-Access-the-Appointment-Modal-for-Service-Appointments)
- [View a Submitted Service Booking Form](#View-a-Submitted-Service-Booking-Form)
- [Generate and Copy a Reschedule Link](#Generate-and-Copy-a-Reschedule-Link)
- [Edit Service Appointments](#Edit-Service-Appointments)
- [Duplicate Service Appointments](#Duplicate-Service-Appointments)
- [Blocked Slots on Your Service Calendar](#Blocked-Slots-on-Your-Service-Calendar)
- [Show Resource in Appointment Modal](#Show-Resource-in-Appointment-Modal)
- [Use Custom Values in Service Notifications](#Use-Custom-Values-in-Service-Notifications??)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What Is the Appointment Modal for Service Appointments?**

The Appointment modal is the side panel where admins and staff review and take action on a single Service booking. It centralizes essential tasks such as editing details, rescheduling, duplicating appointments, and reviewing submitted booking forms so teams can maintain accurate calendars with less back-and-forth.

---

## **Key Benefits of Managing Service Appointments**

Managing appointment details from one place helps staff respond to scheduling changes and review customer information without navigating through multiple screens.

- **Speed:** Edit and reschedule Service appointments without leaving the page.
- **Control:** Block unavailable time from the booking workflow.
- **Scalability:** Duplicate bookings for repeat or similar clients.
- **Form visibility:** Review intake form submissions attached when Service bookings were created.

---

## **How to Access the Appointment Modal for Service Appointments**

Opening a Service appointment displays its Booking Details side panel, where you can review information and use the available appointment actions.

1. Go to **Calendars → Calendar View** (or **Appointment List View**) and select **Services**.

![Calendars menu showing how to open Calendar View for Service appointments](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084556058/original/zErCmaHPv9E13YsTKVPiqadVflmHq1jKCA.png?1793336761)

2. Click an appointment to open **Booking Details** in the side panel (the Appointment modal).

![Booking Details side panel for a selected Service appointment](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084555959/original/1epvOS5fDj6Apcxo5C3BKaHzm3IqvaZPfg.png?1793336589)

---

## **View a Submitted Service Booking Form**

When a form is attached while creating a Service booking, its submitted responses can be reviewed from Booking Details. This allows your team to access customer intake information alongside the saved appointment.

1. Go to **Calendars → Calendar View** and select **Services**.
2. Select the saved Service appointment to open **Booking Details**.
3. Click the form icon in the booking details panel to open **Form submission**.
4. Review the submitted answers.

![Service Booking Details displaying the attached form submission and customer responses](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084553858/original/jwzTo6uFUfoK6vCGKnz0RGyd4owWinuOnw.png?1793330343)

**Important:** A form must be attached during booking creation. You cannot attach a form to an existing booking or edit its submitted form afterward.

---

## **Generate and Copy a Reschedule Link**

Use the appointment's reschedule link when you want the customer to choose a new time themselves. You can generate the link directly from an existing Service appointment and share it through your preferred communication channel.

1. Open the **Service appointment**.
2. Click **Appointment Actions**.
3. Select **Generate Reschedule Link**.
4. After the link is generated, click **Copy Link**.
5. Share the link with the customer.

The customer can open the shared link and use the existing rescheduling flow to choose a new appointment time.

---

## **Edit Service Appointments**

Editing options depend on whether payment has been collected. Unpaid appointments allow more changes, while paid appointments restrict structural edits to protect the existing booking and payment details.

### **Edit Unpaid Appointments**

Users can modify unpaid Service appointments directly from the edit screen without canceling or rebooking. This makes it easier to handle last-minute requests, corrections, or changes.

Supported changes include:

- Add or remove **Services**.
- Add or remove **Add-Ons**.
- Change **Staff** or **Service Variants**.
- Change the **Location**, appointment title, date/time, timezone, or coupon codes.

To edit an unpaid Service appointment:

1. Select the appointment you want to edit, then click the **pencil** icon to open the editor.

![Edit button in the Service appointment modal](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084556126/original/ehVF_-mdtnkjbXODYYkJKwYRRXpPdQRSCw.png?1793336850)

2. Adjust the applicable services, add-ons, staff/variant, location, title, date/time, timezone, or coupon codes, then click **Save**.

![Edit unpaid Service appointment screen showing available appointment fields](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155064119010/original/cCZClATqPysQRMMvk3_aaIk4G2Zyp2Rz3A.png?1770140560)

### **Enhanced Support for Paid Appointments**

Paid appointments remain locked for structural changes, such as changing the service or staff. You can duplicate an appointment to create a new booking, adjust its details, and rebook without starting from scratch.

The edit screen displays a message explaining which details can and cannot be changed.

---

## **Duplicate Service Appointments**

Duplicating a booking helps you quickly create a repeat or similar Service appointment by carrying over the existing details instead of entering them again.

The **Duplicate Appointment** button is available in the Appointment modal. Open the appointment you want to duplicate, then select the **Duplicate** icon. Review and adjust the copied details before completing the new booking.

![Duplicate Service appointment control in the Booking Details panel](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084556112/original/TXsLc-VzgsiiA8MegMSxunyd9O9uuWgccA.png?1793336819)

---

## **Blocked Slots on Your Service Calendar**

Blocked slots let you mark time as unavailable, keeping your calendar accurate and helping prevent accidental bookings.

To create a blocked slot:

1. Click **New Booking** in your calendar.

![New Booking action for creating a blocked slot](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084556055/original/-NchWUgfUri2SCT2HoB26Kg3KftdwR17Nw.png?1793336753)

2. Switch **Event Type** to **Blocked Slot**.

![Event Type selector with Blocked Slot selected](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155064119381/original/n-Jf9wQYrMhdQ3LjBKzuXe086l_HvNeZ3A.png?1770140952)

3. Select the date/time, title, and staff, then click **Block Time**.

![Blocked Slot form showing time and staff options](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155064119444/original/pDXeA17Ua3DUSRqDP4QlULzoxoP9hSjA1A.png?1770141018)

---

## **Show Resource in Appointment Modal**

The Appointment modal displays the resource assigned to a Service booking. Seeing the booked resource helps your team understand which person or resource has been reserved and avoid confusion about allocation.

![Resource information displayed in a Service appointment modal](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084556032/original/UP_E_3nf6D2nGX2iWGRgznoQIArc0CRvTw.png?1793336724)

---

## **Use Custom Values in Service Notifications**

Custom values let you include relevant booking details in customer confirmations, reminders, and other notifications without entering the information manually each time.

Two custom values are available for calendar notifications:

- **Service Booking Price**
- **Meeting Location Name** (short label instead of the full address)

To use these values:

1. Go to **Calendars → Calendar Settings → Notifications**.
2. Open the notification template (confirmation, reminder, etc.).
3. Insert **Service Booking Price** or **Meeting Location Name** from the merge field picker.
4. Save and test the notification.

![Service notification template showing available custom values](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155064119604/original/B80PfHsuKgrj_7P9Hq56wv6Aop-IiAMHLQ.png?1770141210)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I change the staff or service after payment is collected?**

Structural edits (services, add-ons, staff/variant, coupon, title, location) are locked on paid bookings. Reschedule the date/time or use **Duplicate Appointment** to rebook with changes.

**Q: What carries over when I duplicate an appointment?**

Contact, services, add-ons, staff/resource, meeting location, and notes typically carry over. Adjust anything needed before booking the copy.

**Q: Does rescheduling a paid appointment change the existing order or payment?**

No. The payment remains associated with the original booking.

**Q: Can I attach a form to a Service appointment after it has been created?**

No. Forms can only be attached during booking creation. If a form was attached, you can review its submitted responses from **Booking Details**, but you cannot add or edit a form afterward.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [Attach Forms to In-App Service and Rental Bookings](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009518-attach-forms-to-in-app-service-and-rental-bookings)
- [How To Create Service Calendars](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000001159)
- [Calendar View for Rentals](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006641)
- [Troubleshooting Tool for Calendar](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003358)
- [Payments Tab in Calendars](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006098)

title_en: Workflow Trigger - User Replied
source_md:
The User Replied trigger fires whenever a user (member of your team), sends a message to a contact. Use it to measure how quickly your team responds, stop automations once a person steps in, log outbound activity, and route conversations based on who replied and where. This article shows how to setup and use the User Replied trigger in Workflows.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is the User Replied Trigger?](#What-is-the-User-Replied-Trigger?)
- [Key Benefits of Using the User Replied Trigger](#Key-Benefits-of-Using-the-User-Replied-Trigger)
- [How to Use the User Replied Trigger in Workflows](#How-to-Use-the-User-Replied-Trigger-in-Workflows)
- [Trigger Filters](#Trigger-Filters)
- [Replied By: The Grouped User Picker](#Replied-By%3A-The-Grouped-User-Picker)
- [Channel Behavior](#Channel-Behavior)
- [Custom Values](#Custom-Values)
- [Use Cases](#Use-Cases)
- [Setting Up SLA Tracking and Escalation](#Setting-Up-SLA-Tracking-and-Escalation)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is the User Replied Trigger?**

The User Replied trigger starts a workflow when someone on your team sends a message to a contact from the conversation view. It is built around reply and response activity, and it fires on two kinds of messages a user sends:

- **A new outbound message.** A user sends the first message to a contact, for example when a contact comes in through a form and a rep reaches out.
- **A reply in an existing thread.** A contact has messaged in, and a user answers within that conversation

```
Important: This trigger fires only on messages a user sends from the conversation view, and only once that message is delivered, not the moment it is sent. Messages sent by workflow actions (Send SMS, Send Email, and so on) or by Conversation AI do not fire it. For automation based on Conversation AI, use the separate Conversation AI Trigger, which fires on a condition you define rather than on a specific message.
```

---

## **Key Benefits of Using the User Replied Trigger**

- **Track response times:** Capture the moment a rep responds to a contact so you can measure how fast your team replies.
- **Stop automations when a person takes over:** End a drip or nurture sequence as soon as a team member replies personally, so a contact never receives an automated message and a human message at the same time.
- **Build "wait and check" flows:** Pair the trigger with the User Replied wait condition to cover the classic pattern where a contact messages in, you wait a few minutes, and if nobody has replied you alert the owner.
- **Route by who replied and where:** Branch a workflow based on the sending user, the contact's assigned user, or the channel the message went out on.
- **Act on what was said:** React when a rep's message contains a phrase like "refund approved" by moving the opportunity, sending a confirmation, or applying a tag.
- **Log activity:** Record every outbound reply, or keep fields like "Last Contacted By" and "Last Contact Date" up to date.

---

## **How to Use the User Replied Trigger in Workflows**

1. Log in to your account.
2. Go to **Automations > Workflows**.
3. **Create** a new **workflow** or **edit** an **existing** one.
4. Click **+ Add New Trigger**, then select **User Replied** from the list (under **Events**).  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/1fHp8adcptdb0ypSPekL+/GIF+Recording+2026-07-10+at+20.29.33.gif)
5. Enter a clear **Trigger Name** so it is easy to find later, for example "Rep Replied (SLA Timer)".
6. Click **+ Add Filters** to narrow when the workflow should run. If you add no filters, the trigger fires on every user reply, to any contact, on any channel.
7. Click **Save Trigger**.
8. Add your workflow actions, such as Add Tag, Send Email/SmS, Assign to User, Send Internal Notification, or Update Opportunity, etc, then **Publish** the workflow.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/eLWFJFDk9rjFbG13oaXN+/GIF+Recording+2026-07-10+at+21.38.48.gif)

---

## **Trigger Filters**

Filters let you control which user replies should start the workflow. You can combine several of them to get as specific as you need.

| Filter | Operator | Values | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Sent By | Is any of | Grouped user picker (see below) | Multi-select. Pick the contact's assigned user and/or specific users. |
| Message Channel | Is any of | SMS, Email, WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, Instagram DM, Live Chat | Select one or more channels to match. Some channels offer additional channel-specific options. |
| Contains Phrase | Contains | Free text (case-insensitive) | Runs only when the message includes the words or phrases you specify. Supports several comma-separated phrases. |
| Exact Match Phrase | Equals | Free text (case-insensitive) | Runs only when the message matches exactly. Whitespace is trimmed before comparing. |
| Has Tag | Has any of | Tag picker | Runs only if the contact has the selected tag. |
| Doesn't Have Tag | Has none of | Tag picker | Runs only if the contact does not have the selected tag. |

#### 

#### **Replied By: The Grouped User Picker**

The **Replied By** filter is a single, searchable, multi-select dropdown with two kinds of options:

- **User assigned to the Contact.** This dynamic option always sits at the top. Use it when you only want the trigger to fire if the contact's own assigned user replies.
- **Users.** Every available user, listed by name.

```
Note: If you do not add a Replied By filter, the trigger fires when any user replies.
```

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/9No5ot74hueMwhSbLob9+/Screen+Shot+2026-07-10+at+21.45.31.png)

---

## **Channel Behavior**

The trigger works across all the main conversation channels. Because each channel threads its conversations a little differently, what counts as a brand new outbound message versus a reply can vary. The table below shows how that works on each channel.

| Channel | New Outbound | Reply to Existing |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Email | User writes a new email, where a new subject line starts a new thread | User replies inside an existing email thread |
| SMS | First SMS to a contact who has no prior messages | Any later SMS in the ongoing thread |
| WhatsApp | User starts with a template message, outside the 24-hour window | User replies inside the 24-hour service window |
| Facebook Messenger | First message to a contact with no prior conversation | Any later message in the ongoing thread |
| Instagram DM | First DM to a contact with no prior conversation | Any later DM in the ongoing thread |
| Live Chat | Not applicable, since the visitor always starts the session | User replies inside an active session |

Email is the only channel where a user can keep several separate threads going with the same contact. On single-thread channels like SMS, Messenger, and Instagram DM, every message simply adds to one continuous conversation.

---

## **Custom Values**

The trigger makes the following values available inside your workflow actions and If/Else conditions. Use them to personalize notifications, log activity, and route conversations.

| Name | Custom Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| User Name | `{{user_replied.senderName}}` | Name of the user who sent the message |
| User ID | `{{user_replied.userId}}` | Internal user ID of the sender, which is more reliable than the name for external integrations |
| Message Body | `{{user_replied.messageBody}}` | The content of the message |
| Channel | `{{user_replied.channel}}` | The channel the message was sent on, such as SMS, Email, or WhatsApp |
| Timestamp | `{{user_replied.timeStamp}}` | When the message was sent |
| Conversation ID | `{{user_replied.conversationId}}` | The conversation or thread ID |
| User Email | `{{user_replied.senderEmail}}` | Email address of the user who sent the message |

---

## **Use Cases**

**Keyword-Based Routing**

- Trigger: User Replied
- Filter: Contains Phrase set to "refund approved"
- Actions: Move the opportunity to a new pipeline stage and send a confirmation.

**Log Outbound Activity**

- Trigger: User Replied
- Actions: Update "Last Contacted By" with `{{user_replied.senderName}}` and "Last Contact Date" with `{{user_replied.timeStamp}}`, or record the reply somewhere outside the platform.

---

## **Setting Up SLA Tracking and Escalation**

Response-time SLAs are the most common reason to reach for this event. If you want to make sure a rep replies within a target time and escalate when they do not, you build that with the User Replied event as a **Wait** condition and a **Goal**, rather than with the trigger on its own.

The pattern looks like this:

1. Start the workflow with the event that begins the clock, such as Customer Replied, so it runs when a contact messages in.
2. Add a **Wait** step set to the **User Replied** condition, with a timeout such as five minutes.
3. On the timeout branch, where no user replied in time, add your escalation actions, such as notifying the owner or manager, creating a task, or sending an internal alert.
4. To stop a reminder or nurture sequence as soon as a rep replies, add a **User Replied** goal so the contact jumps out of the remaining steps.

```
Note: The Wait condition and the Goal are set up in their own steps. For the full walkthrough, see the Workflow Action - Wait and Workflow Action - Goal Event articles.
```

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Do messages sent by a workflow fire this trigger?**

No. Automated messages from workflow actions such as Send SMS or Send Email do not fire it. Only a message a user sends from the conversation view counts.

**Q: Will it fire on cold or mass outbound outreach?**

Not reliably. The trigger is built around replies and responses, not cold first-touch outreach.

**Q: Can I fire only when the contact's assigned user replies?**

Yes. Add a **Sent By** filter and choose "User assigned to the Contact".

**Q: What happens if a user sends several messages quickly?**

Each message fires the trigger on its own, unless re-enrollment is restricted on the workflow.

**Q: What if a contact is enrolled in more than one workflow?**

The trigger fires independently in each workflow.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [Workflow Trigger - Customer Replied](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000002677-workflow-trigger-customer-replied)
- [Workflow Trigger - Inbound Email](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007650-workflow-trigger-inbound-email)
- [Workflow Action - Wait](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000002470-workflow-action-wait)
- [Workflow Action - Goal Event](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000003328-workflow-action-goal-event)

title_en: Mandatory 2FA for Phone Number Updates
source_md:
HighLevel now requires two‑factor authentication (2FA) whenever a user’s phone number is changed. This aligns phone updates with the existing email change + 2FA flow, closes a high‑risk account‑takeover path, and improves overall security. This article explains how it works, who it affects, and how to complete verification using Email, SMS (to an existing verified number), or an Authenticator App (TOTP).

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is 2FA for Phone Number Updates?](#What-is-2FA-for-Phone-Number-Updates?)
- [Key Benefits of 2FA for Phone Number Updates](#Key-Benefits-of-2FA-for-Phone-Number-Updates)
- [Eligibility & Prerequisites](#Eligibility-&-Prerequisites)
- [Supported Verification Channels & Selection Logic](#Supported-Verification-Channels-&-Selection-Logic)
- [Rate Limiting Rules](#Rate-Limiting-Rules)
- [Admin vs. User Update Paths](#Admin-vs.-User-Update-Paths)
- [Security & Audit Considerations](#Security-&-Audit-Considerations)
- [How To Set Up and Use the Mandatory 2FA for Phone Number Updates](#How-To-Set-Up-and-Use-the-Mandatory-2FA-for-Phone-Number-Updates)
