title_en: How to Use Custom Fields
source_md:
This article already explains the manual custom-field workflow. The new subsection should introduce Ask AI as an additional management method without replacing the existing Settings instructions.

---

[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/yNPsxqD8DUc?&wmode=opaque)

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What are Custom Fields?](#What-are-Custom-Fields?)
- [Key Benefits of Custom Fields](#Key-Benefits-of-Custom-Fields)
- [Contact vs. Opportunity Custom Fields](#Contact-vs.-Opportunity-Custom-Fields)
- [Organizing Custom Fields with Folders](#Organizing-Custom-Fields-with-Folders)
- [How to Set Up Custom Fields](#How-to-Set-Up-Custom-Fields)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

## **What are Custom Fields?**

Custom fields let you store additional information about contacts or opportunities beyond the default fields (like name, phone, email). You can use them in forms, surveys, automation workflows, and pipelines to collect and reference key data specific to your business.

---

## **Key Benefits of Custom Fields**

Custom fields give you flexibility in data collection, segmentation, and automation:

- **Collect custom data**: Capture business-specific info like lead type, budget range, or preferred contact method.
- **Use across tools**: Deploy custom fields in forms, surveys, workflows, and pipelines for full coverage.
- **Personalize automations**: Merge field values into texts, emails, or internal notifications for tailored messaging.
- **Segment contacts easily**: Create Smart Lists or filter workflows based on custom field data.
- **Stay organized**: Group related fields under folders to keep contact and opportunity records tidy.
- **Display critical info**: Show key custom field values directly on opportunity cards or in notifications.

---

## **Contact vs. Opportunity Custom Fields**

Choosing the right type of custom field is essential for keeping your data organized and functional. In HighLevel, you can create two types of custom fields: Contact custom fields and Opportunity custom fields. While they may seem similar, they serve different purposes and are used in different parts of the platform.

**Contact custom fields** are attached to the individual person. Use them to store personal details like lead type (e.g., buyer or seller), birthday, preferred contact method, or referral source. These fields appear in the contact record and can be used in forms, surveys, contact workflows, Smart Lists, and message personalization using merge fields.

**Opportunity custom fields** are linked to a specific deal or sales opportunity. Use them to capture deal-specific information such as budget range, urgency, timeline to close, or property type. These fields appear only within the opportunity record and are used in pipeline views, opportunity workflows, and deal-level reporting or automation.

```
Note: Once a field is created as either a contact or opportunity field, it cannot be switched.
```

---

## **Organizing Custom Fields with Folders**

Organizing your fields keeps your data tidy and easier to use inside records.  
  
Folders appear as sections in the record layout.

You can use folders to group related custom fields.

To create a folder:

1. Go to **Settings** > **Custom Fields**.
2. Use the object selector at the top of the page to choose the object you want to manage.
3. Open the **Folders** tab.
4. Click **Create folder**.
5. Enter the folder name.
6. Click Create.  
     
   After you create a folder, you can assign custom fields to it for better organization.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155049900396/original/PCF0QM0G-of9ERI8GPRYhxJPesPmgYofaw.png?1752609459)

---

## **Manage Custom Fields with Ask AI**

You can also use Ask AI to create, update, and manage custom fields using natural-language requests.

Ask AI can identify a custom field by its name, so you do not need to provide the Field ID.

**For example: “Update Boat Size to Large.”**

Ask AI supports custom fields associated with Contacts, Opportunities, and Custom Objects. For fields such as picklists, Ask AI can manage the available field options before applying a new value when required. Ask AI may request your approval before making changes to custom fields or field values.

---

## **How to Set Up Custom Fields**

Follow these steps to create and organize custom fields in your sub-account:

### **Step 1:**Navigate to Settings → Custom Fields

#### 

In your sub-account, click **Settings**, then click **Custom Fields**.

*![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155049899570/original/Yh9Qi_nPEsGdQ6sTnTPWqfsfYOoqiPMDKw.jpeg?1752607385)*

### **Step 2:**Select the object

Use the object selector at the top of the page to choose the object you want to manage.

### **Step 3:**Open the Fields tab

Stay on the **Fields** tab to view existing fields and create new ones.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155069289224/original/FCj3FKJDzVDpKkC5YnjnnlwgJD-QxfL5Sw.png?1776338503)

### **Step 4:**Click **Create Field**

#### 

Click **Create field** on the top right of the page.

#### 

### Step 5**: Select a field type**

Choose the field type you want to create.

#### 

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155069290219/original/WlNtThFx6snR4gViN1jaJQJGxgatzCMoPQ.png?1776338844)

### **Step 6:**Fill in the field details

Enter the field details, including the field name and folder if needed.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155069290765/original/6zaShf6HHJz7SAL7gro4_9WumqfukG6YWw.png?1776339089)

### **Step 7:** Review the Live preview

Use the Live preview panel to confirm how the field will appear.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155069291322/original/EPYVFabzkOzqPJKnuMsnoK2DdkBzTkKCUA.png?1776339395)

### **Step 8:** Create the field

Click **Create custom field** to save the field.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155069291497/original/LEN3EzAyraO2t3sfRVZy7T0pi0QgOfAHSQ.png?1776339485)

### **Use the Custom Fields page**

The Custom Fields page includes an updated layout that helps you manage fields more efficiently.

1. Use the object selector at the top of the page to switch between supported objects.
2. Use the **Fields** tab to view and manage custom fields.
3. Use the **Folders** tab to create and manage folders.
4. Sort the table by column to find fields faster.
5. Use the icons in the field list to identify special field states.

```
Confirm the exact meaning of each field icon before publishing this article update.
```

### **Delete Options from Select Fields**

Deleting outdated or incorrect field options helps keep Custom Object and Company data clean without removing historical values from records that already use those options. This is supported for **Dropdown, Multi-select, Radio, and Checkbox** fields.

1. From the **Sub-Account**, go to **Settings → Custom Fields**.
2. Select the relevant **Custom Object** or **Company**.
3. Open the Dropdown, Multi-select, Radio, or Checkbox field you want to update.
4. Delete the required option.
5. If the option is already used by records, review the affected-record count shown before deletion.
6. Confirm the deletion.

After an option is deleted:

- Existing records that already use the option continue to retain and display that value.
- The deleted option is no longer available for new record selections.
- The deleted option cannot be selected when creating new filters or workflow conditions.
- Existing filters, Smart Lists, and workflow conditions that already reference the deleted value continue to work.

```
Note: Contact and Opportunity fields already support deleting options. This enhancement extends the same behavior to Custom Objects and Companies.
```

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083497696/original/znBllJQpnFVDILZwWfm4aUbeoSfvqv4JKw.gif?1792147091)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I convert a contact field into an opportunity field (or vice versa)?**  
No. You must recreate the field under the correct object type. Field objects cannot be changed after creation.

**Q: What types of fields can I create?**  
You can create Short Text, Long Text, Drop downs, Date Pickers, Phone, Email, Radio Selects, Checkbox Groups, URLs, and more.

**Q: Why don’t my fields show in a form or workflow?**  
Ensure the object type matches the use case. Only Contact fields appear in forms and contact workflows.

**Q: How many options can the Dropdown (multiple) custom field have?**

The Dropdown (multiple) field can have a lot of options (50+) so there is no practical limit.

---

## **Related Articles**

title_en: AI Glossary and Frequently Asked Questions
source_md:
This article explains common AI terminology and answers frequently asked questions about AI usage across HighLevel. Use it to better understand AI activity, usage, and the different ways AI products may measure or charge for usage.

For current product-specific pricing, included usage, and billing details, see [AI Product Pricing.](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006652)

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [AI Glossary](#AI-Glossary)
  - [Tokens](#Tokens)
  - [Usage](#Usage)
  - [Request](#Request)
  - [Prompt](#Prompt)
  - [Session](#Session)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
  - [Why can't I bring my own AI API keys?](#Why-can't-I-bring-my-own-AI-API-keys?)
  - [Are AI Studio and Ask AI included in the AI Employee plans?](#Are-AI-Studio-and-Ask-AI-included-in-the-AI-Employee-plans?)
  - [How is token cost accumulated?](#How-is-token-cost-accumulated?)
  - [Why did one request use more tokens than another?](#Why-did-one-request-use-more-tokens-than-another?)
  - [Why can AI Studio usage increase as I continue working on a project?](#Why-can-AI-Studio-usage-increase-as-I-continue-working-on-a-project?)
  - [Why does AI Studio and Ask AI use a 5-hour usage window?](#Why-does-AI-Studio-and-Ask-AI-use-a-5-hour-usage-window?)
  - [When will other current free AI products turn to PPU?](#When-will-other-current-free-AI-products-turn-to-PPU?-(AI-Blog-Builder,-certificate-builder,-funnel-builder,-email-builder))
  - [Is the Managed Agents feature included in the AI Employee Plans?](#Is-the-Managed-Agents-feature-included-in-the-AI-Employee-Plans?)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

## **AI Glossary**

Understanding common AI terminology can help you make sense of how HighLevel AI products work, how usage is measured, and why different interactions may require different amounts of AI processing.

### **Tokens**

AI tokens are the s**mall pieces of text an AI reads and writes** when processing a request.

Think of tokens like puzzle pieces. When you type a prompt, AI breaks your words into smaller pieces called tokens. It processes those tokens to understand what you’re asking, then uses more tokens to create its response.

For example, **“Write a follow-up email for this lead”** gets broken into tokens. Both your prompt and the AI-generated email count toward token usage.

The key takeaway is simple: **the more information AI processes or generates, the more tokens it uses.** Tokens are often how AI usage and costs are measured.

### **Usage**

Usage reflects how much computing power your AI requests require. Not every request uses the same amount. A simple Ask AI request may use less usage, while building a more complex project in AI Studio may use more.  
  
Already an active client using AI tools? Use your AI Suite, tab Usage Dashboard located in Agency View to review your personalized charges and usage. For more info, see: [AI Usage Dashboard](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007742-ai-usage-dashboard)

### **Request**

A request is an instruction or task submitted to an AI experience such as Ask AI, AI Studio or Managed Agents.

A request does not represent a fixed amount of AI usage or a fixed charge. A simple request may require relatively little processing, while another may require the AI to reason through multiple steps, retrieve or analyze information, generate content or images, or perform actions.

For example, asking AI Studio to create a website is one request. Sending another prompt asking it to change the headline creates another request, but the amount of AI processing required for each request may be different.

### **Prompt**

A prompt is the message, question, instruction, or information you provide to an AI tool. Prompts can range from simple questions to detailed instructions containing background information, requirements, uploaded files, images, or other context. For Ask AI and AI Studio, submitting a prompt counts as a request.

Example: *"Create a three-page website for a dental practice with a homepage, services page, and contact page."*

Prompt length alone does not determine total AI usage. Task complexity, context, the model used, and the generated output can also affect how much AI processing is required.

### **Session**

A session is a group of interactions used to complete work within supported AI products such as Ask AI.

A session may contain multiple prompts or requests. For example, an Ask AI session may involve retrieving information, generating content, processing follow-up instructions, and requesting approval before completing an action.

Note that not every HighLevel AI product uses sessions as a usage or billing measurement.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

### **Why can't I bring my own AI API keys?**

HighLevel uses multiple AI providers and models across its AI products. Requiring customers to maintain their own accounts, API keys, and billing relationships with every supported AI provider would make setup and ongoing management significantly more complicated.

HighLevel often adds providers, introduces newer models, or changes which models are used for particular AI tasks. Managing these integrations within HighLevel allows those changes to happen without requiring customers to replace or reconfigure their own API keys.

### **Are AI Studio and Ask AI included in the AI Employee plans?**

Yes. Both AI Studio and Ask AI are included with AI Employee plans.

- **AI Employee Standard**includes standard usage\* within a rolling 5-hour window.
- **AI Employee Growth**includes high usage\* within a rolling 5-hour window.
- **AI Employee Unlimited** includes unlimited usage\* within the same rolling 5-hour window, giving you more capacity to build and ask before reaching your usage threshold.

**\*Fair Use Policy**: Free and unlimited usage is subject to HighLevel's Terms of Service, including excessive-use restrictions. If usage is excessive, abusive, or negatively affects platform performance, HighLevel may throttle, limit, require service upgrades, or terminate access with or without notice.

### **How is token cost accumulated?**

Token cost is based on the amount of information the AI processes and the amount of content it generates.

When you send a request, the AI uses **input tokens** to read things like your prompt, instructions, conversation history, knowledge base content, and other context. It then uses **output tokens** to generate its response.

The total cost depends on how many tokens are processed and the pricing of the AI model being used. Different models have different token rates, so two requests using the same number of tokens may not have the same cost. HighLevel calculates these costs automatically based on the models and actions used.

For current model rates and product-specific pricing, see [AI Product Pricing Guide.](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006652)

### **Why did one request use more tokens than another?**

Not every request requires the same amount of AI processing. Usage can vary based on the amount of context involved, task complexity, requested output, information retrieval or analysis, generated assets, and the AI models used.

As a result, two prompts that appear similar may still use different numbers of tokens.

### **Why can AI Studio usage increase as I continue working on a project?**

AI Studio maintains project context so that it can understand previous instructions and changes. For example, if you have already established a site's design, structure, style, and other requirements, later requests may use that existing context when determining how to make your next change.

This makes iterative development easier because you do not have to restate every previous requirement. However, maintaining and processing additional context can increase the amount of AI processing required for later requests. For more information, see [AI Studio - Pricing](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000008322)

### **Why does AI Studio and Ask AI use a 5-hour usage window?**

AI Studio and Ask AI use a rolling 5-hour usage window to help keep AI fast and reliable for everyone. Because AI tasks require significant computing power, the window helps balance demand and prevent periods of heavy usage from slowing down the experience.

Your usage is measured continuously over the previous five hours. As older activity falls outside that window, usage becomes available again, so you don’t have to wait for a fixed daily reset.

### **When will other current free AI products turn to PPU? (AI Blog Builder, certificate builder, funnel builder, email builder)**

These will all stay free.

### **Is the Managed Agents feature included in the AI Employee Plans?**

Yes Managed agents are included: 100 agent runs on Growth, 1000 agent runs on Unlimited. For more information, see: [AI Product Pricing](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006652)

title_en: Workflow Trigger - Number Validation
source_md:
The **Number Validation** workflow trigger lets you start automation based on the validation result of a contact's phone number. Number Validation checks whether a destination phone number is valid and capable of receiving SMS before the applicable first outbound SMS is sent.

Number Validation is part of HighLevel's **Number Intelligence** feature, which also includes Spam Detection and Name Lookup. Using the validation result in workflows can help you route contacts appropriately and reduce attempted SMS sends to invalid or non-SMS-capable destinations.

> **Important:** Number Validation does not determine whether a contact has consented to receive messages. Continue to follow your applicable opt-in, consent, and messaging-compliance requirements.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [Key Benefits of the Number Validation Trigger](#Key-Benefits-of-the-Number-Validation-Trigger)
- [Prerequisites](#Prerequisites)
- [How the Number Validation Trigger Works](#How-the-Number-Validation-Trigger-Works)
- [How to Configure the Number Validation Trigger](#How-to-Configure-the-Number-Validation-Trigger)
- [Common Uses for the Number Validation Trigger](#Common-Uses-for-the-Number-Validation-Trigger)
- [Number Validation vs Messaging Errors](#Number-Validation-vs-Messaging-Errors)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

## **Key Benefits of the Number Validation Trigger**

Number Validation gives workflows a way to respond to phone-number validation results before continuing with SMS-focused automation. This can help teams identify phone-number issues and choose an appropriate next action.

- **Reduce Invalid SMS Attempts:** Identify destinations that should not proceed through an SMS-focused process.
- **Automate Contact Routing:** Route contacts differently based on their validation result.
- **Improve Contact Data:** Flag contacts whose phone information may need correction.
- **Notify Your Team:** Alert team members when a phone number requires attention.
- **Support Multi-Channel Follow-Up:** Route contacts toward another appropriate communication method when SMS should not be used.

---

## **Prerequisites**

Number Intelligence must be enabled before Number Validation can evaluate applicable outbound SMS destinations. For existing sub-accounts, the feature is managed from the sub-account's Phone System settings.

For an existing sub-account:

1. Go to **Settings > Phone System**.
2. Open **Additional Settings**.
3. Locate **Number Intelligence**.
4. Enable the feature.

> **Note:** Number Validation, Spam Detection, and Name Lookup are currently part of Number Intelligence and are enabled or disabled together.

### **Default for New Sub-Accounts**

Agency admins can configure Number Intelligence to be enabled automatically for newly created sub-accounts.

Go to:

**Agency Settings > Phone Integration > Account Creation**

Then enable **Automatically Enable Number Intelligence**.  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081311885/original/CMI66eSlsSRGMGdt6Gv_FWdE9t5jQS9Gkw.png?1789742116)

> **Important:** This setting establishes the default for newly created sub-accounts. It does not retroactively enable Number Intelligence for existing sub-accounts.

---

## **How the Number Validation Trigger Works**

Number Validation does not run simply because a contact is created or imported. Instead, HighLevel performs the applicable validation when it reaches the first outbound SMS validation event for that phone number.

The general flow is:

**Outbound SMS is prepared → Number Validation runs → Validation result is generated → Number Validation workflow can trigger → SMS is sent or prevented based on the validation result**

This means an existing contact can still reach the Number Validation event when HighLevel prepares the applicable first outbound SMS to that phone number.

> **Important:** The Number Validation workflow trigger runs from the **Number Intelligence validation result**. It does not trigger because an SMS later receives a Twilio or messaging delivery error. Use the applicable messaging-error workflow trigger when your automation needs to respond to SMS delivery errors.

---

## **How to Configure the Number Validation Trigger**

The **Number is** filter determines which validation result should enter the workflow. This allows you to create different automations based on the result returned by Number Intelligence.

1. Go to **Automation > Workflows**.
2. Create a new workflow or open an existing workflow.
3. Click **Add New Trigger**.
4. Search for and select **Number Validation**.  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081312104/original/gvNKP71jzM7rZ1Jv2ZsFeTq7m361v4F1rQ.png?1789742205)
5. Add the **Number is** filter.
6. Select the applicable validation result from the options displayed in the workflow builder.
7. Save the trigger.
8. Add the workflow actions that should run when that validation result occurs.
9. Test the workflow.
10. Publish when the workflow behaves as intended.

> **Note:** Use the validation options displayed in the current workflow builder when configuring **Number is**. Available validation results should be selected directly from the UI.

---

## **Common Uses for the Number Validation Trigger**

Validation results can be used to determine how contacts continue through your automation without treating an unusable phone number as a reason to remove the entire CRM record.

### **Route Contacts Based on SMS Capability**

Use the validation result to determine whether the contact should continue through an SMS-focused process.

For example:

**Validation result → SMS-capable destination → Continue SMS workflow**

or:

**Validation result → Destination should not receive SMS → Alternate follow-up path**

### **Notify Your Team About Phone Number Issues**

Send an internal notification when a validation result indicates that the phone information requires attention.

Your team can then review or correct the contact information as appropriate.

### **Segment Contacts by Validation Result**

Use workflow actions to:

- Apply a tag.
- Update a custom field.
- Add relevant contact information.
- Route the contact into another workflow.

This can help your team distinguish contacts whose phone information may require additional review.

### **Request Updated Contact Information**

When a phone number cannot be used for SMS, route the contact into an appropriate process for obtaining corrected information.

Depending on the contact's permissions and available information, another communication channel may also be used where appropriate.

> **Important:** Do not automatically delete a CRM contact solely because their phone number receives an invalid or non-SMS-capable validation result. The contact may still contain useful information or be reachable through another appropriate channel.

---

## **Number Validation vs Messaging Errors**

Number Validation and messaging-error triggers solve different problems. Understanding the distinction helps ensure your workflow starts from the correct event.

| Trigger Type | Use It For |
| --- | --- |
| **Number Validation** | Responding to the Number Intelligence validation result before the applicable first outbound SMS |
| **Messaging Error / SMS Error** | Responding to an error generated during or after an SMS delivery attempt |

For example, if Number Intelligence determines that a destination should not receive SMS, use **Number Validation**.

If an SMS is attempted and the messaging provider later returns a delivery error, use the applicable **Messaging Error** trigger instead.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: When does Number Validation run?**

Number Validation runs before the applicable first outbound SMS is sent to the phone number. Creating or importing a contact by itself does not run Number Validation.

**Q: Does Number Validation run every time I send an SMS?**

Number Validation is designed around the applicable first outbound SMS validation event for the destination number. It should not be treated as a new validation request for every individual SMS.

**Q: Does the Number Validation trigger fire when Twilio returns an SMS error?**

No. The trigger is based on the Number Intelligence validation result. Use the applicable messaging-error workflow trigger when you need automation based on SMS delivery errors.

**Q: Can Number Validation work with existing contacts?**

Yes. An existing contact can reach the applicable validation event when HighLevel prepares the first applicable outbound SMS to that phone number. Creating or importing the contact itself does not trigger validation.

**Q: Does a valid phone number mean I have permission to send SMS?**

No. Number Validation evaluates phone-number validity and SMS capability. It does not establish whether the contact has opted in or consented to receive messages.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Number Intelligence: Number Validation, Spam Detection, and Name Lookup](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001153968)
- [Workflow Trigger - Messaging Error](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003201)
- [SMS Compliance and Best Practices](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001237726)
- [A List of Workflow Triggers](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000002292)

title_en: How to send a Meta Conversion API action for Ad Manager?
source_md:
In this article we will be talking about the process of creating a workflow for sending back Conversion API action to Meta and the newly added ad manager radio button under Meta Conversion API action in workflows and what value does it add to the user.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [Why do I need to create a CAPI action workflow after creating an ad campaign and conversion dataset?](#Why-do-I-need-to-create-a-CAPI-action-workflow-after-creating-an-ad-campaign-and-conversion-dataset?)
- [Which workflow triggers can be used with Meta Conversion API action?](#Which-workflow-triggers-can-be-used-with-Meta-Conversion-API-action?)
- [How is Ad Manager radio button different from Integrations radio button in the Meta Conversion API action?](#How-is-Ad-Manager-radio-button-different-from-Integrations-radio-button-in-the-Meta-Conversion-API-action?)
- [Lead Event + Stage Name = Purchase: Value and Currency](#Lead-Event-+-Stage-Name-=-Purchase%3A-Value-and-Currency%C2%A0)
- [Can I use the offline events with trigger names like 'Call', 'opportunity change status', 'tag', etc. with Meta Conversion API action?](#Can-I-use-the-offline-events-with-trigger-names-like-'Call',-'opportunity-change-status',-'tag',-etc.-with-Meta-Conversion-API-action?)

---

## **Why do I need to create a CAPI action workflow after creating an ad campaign and conversion dataset?**

Creating and sending CAPI (Conversions API) events to Meta after setting up your ad and dataset is important for enhancing the accuracy, reliability, and effectiveness of your Meta advertising campaigns. Here’s why you need to use the CAPI in addition to the standard Meta dataset:

- **Improved Accuracy:**CAPI sends data directly from your server, bypassing issues like browser restrictions, ad blockers, and cookie limitations, ensuring more reliable tracking of user actions.
- **Better Attribution:** It tracks conversions across devices and platforms (including users who block cookies), providing more complete data for campaign optimisation therefore accurate reporting.
- **Fills Pixel Gaps:** When pixel data is blocked or missed (e.g., due to slow load times or privacy settings), CAPI ensures those conversions are still recorded.
- **Enhanced Optimisation:** More granular, server-side data helps Meta improve ad targeting and performance.
- **Privacy Compliance:**CAPI is better suited for privacy regulations as it reduces reliance on client-side cookies.
- **Efficient Budget Spend:**More accurate data allows Meta to optimise your ad spend and improve return on investment (ROI).

In summary, sending back CAPI events to Meta after creating your pixel is essential to improve the accuracy of your tracking, optimise your ads more effectively, and enhance attribution across devices and browsers. It fills in gaps left by browser-based pixel tracking and helps ensure that your ad campaigns are working as efficiently as possible, even with increasing privacy concerns and browser restrictions.

---

## **Which workflow triggers can be used with Meta Conversion API action?**

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155037638079/original/CL4W8FAhtV-LjEKe9VfqBVqFAUa_pIhS0A.png?1733217275)

In workflows, if your action is Meta Conversion API, the triggers which can be used depend on the Event Type that you will be using in the FB CAPI action. All the eligible triggers for both lead and funnel events are listed as under:

1. For Funnel events in Meta conversion API action, you can use the following triggers; Form Submitted, Survey Submitted, Customer Booked Appointment, and Order Form Submission.  
     
   (For an appointment, it will only work with "Customer Booked appointment," not with "appointment," as appointments are the general triggers and "Customer Booked appointment" is the trigger for the widget)
2. For Lead events in Meta conversion API action, you can only use the trigger "Facebook Lead Form Submission" and "Pipeline Stage Change"(This will work if your contact is coming from a Facebook lead form).
3. For Instagram DM events in Meta conversion API action, you can use any trigger that results in contact creation in the CRM.

---

## **How is Ad Manager radio button different from Integrations radio button in the Meta Conversion API action?**

During the creation of conversion API action under workflows, we see two connection type option:

- Integrations
- Ad Manager

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155051770657/original/XpDYkAD5lt1XxfNmsbndb6Ais472qqwOuw.png?1755497368)

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155051770608/original/MsYr_VqK6pzvkMnj27jUWl_oLbHT_0pitw.png?1755497312)

```
Note: All the information with respect to the Integration connection type and the details of what each field under it means can be understood in detail by following the below two articles:  

Meta conversion leads walkthrough   

Setup a funnel event for Meta conversion API
```

The addition of Ad Manager option as the connection type is mainly to ease the user flow and save the hassle of constant to and fro from Meta to workflows. Below are the enlisted points on what efforts are minimised with the addition of it.

1. You can select the event type based on the campaign you want to send back CAPI to Meta. If your campaign objective is 'Website traffic' send a funnel event and if it's 'Lead generation' then send a lead event and for Click to direct ads select Instagram DM.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155051770827/original/rHgIqdAq4nGMsHDtrRcIuYzZueL9DcnATw.png?1755497695)
2. All the pixels that are part of Ad Manager will be pre-populated as the dropdown items giving you an option to select one from it. This saves you from the hassle of going back to Meta and copy/paste the Pixel ID.  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155037642910/original/r6PKw2USmYvjpzah_TJZiuYisNbIbeB78w.png?1733220060)
3. There is no need to generate and then add the access token to CAPI action when under Ad Manager connection type, we take care of it to again help you with the to and fro.
4. Stage name in a Lead Event refers to: It should accurately represent your Pipeline and Pipeline Stage name for better reporting. Select it using the tag icon at the end to add the custom value of the opportunity pipeline and stages.

### **Lead Event + Stage Name = Purchase: Value and Currency**

When you configure Meta Conversion API in a Workflow with:

**Event Type:**Lead Event  

**Stage Name:**Purchase  

HighLevel shows two additional fields:

- **Value:**Supports a static value or a custom field
- **Currency:**Dropdown (defaults to USD), using the same currency list as Funnel Events

These fields are required only when Stage Name is Purchase.

**Backend Behavior**

- If Value and Currency are provided, HighLevel sends them in the CAPI payload.

- If Stage Name is not Purchase, HighLevel ignores any Value/Currency present in the payload.

---

## **Can I use the offline events with trigger names like 'Call', 'opportunity change status', 'tag', etc. with Meta Conversion API action?**

Yes, it is possible to do so and we will be using the last possible pixel data to send this event. Basically, if the fbclid id is found, the data will be sent to conversion API. It can be best explained by the following examples:

**Example 1:**

Contact created Facebook form submission, thus first attribution source will be Paid Social (Facebook).  If you use workflow with Facebook form submitted trigger, the contact will have fbclid and workflow will send data to conversion API (CAPI).

**Additional Behaviour -**  
After sometime that contact got converted to opportunity with add/update opportunity trigger addition, you use opportunity status trigger in workflow to send the data to conversion api as contact from Facebook form submitted will pass fbclid.

**Example 2:**

Contact created google ad, organic google search or direct traffic,, thus first attribution source will be Paid Search (Google) or Direct Traffic. If the contact after certain time interacted with Facebook form and they fill the form, the latest attribution will be Paid Social(Facebook) with contact having fbclid. Now, if the agency runs workflow with Facebook form submitted > Meta conversion API, it will send the data to conversion API with fbclid.

**Additional Behaviour**

After sometime that contact got converted to opportunity with add/update opportunity trigger addition, you use opportunity status trigger in workflow to send the data to conversion api as contact from Facebook form submitted will pass fbclid.

---

**Please Note:**

**Addition of Custom Values -**

Similar to Google Ads, we are now allowing custom mapping for Facebook Ads conversion tracking parameters.  
  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155043836459/original/gFVWuYxc77LoQwMEWkY0p_spdSoyA3QWZQ.jpeg?1742815441)  
  
  
**How It Works:**  
  
By default, custom mapping is disabled.  
  
Users can toggle it on to enable custom mapping.  
  
**When enabled, users can map:**  
1. FBCLID for funnel events.  
  
2. Facebook Lead ID for lead events.  
  
3. If custom mapping fields are provided, they will take priority over system defaults.  
  
4. If left empty, the system will continue using its default internal values.

title_en: HighLevel MCP for Anthropic — Increased Scopes
source_md:
API Integration

# HighLevel MCP for Anthropic — Increased Scopes

Connect Claude to HighLevel with OAuth-based authentication and access to the full operation catalog across 40 domains.

What You'll Learn

The HighLevel MCP for Anthropic endpoint provides Claude clients with OAuth-based access to 625 operations across 40 domains. This represents a significant expansion beyond the limited-scope surface available through the original universal MCP endpoint.

This article explains the key capabilities, setup process, and technical architecture of the Anthropic MCP endpoint, including user-controlled scope selection, the 5-tool facade pattern, and per-client OAuth isolation.

For more, visit the **Support Doc:**<https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/other/mcp/>

## What is the HighLevel MCP for Anthropic?

The HighLevel MCP for Anthropic is an OAuth-based Model Context Protocol endpoint specifically designed for Claude clients. MCP (Model Context Protocol) enables AI assistants like Claude to connect to external data sources and tools through a standardized interface.

This endpoint provides access to the complete HighLevel operation catalog — 625 operations across 40 domains — representing a substantial expansion beyond the limited-scope surface of the original universal MCP endpoint. The Anthropic endpoint uses a dedicated OAuth application that grants the widest scope set available, while maintaining complete user control over which permissions are granted.

The endpoint follows a per-client MCP pattern, with the URL structure:

https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/mcp/anthropic/v2

This approach allows different AI clients to maintain isolated OAuth grants, ensuring that scopes granted to Claude remain separate from scopes granted to other clients like ChatGPT or future integrations.

## Key Features and Capabilities

The HighLevel MCP for Anthropic introduces several advanced capabilities designed to provide comprehensive API access while maintaining security and efficiency:

**Increased Scopes** — Access to the widest scope set available, spanning the full operation catalog across 40 domains, compared to the limited-scope surface of the original endpoint

**User-Controlled Scope Selection** — Users approve exactly which scopes the integration can access through the OAuth consent screen, maintaining complete control over permissions

**5-Tool Facade Pattern** — Instead of hundreds of individual tools, a compact interface of five core tools (search, fetch, search\_operations, describe\_operation, execute\_operation) keeps model context small while enabling full catalog access

**Per-Client OAuth Isolation** — Scopes granted to Claude remain isolated from scopes granted to other AI clients, with dedicated OAuth apps per official client

**Latest v3 API Documentation** — All operations are based on the latest HighLevel v3 API with full RBAC (Role-Based Access Control) enforcement

**Sub-Account Level Connections** — Every connection operates at the location level; one connection equals one location, never agency-wide

How the 5-Tool Facade Works

Agents discover and execute operations using the pattern: `search_operations → describe_operation → execute_operation`. This architecture keeps the model's context window efficient while still providing access to the complete operation catalog.

## Supported Claude Clients

The HighLevel MCP for Anthropic endpoint supports the following Claude clients:

**Claude.ai** — The web-based Claude interface from Anthropic

**Claude Code** — Claude's code-focused development environment

**Claude Cowork** — Claude's collaborative workspace environment

Upcoming Clients

Support for additional AI clients is in development, including OpenAI, Cursor, Windsurf, and VS Code. These clients will follow the same per-client pattern with isolated OAuth grants.

Original Universal Endpoint

The original universal endpoint at `https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/mcp/` remains fully supported and continues to work with any MCP client over OAuth or Private Integration Token, though with the existing limited-scope surface.

## Operation Coverage and Scopes

The HighLevel MCP for Anthropic provides comprehensive access to HighLevel operations. The following table summarizes the complete operation catalog:

| Metric | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Total Operations in Catalog | 625 |
| Active Operations | 571 |
| Read Operations | 243 |
| Write Operations | 244 |
| Delete Operations | 84 |
| Domains Covered | 40 |

Key characteristics of the operation coverage:

**Automatic Filtering** — Operations are automatically filtered based on the user's OAuth grant, ensuring users only access permitted resources

**Widest Scope Set** — The Anthropic OAuth app exposes the complete scope set across the full catalog

**Location-Level Connections** — Every connection operates at the sub-account/location level; one connection equals one location, never agency-wide

**User-Controlled Selection** — Users choose which scopes to grant through OAuth consent or Private Integration Token creation

Legacy Endpoint Comparison

The legacy `/mcp/` endpoint provides a limited subset of operations through the Private Integration Token flow. For full catalog access with Claude clients, use the Anthropic-specific endpoint.

## How to Set Up the HighLevel MCP for Anthropic

Setting up the HighLevel MCP for Anthropic involves configuring your Claude client to connect to the Anthropic-specific endpoint and completing the OAuth authorization flow.

Step 1

Access Your Claude Client

Open one of the supported Claude clients: Claude.ai, Claude Code, or Claude Cowork. Navigate to the MCP or integrations settings within the client interface.

Step 2

Add the HighLevel MCP Endpoint

Configure the MCP connection using the Anthropic-specific endpoint URL:

https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/mcp/anthropic/v2

Step 3

Initiate OAuth Authorization

Click the connect or authorize button to begin the OAuth flow. You will be redirected to the HighLevel authorization page.

Step 4

Select Your Scopes

On the OAuth consent screen, review the requested scopes. Select exactly which permissions you want to grant to the Claude integration. You control which operations the AI can access.

Step 5

Choose Your Location

Select the HighLevel sub-account (location) you want to connect. Remember that each connection operates at the location level, not agency-wide.

Step 6

Authorize the Connection

Click "Authorize" or "Allow" to complete the OAuth flow. The system uses Authorization Code with PKCE (Proof Key for Code Exchange) for secure authentication with refresh token support.

Step 7

Verify the Connection

You will be redirected back to your Claude client. Confirm that the HighLevel MCP connection appears in your active integrations list. You can now use Claude to interact with your HighLevel data.

Connection Confirmed

After successful authorization, Claude can discover and execute operations using the 5-tool facade pattern. The locationId is automatically injected from your OAuth grant for all API calls.

## Technical Architecture

The HighLevel MCP for Anthropic implements several advanced architectural patterns to deliver secure, scalable, and efficient AI integration:

Component 1

Hosted Operation Registry

A generated registry containing every hosted CRM operation provides faster operation discovery, better operation ranking, consistent execution routing, and improved AI tool selection accuracy.

Component 2

Per-Client OAuth App Registry

An upstream OAuth app registry resolves a dedicated OAuth application for each official client behind the `/mcp/{client}/v2` pattern. Client identity is detected from origin and redirect signals, with scoped-path mismatches rejected and per-client OAuth discovery metadata served.

Component 3

Security Enhancements

The architecture enforces redirect URI allowlists, performs MCP origin validation to prevent DNS rebinding attacks, applies sensitive token and secret redaction, and isolates internal admin/debug surfaces from public runtime endpoints.

Component 4

Infrastructure and Reliability

The system utilizes dedicated Redis infrastructure for MCP services, manages OAuth secrets through AWS Secrets Manager, and automatically injects locationId from OAuth grants into API calls.

Component 5

RBAC Enforcement

All operations are based on the latest v3 API documentation with full Role-Based Access Control enforcement. Operations that fail RBAC checks are blocked, ensuring users only access resources permitted by their role and OAuth grant.

Note

Authentication uses Authorization Code with PKCE (Proof Key for Code Exchange) to prevent interception attacks and supports refresh tokens for long-lived connections without re-authorization.

## Video Walkthrough

Watch these video demonstrations to see the HighLevel MCP for Anthropic in action:  
  
\*HighLevel MCP for Anthropic\* `/mcp/anthropic/v2`  
<https://www.loom.com/share/b23bfe32e8be42838bd6eab12a0b932f>  
  
\*Claude Code setup\*  
<https://www.loom.com/share/6e944d0b4038430da6d829a74c944b88>  
  
\*Old endpoint\* `/mcp/`  
<https://www.loom.com/share/d6b2228911514b5a9bbf88fd74a84759>  
  
\*Docs\*  
<https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/other/mcp/>

Maximize Your AI Integration

Ready to Connect Claude to HighLevel?

Access the full operation catalog with 625 operations across 40 domains using the new Anthropic MCP endpoint.

title_en: Send Documents and Contracts via SMS in HighLevel
source_md:
Send Documents and Contracts via SMS in HighLevel helps you deliver documents faster through a channel clients are more likely to see quickly. This feature supports SMS-only sending or Email + SMS delivery, gives you more control over customer notifications, and works with snippets for reusable message templates. It also supports workflow-based sending, making document delivery more flexible and scalable.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Send Documents and Contracts via SMS?](#What-is-Send-Documents-and-Contracts-via-SMS?)
- [Key Benefits of Send Documents and Contracts via SMS](#Key-Benefits-of-Send-Documents-and-Contracts-via-SMS)
- [Global Defaults for Document Notifications](#Global-Defaults-for-Document-Notifications)
- [Create SMS Templates with Snippets](#Create-SMS-Templates-with-Snippets)
- [Send Documents Individually](#Send-Documents-Individually)
- [Send Documents via Workflows](#Send-Documents-via-Workflows)
- [View Contact Information While Adding Recipients](#View-Contact-Information-While-Adding-Recipients)
- [How To Setup Send Documents and Contracts via SMS](#How-To-Setup-Send-Documents-and-Contracts-via-SMS)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)

---

# **What is Send Documents and Contracts via SMS?**

Sending Documents and Contracts via SMS allows you to deliver contracts and documents to recipients through text message instead of relying only on email. This helps improve visibility, supports faster document delivery, and works alongside existing HighLevel tools such as snippets, workflows, and document notification settings.

---

## **Key Benefits of Send Documents and Contracts via SMS**

SMS delivery gives businesses another way to reach contacts when email may be missed. It is especially useful when speed, visibility, and workflow automation matter for proposals, contracts, and other documents.

- **Faster visibility**: SMS messages can help documents get noticed more quickly than email alone.
- **Flexible delivery options**: You can send documents through SMS only or combine Email + SMS for broader reach.
- **Reusable messaging**: SMS snippets help you create consistent, personalized message templates for document sends.
- **Workflow support**: Documents can be sent through workflow automation, helping standardize delivery across your pipeline.
- **Centralized settings**: Global customer notification defaults make it easier to manage how document-related messages are delivered.

---

## **Global Defaults for Document Notifications**

Global notification settings help keep document communication consistent across your account. Setting defaults is useful when you want your team to follow the same delivery method for document-related notifications while still allowing flexibility where supported.

1. Go to **Payments > Documents & Contracts**.
2. Open **Settings**.
3. Select **Customer Notifications**.
4. Under the document notification options, choose your preferred delivery method:

   - **SMS only**
   - **Email + SMS**
5. Save your changes.

```
Important: Based on the release note, Document Received follows the default but can be overridden later when supported, while Document Signed always follows the global setting.
```

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155067040580/original/nUJo909_lPJ7icvF_WgZqt27nsT2vd3BJA.png?1773674171)**

---

## **Create SMS Templates with Snippets**

SMS snippets make document delivery more efficient by letting you reuse clear, consistent text messages instead of rewriting them each time. This is especially helpful when multiple team members send the same type of contract or proposal and need a repeatable communication standard.

1. Go to **Marketing > Snippets**.
2. Click **New Snippet**.
3. Choose **SMS** as the snippet type.
4. Write your SMS message.
5. Save the snippet.

Example SMS snippet:  
  
Your document is ready. Please review and sign it here.

Use concise wording so the recipient immediately understands what action to take.

****![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155067078393/original/Ygu7n8lQlyBwPrOmqhPbozZFZYeHTTUA-Q.jpeg?1773728870)****

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155067078375/original/i6u7egZK8_aDquJIR0PhjiWEBCibjshRSw.png?1773728854)**

---

## **Send Documents Individually**

Individual sending gives users more control when they want to choose the delivery channel at the moment they send a document. This is useful for one-off sends, special cases, or situations where a contact may respond better to text than email.

1. Open the document you want to send.
2. Click **Send**.
3. Choose the delivery channel:

   - **Email**
   - **SMS**
   - **Email + SMS**
4. If you choose SMS, select the SMS snippet you want to use.
5. Review the details and send the document.

This sending option helps you adapt to the recipient’s preferred communication method without changing your broader account defaults.

**[Screenshot: Document send modal showing Email, SMS, and Email + SMS options plus SMS template selection]**

---

## **Send Documents via Workflows**

Workflow-based document sending helps automate your process so documents can go out when specific business conditions are met, such as a new opportunity stage, a form submission, or another workflow trigger. This makes it easier to deliver documents at scale while keeping communication consistent.

1. Go to **Automation > Workflows**.
2. Open an existing workflow or create a new one.
3. Add the **Send Documents & Contracts** action.
4. Select the document or contract template you want to send.
5. Choose the sending channel based on the options available in your account setup.
6. Save and publish the workflow.

Based on the release note, workflow sends use the default SMS content or template behavior configured for documents.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155067078482/original/UFTLRYBXB8SvtOgQDAZxC1NU1YGfUjj4pw.png?1773728995)**

---

## **View Contact Information While Adding Recipients**

Being able to review contact details while adding recipients helps reduce sending mistakes and improves confidence before delivery. This is especially important when using SMS because the correct phone number must be available for successful delivery.

- Review the contact’s available details before sending.
- Confirm the phone number when selecting SMS delivery.
- Check the email address as well if you are using Email + SMS.
- Use the visible contact information to make sure the document is going to the correct recipient.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155067078593/original/3kbUXtkiJAaRFep3eBvWXMH-LK2bqDvUxw.png?1773729090)**

---

## **How To Setup Send Documents and Contracts via SMS**

A proper setup ensures your team can send documents consistently, use reusable SMS messaging, and avoid delays caused by missing delivery settings. Completing these steps before sending helps create a smoother experience for both your team and your recipients.

1. Go to **Payments > Documents & Contracts > Settings > Customer Notifications**.
2. Choose your default customer notification method for supported document events.
3. Go to **Marketing > Snippets** and create at least one SMS snippet.
4. Return to **Documents & Contracts** and open the document you want to send.
5. Click **Send** and select **SMS** or **Email + SMS**.
6. Choose your SMS snippet if prompted.
7. Review the recipient information before sending.
8. Send the document or configure the same delivery flow inside a workflow.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I send a document by SMS only?**  
Yes. The feature supports sending documents through SMS only, or through Email + SMS.

**Q: Can I send a document through both email and SMS at the same time?**  
Yes. You can choose Email + SMS for broader visibility when sending supported documents.

**Q: Do I need to create an SMS snippet before sending documents via SMS?**  
SMS snippets are used for reusable SMS message content and should be created in Marketing > Snippets.

**Q: Can I choose a different send channel when sending an individual document?**  
Yes. Individual sends allow you to select the delivery channel during the send process.

**Q: Do workflow-sent documents support SMS?**  
Yes. The release note states that documents can be sent through workflows using the available channel options.

**Q: Do signed notifications always follow the global setting?**  
Yes. According to the release note, Document Signed always follows the configured global setting.

**Q: What should I check before sending a document via SMS?**  
Confirm that the recipient has the correct phone number and review their contact details before sending.

**Q: Can I still use email for document delivery?**  
Yes. Email remains available, and you can also combine it with SMS.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [Workflow Action - Send Documents & Contracts](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004887)
- [Documents & Contracts: Email Templates and Team Notifications Setup](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000001298)
- [Workflow Trigger - Documents & Contracts](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000001491)

title_en: Wallet Pricing Page
source_md:
Billing & Wallet

# Wallet Pricing Page

Access centralized pricing for every wallet-billed product in HighLevel. View country-specific rates, search products, and understand exactly what you're being charged.

What You'll Learn

The Wallet Pricing page provides a single source of truth for pay-as-you-go rates across all wallet-billed products including AI, Communication, WhatsApp, Domain, and more. This feature is part of HighLevel's Billing Transparency initiative.

This article explains what the Wallet Pricing page includes, how to access it, and how to use it to understand product costs across different markets.

Labs Feature

The Wallet Pricing page must be enabled from Labs before it becomes available in your Billing settings. Navigate to Settings → Labs, locate the Wallet Pricing feature, and enable it to begin using this functionality.

## What is the Wallet Pricing Page?

The Wallet Pricing page is a dedicated pricing reference inside the Billing section that displays pay-as-you-go rates for every product that uses wallet billing. This includes products across multiple categories such as AI, Communication, WhatsApp, Domain, and more.

Prior to this feature, agencies needed to search across multiple pages or contact support to understand product costs. The Wallet Pricing page consolidates all pricing information into a single, searchable view with organized categories, making it easy to find rates and understand what you're being charged for.

This is phase one of HighLevel's Billing Transparency initiative, designed to eliminate confusion around wallet charges and provide agencies with a clear reference for reconciling invoices, planning pricing strategies, and explaining costs to clients.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155080282181/original/icHoXAk1LIs7duQIXa9aL5tANsW-HNuqqw.png?1788788362)

## Key Features

The Wallet Pricing page includes several capabilities designed to help you quickly locate and understand product costs:

Feature 1

Full Product Catalog With Pricing

Every wallet-billed product is listed with unit costs, grouped by category and sub-category. This makes it easy to scan what you're being charged for without searching across multiple pages. All rates are kept up to date automatically.

Feature 2

Search and Filter

Use the search bar to find products by category or product name instantly. You can expand or collapse categories to focus on the section that matters to you, making navigation faster when you need to reference a specific product.

Feature 3

Country-Specific Rates

Switch between 27 supported countries to see localized pricing. Products like WhatsApp messages and calls display country-specific rates so you always know what applies to your market. Additional countries will be added over time.

Feature 4

Product Detail on Demand

Expand any product row to see a full breakdown including category, SKU, description, pricing, billing unit, and country rates. This gives you everything you need to understand exactly how a product is billed without leaving the page.

Feature 5

Enterprise Pricing Included

Enterprise product pricing is covered alongside standard rates. Agencies on enterprise plans have full visibility into what applies to them, ensuring consistent pricing transparency across all account types.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155080282314/original/HjMTGzj_TxkGbP-WNzRu3XM0HACK5yBmtw.png?1788788408)

## Why This Matters

Wallet billing has traditionally lacked a centralized reference for product costs. Agencies were charged for products without an easy way to verify rates, leading to confusion when reconciling invoices or explaining charges to clients.

The Wallet Pricing page eliminates this issue by providing a single source of truth for every wallet product rate. Whether you're reconciling an invoice, planning your pricing strategy, or explaining costs to a client, you have immediate access to accurate, up-to-date pricing information.

This is the foundation of HighLevel's Billing Transparency initiative. Future phases will include sub-account pricing with markup controls and a pricing calculator to further enhance billing visibility and control.

Getting Started

Access the Wallet Pricing Page

Enable the feature from Labs and navigate to Billing to view all product rates

## How to Access and Use the Wallet Pricing Page

Follow these steps to enable and begin using the Wallet Pricing page:

Step 1

Enable the Feature from Labs

Navigate to Settings → Labs in your HighLevel account. Locate the Wallet Pricing feature and enable it. This will activate the Pricing page in your Billing section.

Step 2

Navigate to the Pricing Page

Go to Billing in the main navigation. Under Wallet and Transactions, you will see the new Pricing page. Click to open it.

Step 3

Browse Products by Category

Products are organized by category and sub-category. Expand or collapse categories to focus on specific product areas. All products within a category display their unit costs and billing units.  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155080282837/original/6Lrwa9mkWzIAtnOvi1xC1-lBv5jrH54hxQ.png?1788788533)

Step 4

Use Search to Find Specific Products

Use the search bar at the top of the page to search by category name or product name. The page will filter results in real time as you type, making it faster to locate the product you need.  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155080282500/original/sSiBLM5-Xd0Md_P_gdZBqUD-o0m93gUguQ.png?1788788457)

Step 5

Switch the Country Selector

Use the country selector dropdown to switch between the 27 supported countries. Pricing will update automatically to reflect the rates applicable to the selected market. This is especially useful for products like WhatsApp messages and calls, which have country-specific rates.

Step 6

Expand Product Rows for Full Details

Click on any product row to expand it and view the full breakdown. This includes the product category, SKU, description, pricing, billing unit, and country-specific rates where applicable.  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155080283184/original/LQta_MW1SeQkevFnFlKUPTAU33fQbVFBbA.png?1788788607)

## Supported Countries

The Wallet Pricing page currently supports 27 countries with localized pricing. Additional countries will be added in future updates.  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155080283350/original/hYpNGVs2YJsnLLzgRvgCjrwHKnYBQl2ytA.png?1788788658)

| Region | Countries |
| --- | --- |
| North America | United States (US), Canada (CA), Mexico (MX) |
| Europe | United Kingdom (GB), Ireland (IE), Germany (DE), France (FR), Spain (ES), Italy (IT), Netherlands (NL), Belgium (BE), Norway (NO), Denmark (DK), Finland (FI), Poland (PL), Portugal (PT), Switzerland (CH), Austria (AT) |
| Asia-Pacific | Australia (AU), New Zealand (NZ), India (IN), Japan (JP), Singapore (SG) |
| South America | Brazil (BR) |
| Middle East & Africa | United Arab Emirates (AE), South Africa (ZA) |

Note

If your country is not currently supported, the page will display default pricing. Additional countries will be added over time as part of ongoing updates to the Billing Transparency initiative.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Do I need to enable this feature from Labs?

Yes, the Wallet Pricing page is currently a Labs feature. You must enable it from Settings → Labs before it appears in your Billing section. Once enabled, it will be available under Wallet and Transactions.

Q: Are the prices on this page updated automatically?

Yes, all pricing displayed on the Wallet Pricing page is kept up to date automatically. You do not need to refresh the page manually to see current rates.

Q: Does this page show pricing for sub-accounts?

Currently, the Wallet Pricing page displays agency-level pricing. In future phases, you will be able to extend this to sub-accounts with markup controls. This functionality is part of the roadmap for the Billing Transparency initiative.

Q: Can I export the pricing data from this page?

Export functionality is not available in this phase. Future updates may include the ability to export pricing data as part of enhanced reporting capabilities.

Q: What if my country is not listed in the country selector?

If your country is not currently supported, the page will display default pricing. Additional countries will be added over time. Check back for updates as the feature expands to more markets.

Q: Does this page include enterprise pricing?

Yes, enterprise product pricing is included alongside standard rates. Agencies on enterprise plans can view the pricing that applies to them directly on this page.

Q: Will there be a pricing calculator in the future?

Yes, a pricing calculator is on the roadmap as part of future phases of the Billing Transparency initiative. This will allow you to estimate costs based on projected usage before charges are incurred.

Q: Where can I find more information about wallet billing?

For more information about wallet billing, how charges are calculated, and how to top up your wallet, visit the Wallet and Billing section of the HighLevel Help Center or contact support.

title_en: Webinar Funnels
source_md:
HighLevel Webinars let you create and manage Live, On-Demand, and Recurring webinar experiences from the Sites area. You can collect registrations, build webinar funnel pages, connect webinar content or live links, and use Workflows for confirmations, reminders, and follow-ups.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [Key Features & Benefits](#Key-Features-&-Benefits)
- [Getting Started](#Getting-Started)
- [Live Webinars](#Live-Webinars)
- [On Demand Webinars](#On-Demand-Webinars)
- [Automations & Reminders](#Automations-&-Reminders)
- [Best Practices](#Best-Practices)
- [Troubleshooting](#Troubleshooting)
- [Conclusion](#Conclusion)

---

[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/HtEAiQyhYlQ?&wmode=opaque)

---

## **Key Features & Benefits**

HighLevel’s webinar funnels are built to streamline setup while giving you powerful engagement tools.

- **On-Demand Webinars** → Pre-recorded content that can be accessed anytime, perfect for evergreen lead generation.
- **Live Webinars** → Host real-time sessions with scheduled dates/times and live interaction.
- **Template Selection** → Pre-built registration, confirmation, and broadcast pages to launch faster.
- **Automated Workflows & Reminders** → Pre-configured automation recipes for email and SMS reminders and follow-ups, reducing manual work.
- **Recurring Webinars** → Repeat webinar sessions on a Daily, Weekly, Monthly, or No Fixed Time schedule.
- **Webinar Cloning** → Reuse an existing webinar setup and update details such as the webinar date and time.
- **Webinar Analytics** → Review registration, attendance, viewing, and engagement data for Live, On-Demand, and Recurring Webinars.

## 

## **Getting Started**

### Accessing Webinar Creation

1. **Login** to your HighLevel account: `app.gohighlevel.com`
2. Navigate to **Sites** in the left sidebar
3. Click **Webinars**
4. Select **New Webinar Funnel**

### 

### **Initial Setup**

Choose the webinar type that matches your use case:

- **Live Webinar** — scheduled for a specific date and time.
- **On-Demand Webinar** — uses pre-recorded content that attendees can access after registering.
- **Recurring Webinar** — repeats according to a configured schedule.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155052367881/original/8qh56KdQR3go-fc9rdOUAJxlWBTiCWehUg.png?1756201381)

## **Live Webinars**

### Overview

Live webinars are real-time presentations where attendees join at a specific date and time.

### **4-Step Creation Process**

#### 

#### **Step 1: Webinar Details**

- **Webinar Name** (Required) — Example: *Digital Marketing Mastery Webinar*
- **Timezone** (Required) — Default: *America/New\_York* (changeable)
- **Date** (Required) — Pick a future date
- **Time** (Required) — Example: *2:00 PM*

*![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155052367939/original/hp4XU_1AFmpohZ4h7MtJTVirua_gY__9Kw.png?1756201432)*

#### 

#### **Step 2: Select Form**

Attendees register via forms created in **Sites > Forms**.

- **Dropdown Options** → Displays all available forms
- **Custom Forms** → Create your own with fields like name, email, phone, etc.
- **Lead Capture** → Forms sync with your CRM for tracking and automations
- **Automation Trigger** → Form submissions also trigger reminder and follow-up workflows (see [Automations & Reminders](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000001254))

#### 

#### **Step 3: Live Webinar Link**

Enter your streaming link:

- Zoom → `https://zoom.us/j/123456789`
- YouTube Live → `https://youtube.com/watch?v=ABC123`
- Other supported webinar or custom links

`![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155052367985/original/cyq6X3jZMB7smAU4k7TOGVgvSjTIbpVvSw.png?1756201469)`

#### **Step 4: Templates**

Choose from pre-designed funnel templates, such as:

- **Blank Live**
- **E-Commerce Marketing Live**
- **Financial Planning Live**
- **DIY Home Remodel Live**

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155052368040/original/KAfVqwu684kieAboPhHVDM_XGbLXEfu_Wg.png?1756201489)**

## On Demand Webinars

### Overview

On-Demand webinars are pre-recorded sessions that attendees can access anytime after registering.

### 4-Step Creation Process

#### **Step 1: Webinar Details**

- **Webinar Name** (Required) — Example: *Content Marketing Mastery - On Demand*
- **Note** → No timezone, date, or time needed.

#### **Step 2: Select Form**

Same as Live Webinars:

- Choose a form from **Sites > Forms**
- Default Example: *Marketing Form - Claim Offer*
- Customizable fields to capture the data you need

#### **Step 3: Select Video**

Upload or select a pre-recorded video:

- Supported video formats include:

  - MP4
  - MOV
  - AVI
- Upload from your computer or select from the media library
- **Required** to proceed

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155052368189/original/6s3gS4K1ZLxmnBgxvLJJr8-WaH5I4-9W-Q.png?1756201512)

#### **Step 4: Templates**

Same template library as Live Webinars, optimized for on-demand viewing.

## Automations & Reminders

One of the most powerful features of webinar funnels is automation.

- **Pre-Built Workflow Recipe** → Each webinar funnel comes with an automation recipe for reminders and follow-ups.
- **Triggers** → Registrations (form submissions) automatically start the workflow.
- **Reminders** → Email/SMS reminders can be scheduled for Live Webinars (for example, 24 hours before, 1 hour before, 10 minutes before).
- **Follow-Ups** → Post-webinar workflows send thank-you emails, replay links, and nurture campaigns.
- **Customization** → You can edit workflows via the three-dot menu on your webinar funnel to adjust timing, personalize messages, or add extra steps.

Pro Tip: Align reminder timings with your audience’s habits (for example, B2B audiences respond better to morning reminders, while B2C may need evening prompts).

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155052368326/original/i-D8_xaS4_5ueKvYXMMH9bzVBJ5vzyXfBQ.png?1756201572)

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155052368445/original/gEaGUpaqOPEH5UlIlT_7UP_erPpZTkisVQ.png?1756201600)

## **Best Practices**

### **Live Webinars**

- Test setup before the event
- Schedule with audience timezones in mind
- Promote early and often
- Have a backup plan for technical issues
- Encourage interaction (chat, polls, Q&A)

### **On Demand Webinars**

- Use high-quality recordings
- Keep videos concise (30–60 minutes)
- Structure content for self-paced learning
- Keep your media library organized
- Refresh content periodically

## **Troubleshooting**

### Live Webinars

- **Link not working** → Verify format & test before event
- **Timezone confusion** → Clearly display timezone on registration and confirmation pages

### On Demand Webinars

- **Upload fails** → Check format, file size, and internet connection
- **Poor video quality** → Upload high-resolution versions

Available frequency options include:

- Daily
- Weekly
- Monthly
- No Fixed Time

You can also end the series after a specified number of sessions or on a selected date.

### General

- **Form not capturing leads** → Test form integration with CRM
- **Template not loading** → Refresh or check connection

## **Recurring Webinars**

```
Recurring Webinar settings let you repeat webinar sessions without manually creating every occurrence.
```

To configure a recurring webinar:

1. Go to **Sites → Webinars**.
2. Create a new webinar or open an eligible existing webinar.
3. Complete the Webinar Details.
4. Turn on **Enable recurring webinar**.
5. Select the recurrence frequency.
6. Configure the recurrence pattern.
7. Choose when the webinar series should end.

## **Conclusion**

Use the webinar type that matches your delivery model, then test the registration form, webinar content, funnel pages, and automation before promoting the webinar.

- **Live** → Real-time engagement and interaction
- **On Demand** → Evergreen, scalable, and flexible access

With built-in templates and automation workflows, you can launch webinars quickly while ensuring attendees receive **timely reminders, seamless confirmations, and personalized follow-ups** — helping you maximize engagement and conversions with minimal effort.

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Can I clone an existing webinar?**  
Yes. HighLevel supports cloning webinars so you can reuse an existing setup and update details such as the date and time.

**Can I create a recurring webinar?**  
Yes. Recurring Webinars can repeat on Daily, Weekly, Monthly, or No Fixed Time schedules.

**Where can I view webinar analytics?**  
Go to **Sites → Analytics → Webinars**.

**Does an On-Demand Webinar require a scheduled date and time?**  
No. On-Demand Webinars require webinar content but do not require a fixed webinar date, time, or timezone.

## 

## **Related Articles**

- [Complete Guide to Creating Webinars in HighLevel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006062)
- [Recurring Webinar Settings](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006462)
- [Webinar Video Analytics](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006582)

title_en: Restore a Deleted Phone Number
source_md:
If you accidentally delete or release a phone number, it may still be possible to recover it depending on your phone system, how recently the number was deleted, and whether the number is still available. This guide explains how to restore a deleted number for LC Phone (LeadConnector) and agency-connected Twilio accounts, what information you need, and what to check after the number is restored.

```
Note: This article covers phone numbers manually deleted or released from an active account. Phone numbers associated with a canceled HighLevel subscription follow a different deletion timeline.
```

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [Key Benefits of Restoring a Deleted Phone Number](#Key-Benefits-of-Restoring-a-Deleted-Phone-Number)
- [Phone Number Restoration Rules and Reminders](#Phone-Number-Restoration-Rules-and-Reminders%C2%A0)
- [If You're Using LC Phone (LeadConnector)](#If-You're-Using-LC-Phone-(LeadConnector))
- [If You're Using Your Own Twilio Account](#If-You're-Using-Your-Own-Twilio-Account)
  - [Step 1: Identify the correct Twilio sub-account](#Step-1%3A%C2%A0Identify-the-correct-Twilio-sub-account)
  - [Step 2: Find the Twilio SID](#Step-2%3A%C2%A0Find-the-Twilio-SID)
  - [Step 3: Copy the Account SID](#Step-3%3A%C2%A0Copy-the-Account-SID)
  - [Step 4: Navigate to Released Numbers in Twilio Console and Repurchase the released number](#Step-4%3A%C2%A0Navigate-to-Released-Numbers-in-Twilio-Console-and-Repurchase-the-released-number)
- [What to Check After Restoring the Number](#What-to-Check-After-Restoring-the-Number)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

## **Key Benefits of Restoring a Deleted Phone Number**

- **Preserve Customer Trust** – Avoid confusing customers who still have the number saved.
- **Maintain Marketing Consistency** – Reuse numbers already featured in ads, landing pages, and printed materials.
- **Prevent Missed Leads** – Ensure ongoing calls and texts continue without interruption.
- **Avoid Costly Transitions** – Save time and effort versus setting up a new number and reconfiguring workflows.
- **Retain Caller ID History** – Keep your reputation intact with your existing contact and SMS history.

---

## **Phone Number Restoration Rules and Reminders**

- **10-Day Window**: You have **10 days** from the deletion date to restore a number. After that, the number is no longer available.
- **Act as soon as possible.** Deleted or released numbers may only be recoverable for a limited period, and restoration is not guaranteed. Availability depends on whether the number is still held or has been returned to inventory/reassigned.
- **Immediate Billing**: Twilio may charge you immediately upon restoring the number.
- If the number is no longer available, **restoration may not be possible.**
- Restoring a number **won’t automatically restore** any webhook or call routing configurations.

- **Twilio holds deleted numbers for 10 days.**After that period, you must contact **Twilio Support** directly to request restoration.
- **Restoration charges may apply** once the number is recovered.

```
IMPORTANT: If you're trying to move a phone number between LC Phone, Twilio, sub-accounts, or agencies, do not delete or release the number first. Phone number migrations follow a separate process. See Moving Phone Numbers Across Accounts (US and International).
```

---

## **If You're Using LC Phone (LeadConnector)**

If your number was deleted from a **HighLevel sub-account using LC Phone (LeadConnector-hosted numbers)**, our support team may be able to restore it, **but only within 10 days** of deletion. LC Phone numbers are managed by HighLevel, so you must reach out to our support team with the correct **Location ID** where the number was assigned. Our team will check if the number is still available and attempt restoration on your behalf.

Have the following ready when contacting **HighLevel Support:**

- Phone number you want to restore
- **Location ID** of the sub-account where the number was previously assigned
- Approximate deletion date

**Then**:

> HighLevel Support will check whether the number is still recoverable. Restoration is not guaranteed if the number has already been released or reassigned.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155046032623/original/kGK3w-QWsllxiXq5FY0OAowiJZQedg3F7Q.gif?1746194333)

---

## **If You're Using Your Own Twilio Account**

If you're using your **own Twilio account** (not LC Phone), you can attempt to restore the number directly from the Twilio Console, within 10 days of deletion.
