title_en: Get Additional Domain Extensions While Buying or Managing Domains
source_md:
This article explains HighLevel’s suggested Additional Domain Extensions feature. It helps you secure extra TLDs like .net, .org, .co, and more when purchasing or managing a domain, so your brand stays protected and easier to manage.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Additional Domain Extensions Suggestion?](#What-is-Additional-Domain-Extensions-Suggestion?)
- [Key Benefits of Additional Domain Extensions Suggestion](#Key-Benefits-of-Additional-Domain-Extensions-Suggestion)
- [How to Use the Additional Domain Extensions Suggestion](#How-to-Use-the-Additional-Domain-Extensions-Suggestion)
  - [1. When Purchasing a Domain](#1.%C2%A0When-Purchasing-a-Domain)
  - [2. When Managing an Existing Domain](#2.%C2%A0When-Managing-an-Existing-Domain%C2%A0)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Additional Domain Extensions Suggestion?**

Additional Domain Extensions suggestion is a HighLevel feature designed to help you secure your brand by recommending popular alternative domain endings when you purchase or manage a domain. By automatically suggesting extra TLDs, this feature not only minimizes impersonation risks but also simplifies the process of securing all relevant domain extensions with a single, transparent transaction.

---

## **Key Benefits of Additional Domain Extensions Suggestion**

This feature offers several advantages that enhance both security and convenience:

- **Brand Protection:** Safeguard your brand by acquiring multiple domain extensions, reducing the likelihood of competitors or fraudsters exploiting similar names.
- **User Convenience:** Enjoy an intuitive, streamlined domain purchase experience with smart, automated recommendations.
- **Cost Transparency:** See the total extra cost for any additional domain extensions upfront, ensuring complete transparency in your purchase.
- **Competitive Advantage:** Secure critical extensions that reinforce your online presence and prevent impersonation.

---

## **How to Use the Additional Domain Extensions Suggestion**

HighLevel now allows you to purchase **additional domain extensions** either when **buying a new domain** or while **managing an existing one**. This feature helps protect your brand by securing multiple extensions of your domain name. Follow the steps below:

### **1.****When Purchasing a Domain**

1. Log in to your sub-account.
2. Click on **Settings** in the left-hand menu.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/YDsWLpuEsdBw8PKu0Wxs+/Screen+Shot+2025-08-18+at+10.59.17+PM.png)
3. Scroll down and select the **Domains** tab.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/hqWEypTz2rRS221Njfzu+/Screen+Shot+2025-08-18+at+11.01.50+PM.png)
4. Click the **Purchase / Transfer Domain** button.
5. In the search bar, enter the domain name you want to buy.
6. From the results, click **Buy** next to your desired domain.
7. A window labeled **Confirm Domain Purchase** will appear.
8. You’ll see a section titled **“Protect your brand from competitors — grab these extensions too.”**
9. Up to **three alternative extensions** (e.g., .net, .uk, .org) will be suggested.
10. Click on an extension you want to add, then click **Add for $X.XX** (price will vary by domain).
11. Repeat for each additional extension you’d like.
12. The modal will display the total cost of:

    - Your primary domain.
    - Any selected additional extensions.
13. Check the box **“I agree to terms and conditions.”**
14. Click **Pay $X.XX** to finalize the purchase of your domain and selected extensions.  
      
    ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/Dh1i0jqF4dQINib23FPI+/GIF+Recording+2025-08-18+at+11.02.56+PM.gif)

### **2.****When Managing an Existing Domain**

1. Log in to your sub-account.
2. Click on **Settings.**  
     
   **![](https://jumpshare.com/share/YDsWLpuEsdBw8PKu0Wxs+/Screen+Shot+2025-08-18+at+10.59.17+PM.png)**
3. Click on the**Domains**tab.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/hqWEypTz2rRS221Njfzu+/Screen+Shot+2025-08-18+at+11.01.50+PM.png)
4. You’ll see a **list of your registered or transferred domains**.
5. Find the domain you want to add new extensions to.
6. Click **Manage** next to it.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/UbWETuWCAfrnF2SDR6mh+/Screen+Shot+2025-08-18+at+11.11.20+PM.png)
7. At the top of the domain management screen, you’ll see a message: **“Protect your brand from competitors by purchasing your domain name with suggested extensions for $X."**
8. Click on **Buy Now.**  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/uWl1fyZGk3F5SQxsGAqQ+/Screen+Shot+2025-08-18+at+11.12.52+PM.png)
9. The **Confirm Domain Purchase** modal will appear.
10. Select the additional extensions (e.g., .net, .uk) and click on **Add for $X.XX**button.  
      
    ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/x6RtF3pD91MAKMDtJvb1+/Screen+Shot+2025-08-18+at+11.19.51+PM.png)
11. Check the **Terms and Conditions** box.
12. Click **Pay $X.XX** to complete the purchase of the additional extensions.  
      
    ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/gX6iT29pOuYoj4vffnSQ+/Screen+Shot+2025-08-18+at+11.21.47+PM.png)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: How many additional domain extensions can I purchase at a time?**

You can select up to 3 additional domain suggestions along with your main domain.

**Q: Is it mandatory to purchase the recommended additional extensions?**

No, you can opt to purchase a standalone domain without selecting any additional extensions.

**Q: Will there be extra costs for these additional domain extensions?**

Yes, the extra cost is clearly displayed during the purchase process, providing complete pricing transparency.

**Q: Can I add additional domain extensions to an already owned domain?**

Absolutely – if you own a domain, a “Protect your brand” banner in the domain details page allows you to purchase additional extensions.

****Q: Will adding extensions impact DNS for my current primary domain?****

No. Purchasing an additional extension creates a separate domain with its own DNS zone. Its records are managed independently inside HighLevel and do not change the DNS of your existing primary domain unless you explicitly edit records or set up redirects.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [How to Purchase Domain Step by Step](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003610)
- [Transfer and Manage External Domains Through Domain Dashboard](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005134)
- [Configure & Connect Purchased Domains](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004674)
- [How to Manage All of Your Domains Centrally in LC Domains](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005857)

title_en: Getting started with Countdown Timer
source_md:
#### Introducing the Countdown Timer to boost all your marketing activities towards more conversion

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is a Countdown Timer?](#What-is-a-Countdown-Timer?)
- [Benefits of Countdown Timers -](#Benefits-of-Countdown-Timers--)
- [When should you add a timer?](#When-should-you-add-a-timer?%C2%A0)
- [Types of Countdown Timers](#Types-of-Countdown-Timers)
- [Key Considerations](#Key-Considerations)
- [Countdown Timer Dynamic Links](#Countdown-Timer-Dynamic-Links)
- [Steps to Create a Countdown Timer](#Steps-to-Create-a-Countdown-Timer)

### **What is a Countdown Timer?**

A countdown timer visually counts down to a specific deadline, creating urgency for users to act before time runs out. It’s commonly used for sales, launches, or limited-time offers.

### **Benefits of Countdown Timers -**

- **Creates Urgency**: Encourages immediate action by showing time ticking down.
- **Increases Conversions**: Timers can boost conversion rates by up to 27%, according to VWO.
- **Promotes Exclusivity**: Highlights limited-time offers, making deals feel special.
- **Enhances Engagement**: Keeps users on your page longer, increasing interaction.

### **When should you add a timer?**

Countdown timers are incredibly versatile and can enhance various types of emails:

1. **Retail**: Often used to indicate the time remaining for special promotions or to highlight delivery deadlines, such as “Two hours left for next-day delivery.”
2. **Fashion**: Employed to build anticipation for new collections, events, or fashion shows.
3. **Travel**: Can show the remaining time before departure.
4. **Media**: Used to remind subscribers of the remaining time before their subscription expires.
5. **Events**: Effective for counting down to an event or the end of ticket pre-sales.
6. **Non-profits**: Can create urgency for donation matching opportunities with a timer.
7. **Transactional Emails**: Used to build excitement for upcoming events, as demonstrated in emails to attendees of Litmus Live 2022.

In each case, countdown timers help drive action, create urgency, or build excitement, depending on the context.

### **Types of Countdown Timers**

1. **Fixed Timer**

   - **Description**: Counts down to a set date and time. Ideal for events like Black Friday sales or product launches.
   - **Usage**: "Black Friday Sale ends in 2 days!"
2. **Recurring Timer**

   - **Description**: Resets after reaching zero, useful for ongoing promotions.
   - **Usage**: "Weekly classes countdown" (resets weekly for the next class).
3. **Dynamic Timer**

   - **Description**: Personalized for each user based on actions, like email opens.
   - **Usage**: "Your special offer expires in 1 hour" (based on user behavior).

### **Key Considerations**

1. **Design and Style**: Ensure the timer aligns with your brand's look and feel.
2. **Placement**: Position the timer prominently, such as at the top of an email or landing page.
3. **Redirections**: Set up functional links for both active and expired states.
4. **Consistency**: Keep timers consistent across emails and websites for authenticity.
5. **Expiry Image**: Use an image or message to inform users when the timer ends.

### **Countdown Timer Dynamic Links**

- **Active Timer Link**: This link directs users to the page where they can take advantage of the active offer, such as the offer or checkout page. It's best to use the same countdown timer on this page so that when the timer expires, users are automatically redirected to the expired page.
- **Expired Timer Link**: This link takes users to a page indicating that the timer has run out. In emails, users will see an expired image, which links to the expired page. In funnels, the expired page will automatically display once the timer ends.

Ensure you add both the Links before saving to ensure the dynamic links work.

### **Steps to Create a Countdown Timer**

1. **Navigate to Marketing**: Go to the "Marketing" section and select "Countdown Timer."![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155031337258/original/zV5txsC5m2hg65VMXt2tI6V_4Yk0hHItoA.png?1724150329)
2. **Click on New**: Click the "New" button to start creating your timer.![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155031337343/original/XjDFqVhejxQWHaeOqyfrE9ypFhKUiMTTUg.png?1724150378)
3. **Select a Template**: Choose a design template and click "Continue with this template."![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155031337585/original/uvwAYBuvT1CvoLJCf8QA1emvvzUhSidoww.png?1724150546)
4. **Choose Timer Type**: Select the type of timer you want: Fixed, Recurring, or Dynamic.  
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155031337821/original/8x18eyi1PnHs7SjJu0M6sNQ-Ax7aa944og.png?1724150681)
5. **Configure Timer Details**:

   - **Fixed Timer**: Set the end date and time.
   - **Recurring Timer**: Define the countdown duration and number of loops.
6. **Add Links**:

   - **Active Link**: Specify the URL users will be directed to while the timer is active.
   - **Expired Link**: Specify the URL users will land on after the timer expires.![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155031337968/original/e4SnFLU5se3mR6nYeq0RCQICIX2fEmgnOw.png?1724150756)
7. **Customize Styling**: Adjust the timer’s appearance, including colors, fonts, expiry image, and time display format.![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155031338064/original/xRfLAe-LTV63XhGIdwTpqIRZpvJZuoBuIw.png?1724150803)![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155031338193/original/7vG6I1JB-KJHIQh1UWhSCqFjFQgLn08qfw.png?1724150877)
8. **Rename Timer**: Give your timer a descriptive name by click at the top![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155031338323/original/-CxkoTh_RDNQmaXGAChFBlNxgANuqClDBg.png?1724150947)
9. **Save**: Click "Save" to finalise and activate your countdown timer.  
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155031338406/original/EZo12Y7CE8QYHbxxLIUk-wCPFEvxoaGGzw.png?1724150981)

**Quick Links:**  
**[1. How to use Countdown Timer in Emails](https://help.gohighlevel.com/a/solutions/articles/155000003101?portalId=48000045315)**  
**[2. Syn your Countdown Timer in Websites and Funnels](https://help.gohighlevel.com/a/solutions/articles/155000003102?portalId=48000045315)**  
**[3. How to copy code of a timer?](https://help.gohighlevel.com/a/solutions/articles/155000003103?portalId=48000045315)**

title_en: Using Custom Font in Funnels And Websites
source_md:
Funnels And Websites Builder now supports custom fonts, eliminating the need for CSS hacks or external hosting. Designers and marketers can maintain brand consistency directly in funnels and websites. This articles shows how agencies can upload and manage their own font files natively within the site builder, improving platform usability and brand fidelity.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Custom Font Support in Funnels & Websites?](#What-is-Custom-Font-Support-in-Funnels-&-Websites?)
- [Key Benefits of Custom Font Support in Funnels & Websites](#Key-Benefits-of-Custom-Font-Support-in-Funnels-&-Websites)
- [Custom Fonts Modal](#Custom-Fonts-Modal)
- [Supported Font Formats](#Supported-Font-Formats)
- [Media Storage Integration](#Media-Storage-Integration)
- [How To Apply Custom Font in Funnels & Websites](#How-To-Apply-Custom-Font-in-Funnels-&-Websites)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

## **What is Custom Font Support in Funnels & Websites?**

Custom Font Support is a native HighLevel feature that allows you to upload, store, and apply your own font files directly inside the Funnels and Websites Builder. By removing the need for external font hosting or @font-face code, the feature gives designers and agencies full control over brand typography while streamlining page creation.

---

## **Key Benefits of Custom Font Support in Funnels & Websites**

- **Brand Consistency:** Maintain identical typography across every funnel and webpage for a unified customer experience.
- **No CSS Required:** Apply custom fonts entirely through the builder—saving time and avoiding code errors.
- **Faster Workflow:** Upload once, then select your font from the dropdown in any text element.
- **Flexible File Support:** Use industry-standard formats and treat each style (e.g., Bold, Italic) as its own pick-list option for precise styling.

---

## **Custom Fonts Modal**

The Custom Fonts Modal centralizes font management so you can add or update typefaces in seconds.

- Access the modal by clicking **Upload Fonts** within any font dropdown.
- Drag-and-drop or browse to select files from your device.
- Review existing uploads and remove outdated versions with one click.

*![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155051517752/original/MXagHZw8BcG6wGVHEVVfhorEiWcJTPVU2Q.png?1755083536)*

---

## **Supported Font Formats**

HighLevel accepts the most common font standards, ensuring compatibility with professional type libraries.

- `.ttf` – TrueType Font
- `.otf` – OpenType Font
- `.woff` – Web Open Font Format
- `.woff2` – Compressed Web Open Font Format

---

## **Media Storage Integration**

Store fonts securely in HighLevel so your team can reuse them across accounts and projects.

- Uploaded fonts are automatically saved to **Media Storage** for easy access.
- Delete or rename fonts from Media Storage without breaking live pages—as long as the file name remains unchanged.
- Centralized storage keeps your workspace organized when managing multiple brand assets.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155051814523/original/TDxH-2yIs6Zjpy9gnodFrDvroSBmkZ2h1A.png?1755520917)

---

## **How To Apply Custom Font in Funnels & Websites**

1. Enable the Feature in **Labs:**  
     
   Go to Agency **Settings → Labs**  
     
   Locate**Custom Font Support for Funnels and websites"** and click on Manage.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155051814914/original/bCmNfgWKl6E13rjh_CFbrfJvIFjQmnBy1g.gif?1755521165)
2. Switch to the**Sub-Account**and **Open the Builder** of the **Funnel step or Webpage** you want to edit.
3. Select the **text element** (paragraph/heading/rich text)  
     
   In the right panel go to Typography → Typography type → Custom Font → Upload Fonts → Upload from Device.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155051815637/original/SSEf60Ib31VnIEgOPOtIBmjYH9opUFMR5Q.gif?1755521559)
4. **Upload Your Font File**:  
     
   Pick a `.ttf`, `.otf`, `.woff`, or `.woff2` file from your device or Media Storage. The Custom Fonts Modal will confirm once the upload is complete.
5. **Apply the New Font**:  
     
   Your font now appears in the dropdown. Select it, then adjust size, weight, or style as needed.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155051815647/original/deJ9w5MngZR24ORWAIPVXw8v9NzR2R2BmA.gif?1755521570)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q:****How do I enable Custom Font Support if it’s behind Labs?**  
Go to **Agency** **Settings → Labs**, locate **Custom Font Support for Funnels and Websites**, and toggle it on.

**Q:****Which file types can I upload?**  
HighLevel supports `.ttf`, `.otf`, `.woff`, and `.woff2` formats.

**Q:****Can I use the same custom font in both funnels and websites?**  
Yes—any font you upload becomes available across Funnels and Websites within the same sub-account.

**Q:****Do I need CSS to apply my custom font?**  
No. Everything is handled inside the builder—no additional code required.

**Q:****My font isn’t displaying after upload—what should I check?**  
Ensure you’ve applied the correct font family in the Typography panel and cleared your browser cache. Also confirm that the file name hasn’t been changed in Media Storage.

**Q:****Is there a limit to how many fonts I can store?**  
There’s no hard limit, but keeping your Media Storage organized and removing unused fonts is recommended for faster load times.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [Complete Guide to Media Storage](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000002707-complete-guide-to-media-storage-)
- [Media Storage & File Upload Limits](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001216629-media-storage-file-upload-limits)
- [Font Weight in Funnels and Websites](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000002772-font-weight-in-funnels-and-websites)
- [How to Create a Brand Board & Design Kit in HighLevel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000003136-how-to-create-a-brand-board)
- [Using the New Revamped Sidebar in Funnel & Website Builder](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005422-using-the-right-sidebar-in-funnel-website-builder)
- [How to Use Rich Text Elements in Funnels & Websites](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005817-how-to-use-rich-text-elements-in-funnels-websites)

title_en: Funnels & Websites | Creating Categories in the Navigation Menu
source_md:
This article shows you how to create drop-down categories in your website or funnel’s navigation menu by nesting menu items under parent items. This helps organize your navigation and improves the user experience with cleaner, more intuitive menus.

[동영상](https://www.loom.com/embed/c8aa1109b476416cb95e93c3a8edd1d2)

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What Are Categories in the Navigation Menu?](#What-Are-Categories-in-the-Navigation-Menu?)
- [Key Benefits of Navigation Menu Categories](#Key-Benefits-of-Navigation-Menu-Categories)
- [How Navigation Menu Categories Work](#How-Navigation-Menu-Categories-Work)
- [How to Create Categories in the Navigation Menu](#How-to-Create-Categories-in-the-Navigation-Menu)
- [Previewing and Organizing Menu Items](#Previewing-and-Organizing-Menu-Items)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

## **What Are Categories in the Navigation Menu?**

Navigation Menu categories group related links beneath a parent menu item so visitors can access them from a dropdown. This structure is useful when several pages belong to the same topic or area and displaying every page as a top-level menu item would make the navigation crowded.

A navigation category consists of:

- **Parent Item:** The top-level navigation item that contains the dropdown.
- **Sub Item:** A nested menu item displayed beneath the parent.
- **Dropdown Menu:** The menu visitors see when they interact with the parent item.

For example, a business could use **Services** as the parent item and place **Consulting**, **Coaching**, and **Training** underneath it as sub items.

Standard Navigation Menus support one level of nested menu items.

---

## **Key Benefits of Navigation Menu Categories**

Organizing related links into dropdown categories makes it easier for visitors to understand your site's structure while reducing visual clutter. Categories are especially useful when a website or funnel contains several related destinations that should remain grouped together.

- **Cleaner Navigation**: Declutters the main navigation bar by nesting related links
- **Improved UX**: Users can find grouped pages quickly and intuitively
- **Drag-and-Drop Simplicity**: Build drop-down menus easily with no code
- **Flexible Structure**: Rearrange or update categories by dragging items
- **Responsive-Friendly**: Menus adapt to desktop and mobile layouts

---

## **How Navigation Menu Categories Work**

Navigation categories use a parent-and-child relationship to determine which items appear at the top level and which items appear inside a dropdown. Understanding this hierarchy makes it easier to organize the menu correctly before publishing the page.

A standard Navigation Menu can contain:

- Top-level menu items
- Parent items that contain dropdowns
- Multiple sub items beneath the same parent
- One level of nested sub items

When a menu item is nested beneath another item, HighLevel displays it as part of that parent's dropdown menu.

You can create sub items using the available **Add Sub Item** option or organize existing menu items using drag-and-drop indentation.

> **Note:** Standard Navigation Menu dropdowns support one level of nested menu items. If you need a larger or more visual navigation structure, consider using a Mega Menu.

---

## **How to Create Categories in the Navigation Menu**

Creating categories requires defining a parent item and then adding or nesting related menu items underneath it. Building the hierarchy correctly ensures visitors see the intended dropdown structure when they use your navigation.

1. Open your funnel or website in the builder
2. Select the **Navigation Menu**element in your layout  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155050091978/original/f97PmFrGYYKhDEy_PFu2n_EU1o2yH6P2pQ.png?1752860966)
3. In the right-hand panel, click **Add Item → New Menu Item**  
     
   **![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155050091935/original/tB7qSTdcg8RCz0FfRbdRau_LfxdReoI78g.png?1752860887)**
4. **Name the item** something descriptive
5. Drag and drop the new item underneath a parent item (e.g., “Home”). When it indents slightly, that means it’s nested and will appear as a drop-down  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155050092023/original/vqRAKvDU-o5f-NvmmZIFg7lOX5kgqK_nZg.png?1752861022)
6. Click **Save**then **Preview** and hover over the parent item to see the drop-down appear

---

## **Previewing and Organizing Menu Items**

When reviewing the menu:

- Confirm each sub item appears under the correct parent.
- Verify each menu item's destination.
- Drag menu items to change their order.
- Rename items when labels are unclear or too long.
- Remove menu items that are no longer needed.
- Preview both desktop and mobile layouts.
- Test each dropdown before publishing.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I create more than one level of drop-downs?**  
No, To keep navigation user-friendly, especially on mobile, it is limited to one layer of nested pages.

**Q: Can menu items link to sections within the same page?**  
Yes. Use anchor links to scroll to sections. For more info, see [Scroll to Elements or Sections in Websites or Funnels](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001158589).

**Q: How do I remove or rename items?**  
Click on the 3 dots next to the item in the sidebar. Edit the name or click the **Delete** button to delete.

**Q: Is this process the same in funnels and websites?**  
Yes, the Navigation Menu element behaves the same across both.

**Q: Is the category workflow the same for Funnels and Websites?**

Yes. Funnels and Websites use the same core builder experience for Navigation Menu configuration.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Navigation Menus in the HighLevel Funnel Builder](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48000986314)
- [Navigation Menu Revamp with Mega Navigation Support](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004192)
- [Prebuilt Mega Menu Headers](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004977)
- [Scroll to Elements or Sections in Websites or Funnels](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001158589)
- [Customizing HighLevel Menus: A Guide to Custom Menu Links](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001185767)
- [Sites Overview](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000001633)

Dashboard templates streamline the process of replicating dashboards across different sub-accounts, saving time and effort. What Are Dashboard Templates?

Dashboard templates are reusable frameworks designed to replicate dashboards across multiple sub-accounts. By saving an existing dashboard as a template, you can maintain consistency across your accounts while significantly reducing setup time. Templates make it easy to standardize reporting and ensure every account has access to essential metrics and visualizations.

Why Should You Use Dashboard Templates?

Using dashboard templates helps solve common challenges in managing dashboards across multiple accounts. These include:

    •    **Time-Saving:**Eliminates the need to manually recreate dashboards for each sub-account.

    •    **Consistency:** Ensures uniformity in data representation across accounts.

    •    **Scalability:** Streamlines processes for agencies managing multiple clients.

    •    **Efficiency:** Simplifies updates and modifications by centralizing dashboard templates.

source_md:
Stay on top of your social media scheduling with HighLevel’s new in-app notification banners for disconnected accounts. This feature helps you avoid missed posts by alerting you in real time whenever a connected social account loses authentication, so you can reconnect and keep your content calendar running smoothly.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What are In-App Notification Banners for Disconnected Accounts?](#What-are-In-App-Notification-Banners-for-Disconnected-Accounts?)
- [Key Benefits of the Social Planner In-App Notification Banner](#Key-Benefits-of-the-Social-Planner-In-App-Notification-Banner)
- [How to Find and Act on Disconnected Account Alerts](#How-to-Find-and-Act-on-Disconnected-Account-Alerts)
  - [Step 1: Connect Your Social Accounts](#Step-1%3A%C2%A0Connect-Your-Social-Accounts)
  - [Step 2: Monitor for Notification Banners](#Step-2%3A%C2%A0Monitor-for-Notification-Banners)
  - [Step 3: Take Action to Reconnect](#Step-3%3A%C2%A0Take-Action-to-Reconnect)
- [Multi-Channel Alert System](#Multi-Channel-Alert-System)
- [Account Health Monitoring](#Account-Health-Monitoring)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What are In-App Notification Banners for Disconnected Accounts?**

The Social Planner In-App Notification Banner is a real-time alert system within HighLevel that notifies users when any of their connected social media accounts become disconnected. These banners appear directly inside the Social Planner, Launchpad, and Dashboard, providing immediate visibility and prompting users to take action to restore connections and prevent disruptions to scheduled content.

---

## **Key Benefits of the In-App Notification Banners for Disconnected Accounts**

The notification banner system offers several advantages for users managing multiple social accounts:

 

- **Instant Awareness:** Receive immediate alerts when a social account disconnects, reducing the risk of missed or failed posts.
- **Multi-Channel Alerts:** Get notified both via in-app banners and email, ensuring you never miss a critical update.
- **Platform-Specific Messaging:** See clear, tailored messages for each platform (Facebook, Instagram, Google Business Profile, LinkedIn, TikTok, Pinterest, YouTube) for easy identification and action.
- **Seamless Workflow:** Quickly reconnect accounts without leaving your workflow, minimizing downtime.
- **Improved Account Health:** Proactively manage account connections to maintain a consistent posting schedule and avoid content gaps.

---

## **How to Find and Act on Disconnected Account Alerts**

Tracking and responding to in-app notification banners is straightforward, ensuring you can act quickly to restore any disconnected accounts and keep your social content on track. 

 

### **Step 1:**Connect Your Social Accounts

- Click on **Marketing** from your account.
- Click on the **Social Planner** tab.
- Connect your desired social media accounts (Facebook, Instagram, Google Business Profile, LinkedIn, TikTok, Pinterest, YouTube).

![](https://jumpshare.com/v/0IaH7FqGdN1QUAh2P6On+/Screen+Shot+2025-06-17+at+9.58.14+PM.png)

### **Step 2:**Monitor for Notification Banners

- If any account becomes disconnected, a banner will appear at the **top of Social Planner, Launchpad, or Dashboard**.
- The banner will specify **which account and platform** require your attention.
- Each banner provides a **platform-specific message**, such as:  
    
  - “The connection for the following Social Planner Facebook page(s) has expired: [Account Name].”
  - “The connection for the following Social Planner Instagram account(s) has expired: [Account Name].”

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155048427287/original/o1ItpEmn-_zryotwKH-xU2NCGejz6KFeBg.png?1750184868)

### **Step 3:**Take Action to Reconnect

- Click on the **Re-integrate**button of the banner.
- Complete the **authentication process** for the relevant social platform.
- You will also receive an **email notification** about the disconnection, providing another prompt to take action.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155048427435/original/7xyc6mE_6izvcsJQ23yjW0pJuu-VdN2Tgg.png?1750185032)

---

## **Multi-Channel Alert System**

HighLevel’s notification system ensures you’re alerted through both in-app banners and email, maximizing the chances you’ll see and act on account disconnections before they impact your posting schedule.

- In-app banners provide immediate, visible alerts within your workflow.
- Email notifications serve as a backup, ensuring you’re informed even when not logged into HighLevel.

---

## **Account Health Monitoring**

Proactively monitoring your account connections helps ensure your scheduled posts are published without interruption and maintains the integrity of your social media strategy.

 

- Regularly check for banners.
- Reconnect accounts promptly to avoid missed posts.
- Review your email for additional alerts.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: What causes a social account to become disconnected in Social Planner?**

Disconnections typically occur due to expired authentication tokens, password changes, revoked permissions, or platform security updates.

**Q: Will I lose scheduled posts if my account disconnects?**

Scheduled posts will not be published while an account is disconnected. Once you reconnect, posting resumes as normal.

**Q: Do I get notified for all types of social accounts?**

Yes, the system supports notifications for Facebook, Instagram, Google Business Profile, LinkedIn, TikTok, Pinterest, and YouTube.

**Q: How quickly will I be notified after a disconnection?**

Notifications are sent in real time, both via in-app banners and email, as soon as a disconnection is detected.

**Q: Will other team members see the notification banner?**

Yes, all users with access to Social Planner will see the banner for disconnected accounts.

---

## **Related Articles**

 

- [Email Notification for Failed Post, Account Expired and Post Approval](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000002407)
- [Getting Started - Setup Social Planner](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005063)
- [Social Planner Statistics](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004101)
- [How to post Recurring Social Posts through the Social Planner](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000000648)

title_en: Business Profile Settings - Business Physical Address
source_md:
Your Business Physical Address is a very important component of your Business Profile. This information not only can be used when verifying your business for certain features that may need verification, but it can also be used when adding Custom Fields and Custom Values in messages, social posts, email campaigns, websites, and even funnels.

To learn more about the Business Profile Settings, including how to navigate to the settings panel, see: [Business Profile Settings Overview](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006223-business-profile-settings/preview#Where-Do-I-Find-the-Business-Profile?)

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [Business Physical Address Settings](#Business-Physical-Address-Settings)
- [Business Physical Address](#Business-Physical-Address)
- [Time Zone](#Time-Zone)
- [Platform Language](#Platform-Language)
- [Outbound Communication Language for Custom Values](#Outbound-Communication-Language-for-Custom-Values)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **Business Physical Address Settings**

These fields act as the single source of truth for location and locale preferences in HighLevel. Complete each entry carefully, matching official records where noted. After updating, save your changes and spot-check a booking page and a test email/SMS to confirm that dates, times, and formatting look correct.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155052631620/original/CQVwNnFLJykZPY6pFWDPLs7HOHaxXZ4T2w.jpg?1756414483)

---

## **Business Physical Address**

The Business Physical Address should **match the address on your EIN listing**. This information may be used to verify your business if needed.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155052631748/original/x6--PnYyPjfjHwYmMBMJXqWVqC-ebEb-nA.jpg?1756414676)

---

## **Time Zone**

Automated events within campaigns work with this field to determine when to send. You may be able to override this default timezone setting depending on the feature being used, such as workflows or email campaigns. Always check your business profile settings and the settings of the feature being used to make sure the correct time zone is selected.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155052631826/original/34gkds5drDlUx62M1c6K4vAX4AjuCG_LLQ.png?1756414850)

---

## **Platform Language**

This setting controls what language your sub-account displays in. Meaning, if you speak and read English, you would want your HighLevel sub-account to be displayed in English. If you speak and read Spanish, you would most likely want your sub-account to be displayed in Spanish.

```
Note: Checkout pages seen by payers inherit language from Platform Language. This affects hosted payment experiences across Invoices, Payment Links, Subscriptions, Manage Cards, Forms, and Course purchases.
```

The Platform Language also determines the language of default notification templates across Calendars, Services, and Rentals. New configurations receive localized defaults automatically. For existing configurations, select Reset to defaultin the relevant notification settings to load the localized version. Customized templates are not automatically overwritten.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155052632745/original/F8NSc17Feejb6xvLtszQGb9QUFHAjDa7LA.jpg?1756417290)

---

## **Outbound Communication Language for Custom Values**

When you are sending Custom Fields and Custom Values in messages, HighLevel needs to know how you want that information to be displayed to the person or persons receiving the message. Selecting the proper language here will make sure that when you send a message with Custom Fields or Custom Values, or use Custom Fields and Custom Values anywhere else such as in websites and funnels, that the correct language is being displayed.
