title_en: Reusing Protected Assets Within Your Agency (Snapshots)
source_md:
Protected assets can now be reused and redistributed freely **within your own agency** through snapshots. Previously, once a snapshot with protected assets was imported, those assets were locked from any further use—even for purely internal builds. That restriction has been lifted at the only boundary that matters: **leaving your agency.**

---

### **TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- Overview
- What's New
- Why It Matters
- How It Works
  - 1. Building or refreshing a snapshot with protected assets
  - 2. Sharing a snapshot that contains protected assets
  - 3. Identifying protected (non-redistributable) snapshots
- Frequently Asked Questions
- Related Articles

---

## **Overview**

If you've ever imported a snapshot containing **protected assets** (previously called “IP Protected”), you know the old limitation: you could load it into a sub-account, but you couldn't reuse those assets anywhere else in your agency.

We've lifted that restriction. Protected assets can now be **reused and distributed within your agency** through snapshots. The protection now applies only when assets attempt to leave your agency—sharing or reselling to another agency remains blocked, so the original creator's rights are always respected.

---

## **What's New**

- **Use asset-protected snapshots within your agency without restriction.** Reuse protected assets across your own sub-accounts and snapshots freely.
- **The restriction still applies at the agency boundary.** Sharing or reselling protected assets to another agency remains blocked.
- **Mixed snapshots can now be shared.** If a snapshot mixes protected and non-protected assets, only the protected assets are held back when you share—everything else goes through normally.
- **See what's restricted before you share.** Check exactly which assets in a snapshot are marked as protected, so there are no surprises.
- **Protection follows the assets correctly** wherever they travel within your agency—import them, build from them, or pass them to another sub-account, and the system always knows what's protected and what isn't.

---

## **Why It Matters**

Before, importing protected assets into your agency didn't give you full use of them. Any snapshot you built afterward—even for purely internal use—was blocked. It didn't matter that the assets never left your agency; the restriction treated internal reuse the same as reselling.

The fix: the restriction now applies **only at the boundary that matters—leaving your agency.** Inside your agency, protected assets are fully yours to build with.

- **Reuse protected assets freely across your agency** — build new sub-accounts and snapshots from assets you've imported, without hitting restrictions.
- **No more dead ends** — a snapshot with protected assets in it is no longer locked from further use just because of that.
- **Creators stay protected** — sharing or reselling protected assets to another agency is still blocked.
- **Total clarity** — know exactly which assets are protected and where the boundary applies before you share anything.

---

## **How It Works**

### **1. Building or refreshing a snapshot with protected assets**

When you **Create** or **Refresh** a snapshot, protected assets now appear in the asset list and can be **selected and included** for use within your agency. A green shield icon marks each protected asset. Hovering over the shield shows:

*“Protected asset — usable in your agency, excluded from snapshot sharing.”*  
  
*![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155079639340/original/jMp8PxMz9PzXRkG8mdI878WGVK59b5stOw.png?1788098876)*

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155079639377/original/Ya9bCehwbJKeozSoXune6xDecnPI_ZKwtw.png?1788098897)

### **2. Sharing a snapshot that contains protected assets**

When you share a snapshot that mixes protected and non-protected assets, HighLevel shows a **“Some assets can't be shared”** review screen. It clearly states how many assets are protected and excluded, and how many shareable assets will actually be included in the share.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155079639423/original/E7foOi4Auy87TrfEgsQWdNFHXG4a6NkMrA.png?1788098960)

Expand any group to see each asset labeled as either **Shareable** or **Restricted**, so you know exactly what will leave your agency before you continue.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155079639427/original/ynk1V7vKC42k6ZVMz8XJE7wwx_KblmGv4Q.png?1788098976)

### **3. Identifying protected (non-redistributable) snapshots**

In your Snapshots list, snapshots that contain protected assets display a shield indicator. Hovering shows: *“This snapshot's assets cannot be redistributed.”* This helps you tell at a glance which snapshots carry protection that will apply at the agency boundary.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155079639457/original/SayeIS7KD2v9iLiKcpL_pBNxONlmmWLmhA.png?1788099028)

---

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: Can I now reuse protected assets I imported in other sub-accounts within my agency?**  
Yes. Protected assets you've imported can be reused across your own sub-accounts and snapshots without restriction, as long as they stay within your agency.

**Q: Can I share or resell protected assets to another agency?**  
No. Sharing or reselling protected assets to another agency remains blocked. Protection is enforced at the point where assets leave your agency.

**Q: What happens if my snapshot contains both protected and non-protected assets?**  
You can still share it. Only the protected assets are excluded from the share—all shareable assets go through normally. You'll see a review screen listing exactly what's included and what's held back.

**Q: How do I know which assets in a snapshot are protected before sharing?**  
The share review screen (“Some assets can't be shared”) lists every asset grouped by type and labels each as **Shareable** or **Restricted**, along with a count of protected vs. shareable assets.

**Q: Does the protection carry over correctly when I build new snapshots or move assets between sub-accounts?**  
Yes. Protection follows the assets wherever they travel within your agency—whether you import them, build from them, or pass them to another sub-account—so the system always knows what's protected and what isn't.

---

title_en: Workflow Trigger - Coupon Code Expired
source_md:
Easily automate actions when a coupon code reaches its expiration date and becomes inactive. This article walks you through everything you need to know, from setup to key benefits, so you can seamlessly trigger workflows the moment a coupon expires. Perfect for promotional wrap-ups, customer follow-ups, and internal alerts.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is the Coupon Code Expired Workflow Trigger](#What-is-the-Coupon-Code-Expired-Workflow-Trigger)
- [Key Benefits of Coupon Code Expired Workflow Trigger](#Key-Benefits-of-Coupon-Code-Expired-Workflow-Trigger)
- [Configuring Coupon Code Expired Workflow Trigger](#Configuring-Coupon-Code-Expired-Workflow-Trigger)
- [Available Filters](#Available-Filters)
- [Recommended Workflow Actions for Expired Coupons](#Recommended-Workflow-Actions-for-Expired-Coupons)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is the Coupon Code Expired Workflow Trigger**

The **Coupon Code Expired** trigger fires when a coupon code reaches its scheduled expiration date and becomes inactive. It’s a great tool for marketers and sales teams to manage time-bound promotions and follow up with customers who missed out, replace expired coupons, or notify internal teams when offers are no longer active.

---

## **Key Benefits of Coupon Code Expired Workflow Trigger**

- **Instant Alerts:** Inform sales, support, or marketing when key coupons expire so teams can react right away
- **Customer Re‑engagement:** Send follow‑up offers or extensions to shoppers who missed out, boosting conversion opportunities
- **Campaign Cleanup:** Archive tags, close opportunities, or stop ads automatically when coupon expires to keep data tidy
- **Consistent Customer Experience:** Prevent confusion by confirming that an offer is no longer valid before customers try to use it again

---

## **Configuring Coupon Code Expired Workflow Trigger**

To set up this trigger, follow these steps inside your workflow builder:

#### **Step 1:**Add the Trigger to Your Workflow

- Navigate to **Automation > Workflows**
- Either create a new workflow or edit an existing one
- In the workflow builder, click **+ Add New Trigger**to get started

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155050551956/original/KS83c0dS2PvtlP4YCrV05IBN_GsjzQallg.png?1753727277)

#### **Step 2:**Choose the Trigger Type

From the list of available triggers, scroll to the **Payments** section and select **Coupon Code Expired**

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155050551986/original/iS9zpAvHNi_rsInKm1vVz0rroVNwkUHKVA.png?1753727377)

#### **Step 3:** Name Your Trigger

- Provide a descriptive name in the**Workflow Trigger Name** field to keep your workflow organized
- Example: *SummerSaleCouponExpired*

`![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155050552764/original/FcSxv_3jNMqPs69syQRA2cMIuKgOQyp5SA.png?1753729190)`

#### **Step 4:**Apply Filters to Target Specific Scenarios

- After naming the trigger, you can apply filters to narrow down exactly when this workflow should fire
- To add filters, click **+ Add Filters**
- Each filter comes with specific operators to precisely target the conditions you care about. [Click Here to See List of Available Filters](#Available-Filters)

### 

#### **Step 5:** Save and Build the Workflow

- Once your trigger and filters are configured, click **Save Trigger** and start adding your desired actions to the workflow
- When finished, use **Test Workflow** to confirm everything’s working as expected, then **Publish** the workflow to activate it

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155050552860/original/x4q_5CI9nIOpvsgrNMWld-e8aXcCFPqaPA.png?1753729421)

---

## **Available Filters**

|  |  |  |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Filter | Operator(s) | Input Type |
| Coupon Code | Is Any Of / Is Empty / Is None Of / Is Not Empty | Multi-Select Dropdown of Active Coupon Codes |
| Coupon Name | Is Any Of / Is Empty / Is None Of / Is Not Empty | Multi-Select Dropdown of Active Coupon Names |
| Coupon Type | Is / Is Not / Is Empty / Is Not Empty | Single-Select Dropdown (Amount vs Percentage) |

---

## **Recommended Workflow Actions for Expired Coupons**

Once your **Coupon Code Expired** trigger is active, consider adding actions like:

- **Send Email:** Notify customers that their coupon expired and offer a new promotion
- **Internal Notification:** Alert your sales or marketing team when key coupons expire
- **Add Tag:** Apply a tag to the contact for follow-ups or segmentation (e.g., `MissedPromo`)
- **Create/Update Opportunity:** Route contacts who missed redemptions into a nurture sequence
- **Send SMS:** Deliver a quick follow-up offer or coupon extension for select customers

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: When exactly does this trigger fire?**  
It fires when a coupon’s scheduled expiration date is reached and the coupon automatically becomes inactive.

**Q: Can I target specific types of coupons?**  
Yes, use the *Coupon Type* filter to target *Percentage* or *Fixed Amount* coupons.

**Q: What happens if I don’t apply any filters?**  
The workflow will trigger for any coupon that expires. To narrow it down, apply filters like *Coupon Code Is* or *Coupon Name Contains*.

**Q: Can I send different actions for different coupons?**  
Yes, by setting up separate workflows with different *Coupon Code* or *Coupon Type* filters, you can run unique actions for each.

**Q: Will this trigger fire if a customer tries to redeem an already‑expired coupon?**  
No. The trigger only fires when the coupon moves from active to expired status, not on failed redemption attempts.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [How to Create Coupons for Products](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001224172)
- [Coupon Application on Subscription Products](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004886)
- [Workflow Trigger - Coupon Code Redeemed](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005658)
- [Workflow Trigger - Coupon Redemption Limit Reached](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005660)
- [Workflow Trigger - Coupon Code Applied](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005641)

title_en: Conversations - Snippets
source_md:
Conversations • Snippets • Reusable Messaging

Create and Use Snippets in Conversations

HighLevel Snippets let teams save reusable text and email content for frequently used messages. Snippets can include supported personalization, helping teams respond faster while keeping communication consistent. From Conversations, users can create, organize, search, and insert Snippets without repeatedly writing the same message.

What You'll Learn

Learn how to create Text and Email Snippets, manage user permissions, organize reusable content, and insert Snippets directly into Conversations.

Important

The current HiRise Snippets experience is automatically enabled and the classic Snippets layout has been retired. Users accessing Snippets through Conversations need **Conversations → View & manage conversation** permission.

# What Are Snippets in Conversations?

Snippets are reusable text or email messages that can be quickly inserted into customer conversations. HighLevel supports separate **Text Snippets** and **Email Snippets**, allowing teams to prepare content for the channel where it will be used.

Snippets can also include supported personalization such as **Custom Values** and **Trigger Links**.

Common uses include:

- Appointment reminders and follow-ups
- Frequently asked questions
- Lead follow-ups
- Support responses
- Business hours and instructions
- Frequently reused email content

## Key Benefits of Using Snippets

Snippets reduce repetitive typing while giving teams a centralized library of reusable messaging that can be updated and reused as communication needs change.

- **Save Time:** Reuse common responses instead of rewriting them.
- **Improve Consistency:** Give team members access to standardized messaging.
- **Personalize Responses:** Add supported Custom Values to reusable content.
- **Stay Organized:** Use folders, search, and filters to manage Snippets.
- **Edit Before Sending:** Review and adjust inserted content before sending it to a contact.

## Prerequisites and Permissions

Snippets inside Conversations depend on the user's Conversations permission. Checking this permission first can quickly resolve cases where the Snippets tab or composer option is missing.

- Snippets are managed within the relevant **Sub-Account**.
- The HiRise Snippets interface is automatically enabled.
- Users need **Conversations → View & manage conversation** permission.

### Give a User Access to Snippets

The user's Conversations permissions control whether they can access the Conversations workspace and its Snippets tools.

1. From the **Sub-Account View**, click **Settings**.
2. Select **Users**.
3. Select the team member you want to update.
4. Open **Roles & Permissions**.
5. Select **Conversations**.
6. Enable **View & manage conversation**.
7. Click **Save**.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081373450/original/-VRLF3lP5ENMkTdEFmfjgwJXYyEgoRHsHA.png?1789861346)

## How To Create a Snippet

Creating a Snippet gives your team reusable content that can be searched, organized, and inserted whenever the same type of communication is needed.

1. From the **Sub-Account View**, click **Conversations**.
2. Select **Snippets** at the top of the page.
3. Click **+ New Snippet**.
4. Select **Add Text Snippet** or **Add Email Snippet**.
5. Enter a descriptive name.
6. Add the message content.
7. Add supported **Custom Values** or a **Trigger Link** when needed.
8. Review the available preview or test option.
9. Click **Save**.

![HiRise Snippets dashboard showing New Folder and New Snippet with Text and Email Snippet options](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155056243868/original/sK2i8lnlVoluWHqwbM9WF7TbQVsjM5sfhQ.png?1760702857=)

**Alternate Access:** Snippets can also be accessed from **Marketing → Snippets**.

## How To Organize and Manage Snippets

Keeping your Snippet library organized helps team members find approved content quickly and reduces the chance of outdated or duplicate messages being reused.

From **Conversations → Snippets**, you can:

- Use **Search** to find a Snippet by name or keyword.
- Filter the list by supported Snippet type.
- Click **New Folder** to group related Snippets.
- Use the **three-dot menu (⋮)** to move, edit, duplicate, or delete a Snippet.

Folders can be organized around areas such as Sales, Support, Appointments, Billing, or FAQs.

## How To Use a Snippet in Conversations

Inserting a Snippet quickly populates prepared content while still allowing the user to review, personalize, or edit the message before it is sent.

1. Go to **Conversations**.
2. Open the contact conversation.
3. Select the appropriate messaging channel.
4. Click the **Snippets** icon in the message composer.
5. Browse folders or search for the Snippet.
6. Select the Snippet.
7. Review the populated content and supported dynamic information.
8. Make any necessary changes.
9. Send the message.

![Conversation composer showing the Snippets picker for selecting reusable message content](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081372383/original/-u4VGvyjoGhCqJQXeRqtHysHub-KsrCjYg.png?1789854576)

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What is the difference between a Text Snippet and an Email Snippet?

They are separate reusable content types. Use a Text Snippet for text-based messaging and an Email Snippet for reusable email content.

Q: Where can I access Snippets?

Go to **Sub-Account View → Conversations → Snippets**. Snippets can also be accessed from **Marketing → Snippets**.

Q: Do I need to enable HiRise Snippets in Labs?

No. The HiRise Snippets page is automatically enabled, and the classic Snippets layout has been retired.

Q: Can I personalize a Snippet?

Yes. Snippets support Custom Values and other supported placeholders for dynamic information.

Q: Can I edit a Snippet after inserting it into a conversation?

Yes. Review and edit the populated message in the composer before sending it.

Q: Is there a limit to how many Snippets I can create?

HighLevel currently documents no fixed Snippet limit. Use folders, search, and filters to manage larger libraries.

Q: What permission is required to use Snippets in Conversations?

The user needs **Conversations → View & manage conversation** permission. Manage this from **Settings → Users → Roles & Permissions**.

title_en: How To Manage Dashboard Permissions
source_md:
Dashboards can be private to their creator, or they can be shared with different roles at different access levels.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What Are Dashboard Permissions?](#What-Are-Dashboard-Permissions?)
- [Manage Dashboard Permissions](#Manage-Dashboard-Permissions)
- [Set Permissions On A New Dashboard](#Set-Permissions-On-A-New-Dashboard)
- [Set Permissions On An Existing Dashboard](#Set-Permissions-On-An-Existing-Dashboard)
- [Agency vs Account Views](#Agency-vs-Account-Views)
- [Agency View Of Dashboard Permissions](#Agency-View-Of-Dashboard-Permissions)
- [Account View Of Dashboard Permissions](#Account-View-Of-Dashboard-Permissions)
- [Roles and Permissions Hierarchy](#Roles-and-Permissions-Hierarchy)
- [Export data](#Export-data)

---

## **What Are Dashboard Permissions?**

Dashboards offer the following levels of permissions:

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Level | Description |
| FULL | Gives the person the ability to create, edit, share, and delete Dashboards |
| EDIT | Gives the person the ability to edit a dashboard and the widgets. The person isn't able to delete the dashboard. |
| VIEW | Gives the person read-only access to a Dashboard |
| NO ACCESS | Restricts access to the dashboard entirely |

Here are how different actions on dashboards work for different level of permissions

|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
|  | FULL | EDIT | VIEW | NO ACCESS | PRIVATE DASHBOARD | OWNER |
| Manage Permissions | ﻿✅﻿ | ﻿❌ | ﻿❌ | ﻿❌ | ﻿❌﻿ | ﻿✅﻿ |
| Delete Dashboard | ﻿✅﻿ | ﻿❌ | ﻿❌ | ﻿❌ | ❌﻿ | ﻿✅﻿ |
| Set as Default Dashboard | ﻿✅﻿ | ﻿❌ | ﻿❌ | ﻿❌ | ﻿❌﻿ | ﻿✅﻿ |
| Edit Dashboard | ﻿✅﻿ | ✅ | ﻿❌ | ﻿❌ | ﻿❌﻿ | ﻿✅﻿ |
| Clone Dashboard | ﻿✅﻿ | ✅ | ﻿❌ | ﻿❌ | ﻿❌﻿ | ﻿✅﻿ |
| View Dashboard | ﻿✅﻿ | ✅﻿ | ✅ | ﻿❌ | ﻿❌﻿ | ﻿✅﻿ |
| Duplicate to another Sub-Account (Only Agency Level) | ﻿✅﻿ | ✅ | ✅ | ﻿❌ | ﻿❌﻿ | ﻿✅﻿ |

Only dashboard Owners or roles with Full permission are able to edit a dashboard's permissions.  
  
Agency Admins always have Full access to all non-private dashboards.  
  
Only Account Admin or Agency roles with full access to a dashboard are able to set it as a default dashboard.  
  
Only Agency roles are able to duplicate a dashboard to another subaccount.

---

## **Manage Dashboard Permissions**

### **Set Permissions On A New Dashboard**

**Step 1: Add A Dashboard**

Navigate to Dashboard, click on the Dashboard Selection menu (blue), then click on Add Dashboard.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155044433881/original/rQJh1RSrr244FcvqH8VsYlSNaL1_5L9_6A.png?1743641657)

**Step 2: Select Blank Dashboard**

Under Create a Blank Dashboard, click Select.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155044433890/original/lpbrI6m-ixLatlPsrrpGNDCwvkylimB_Fw.png?1743641724)

**Step 3: Set Permissions and Save**

On the New Dashboard modal, leave the dashboard private, or turn that off to access sharing permissions. When you are happy with the settings, click Confirm to create the new dashboard with those permissions.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155044433908/original/9V9Sr9PLG29YqUu0VXW1O2t2yRRyqmHvdQ.png?1743641801)

---

## **Set Permissions On An Existing Dashboard**

**Step 1: Action Manage Permissions**

On your existing dashboard, click the 3-dot "action menu", then click Manage Permissions.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155044433750/original/XBQjE4b9QWgmSCGpAV3ShVjvdPCuPizE5g.png?1743641029)

**Step 2: Set Permissions and Save**

Use the Private toggle to switch between private (only yourself) or sharing permissions.

When you are satisfied with your permissions changes, click Save to close the modal and return to the dashboard.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155044433989/original/whua1cN1ou81Jrr3_UI7SGEnO-PPebUdng.png?1743642044)

---

## **Agency vs Account Views**

Permissions screen and options changes as per the role of the logged in user

### **Agency View Of Dashboard Permissions**

Agency Admins will always have full access to all dashboards except those marked private by their creator. In the Agency view, there are three roles with access settings: Agency User, Account Admin, and Account User.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155044434191/original/ag_owqTRkCZiAF5mHoJ3MUHYMr0kLRkY-g.png?1743643164)

### **Account View Of Dashboard Permissions**

In the Account view there are two roles with access settings: Account Admin and Account User.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155023290478/original/LNohQGZJfVvUZVBvP4IWBFbbhDDct6fjHA.png?1711017852)

---

## **Roles and Permissions Hierarchy**

Dashboard Permissions follow a clear hierarchy to ensure smooth management of access levels:

Agency Admins > Agency Users > Account Admins > Account Users.

Permissions for higher-level roles will override permissions for lower-level roles. Lower-level roles cannot posess higher permissions than higher-level roles.

For example, if a dashboard is set to Account Admin:Edit and Account User:Edit is changed to Account Admin:View, then Account User will be automatically changed to View as well.

---

## **Export data**

The Export data permission controls whether a user can export data from dashboard widgets. This helps teams share reports while giving admins control over when dashboard data can be downloaded.

---

**Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: What happens if no permissions are set?**By default, dashboards are visible to all users unless restricted.

**Q: What does "Only Assigned Data" restrict exactly?**It filters dashboard widgets to only show data related to the user's assigned records (contacts, opportunities, etc.).

**Q: How do I remove a user or role from a dashboard?**Re-open the permissions modal for the dashboard and uncheck the user or role.

---

**Related Articles**

- [How to Edit a dashboard](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000001536)
- [How To Clone A Subaccount Dashboard](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000001534)
- [How To Pin Favorite Dashboards](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000001535)

title_en: How to Setup Voicemail in HighLevel
source_md:
HighLevel lets you upload a custom audio recording for company voicemail, individual user voicemail, or a voicemail drop in a workflow. For reliable playback, prepare the recording in a supported format and test it after uploading.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [Audio File Requirements](#audio-file-requirements)
- [Set Up Company Voicemail](#company-voicemail)
- [Set Up User Voicemail](#user-voicemail)
- [Add a Voicemail Drop to a Workflow](#workflow-voicemail)
- [Prepare Your Recording](#prepare-recording)
- [Test and Troubleshoot Your Voicemail](#test-voicemail)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#faq)
- [Related Articles](#related-articles)

---

## **Audio File Requirements**

Before uploading a voicemail recording, use the following recommended settings:

| **Requirement** | **Recommended Setting** |
| --- | --- |
| **File format** | MP3 or WAV |
| **Audio quality** | 64 kbps |
| **Content** | Clear, pre-recorded voice message |

```
Important: Higher-quality audio is not always better for voicemail delivery. If the recording does not play correctly, convert or export it at 64 kbps, upload it again, and retest.
```

---

## **Set Up Company Voicemail**

Use company voicemail when you want a default voicemail recording for the Sub-Account.

1. Go to **Sub-Account → Settings → Phone System**.
2. Scroll to **Call & Voicemail Settings**.
3. Upload the MP3 or WAV voicemail file.
4. Save your changes.
5. Call the HighLevel phone number from another phone and allow the call to reach voicemail.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082701498/original/vaVrcVOLC2Z69nRAY4UF33joNFVSyPiPfg.png?1791355312)

---

## **Set Up User Voicemail**

You can configure a separate voicemail recording for an individual user.

1. Go to **Sub-Account → Settings → Users**.
2. Open the applicable user.
3. Open the user's call and voicemail settings.
4. Upload the MP3 or WAV voicemail file.
5. Save the user's settings and test the call flow.

When creating a user from **Users**, available setup options can include call-forwarding defaults and voicemail configuration.

A user's voicemail can take precedence when the contact or phone number is assigned to that user.

---

## **Add a Voicemail Drop to a Workflow**

Use the Voicemail workflow action when you want to deliver a pre-recorded voicemail through automation.

1. Open the appropriate **Workflow**.
2. Click the **+** button to add an action.
3. Search for and select **Voicemail**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082701531/original/zsGjQF-dvEgc4xilkupskQuSw__fINJ6Uw.png?1791355340)
4. Upload the pre-recorded **MP3 or WAV** file. For best compatibility, use **64 kbps**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078594921/original/eqhXXr-UlF3Mvr-kqDF9haxfz7fiBypahQ.png?1786969104)
5. Click **Save Action**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082701546/original/G0ytCnyvaAtxD1bzZSySWxVXZiLH_Fa9mw.png?1791355360)
6. Save or publish the workflow as appropriate.

Test the workflow with a test contact before using the voicemail drop with your intended audience.

---

## **Prepare Your Recording**

You can create the voicemail with any recording or audio-editing tool that can export a compatible file.

- Record in a quiet environment.
- Speak clearly and at a consistent volume.
- Keep background noise to a minimum.
- Export the recording as **MP3 or WAV**.
- Use **64 kbps** for voicemail compatibility.

If you already have a recording, you do not need to record it again. Convert or export the existing file to the recommended format and quality when necessary.

Third-party audio tools can be used for recording or conversion. HighLevel does not require a specific external tool.

---

## **Test and Troubleshoot Your Voicemail**

### **Test Company or User Voicemail**

1. Call the HighLevel phone number from a different phone.
2. Allow the call to reach voicemail.
3. Confirm that the correct recording plays.
4. Listen for distortion, unusually low volume, or playback problems.

### **Test a Workflow Voicemail Drop**

Run the workflow with a test contact and confirm that the expected recording is delivered.

### **If the Audio Does Not Play Correctly**

1. Confirm the file is **MP3 or WAV**.
2. Convert or re-export the recording at **64 kbps**.
3. Upload the new file.
4. Save your changes.
5. Test the call or workflow again.

For company or user voicemail, also review the **Incoming Call Timeout**. If the timeout is too long, a forwarding number's carrier voicemail may answer before the uploaded HighLevel voicemail can play.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: What file format should I use for voicemail?**

Use an MP3 or WAV file. For reliable voicemail playback, 64 kbps is recommended.

**Q: Why does my voicemail file upload successfully but not play correctly?**

The audio encoding or quality may not be compatible with reliable carrier playback. Re-export the recording at 64 kbps, upload it again, and retest.

**Q: Can an individual user's voicemail override the company voicemail?**

Yes. A user's voicemail can take precedence when the contact or phone number is assigned to that user.

**Q: Where do I configure voicemail for an individual user?**

Go to **Sub-Account → Settings → Users**, open the applicable user, and access the available call and voicemail settings.

**Q: Can I use the same recording for a voicemail greeting and a workflow voicemail drop?**

Yes, provided the file meets the supported format and audio-quality requirements for the intended use.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Ringless Voicemail & Voicemail Drops Setup Guide](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48000981430-ringless-voicemail-and-voicemail-drops-in-highlevel-setup-guide)
- [Workflow Action - Voicemail](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000003373)
- [Overview of Phone Number Configuration Options](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001229976-phone-number-settings-explained)
- [Phone Number Edit Configuration: Incoming Call Settings](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006881-phone-number-edit-configuration-incoming-calls-settings-)

---

title_en: Create Website QR Codes That Follow Page Changes
source_md:
HighLevel lets you create QR codes for website pages without manually entering URLs. Generate a QR code directly from the Website Builder or select a website and page in the QR Code Builder. Website QR codes stay connected to their destination even when the page slug or domain changes.

**Table of Contents**

- [What Are Website QR Codes?](#what-are-website-qr-codes)
- [Key Benefits of Website QR Codes](#key-benefits)
- [Prerequisites and Limitations](#prerequisites)
- [How to Create Website QR Codes](#how-to-create)
- [Manage and Customize Website QR Codes](#manage-customize)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#faq)
- [Related Articles](#related-articles)

---

# **What Are Website QR Codes?**

Website QR codes link directly to specific HighLevel website pages rather than fixed URLs. They allow businesses to share website pages through printed materials and digital channels while automatically maintaining the correct destination after page slug or domain changes.

---

## **Key Benefits of Website QR Codes**

Website QR codes simplify page sharing and provide flexible customization options.

- **One-click creation:** Generate QR codes directly from the Website Builder.
- **Automatic destination updates:** QR codes continue opening the correct page after slug or domain changes.
- **No manual URL entry:** Select a website and page directly in the QR Code Builder.
- **Custom branding:** Personalize colors, shapes, logos, and backgrounds.
- **Flexible sharing:** Download as PNG, SVG, or PDF, or use Add to Wallet.

---

## **Prerequisites and Limitations**

To generate a QR code from the Website Builder, the website must have a connected domain.

**Important:** The original QR type labeled **Website** has been renamed **URL**. Existing QR codes continue working as before. The new **Website** type links directly to selected HighLevel website pages.

---

## **How to Create Website QR Codes**

Create a QR code from the Website Builder for the current page or use the QR Code Builder to select a website and page.

### **Method 1: From the Website Builder**

Generate a QR code for the page you are editing without manually selecting its destination.

1. From your **Sub-Account** view, navigate to **Sites → Websites**.
2. Open a website with a connected domain.
3. Select **Pages**, choose your page, and click **Edit Page**.
4. Click the **QR code icon** beside the page URL.
5. In the QR code window, select **Download** to export as PNG, SVG, or PDF. Alternatively, click **Edit QR** to open Step 3 of the QR Code Builder for customization.
6. Scan the QR code to verify that it opens the correct page.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084674780/original/edS57qZnSCS-Ti1zH46dUm9ltAG-QQ97MA.png?1793519480)

### **Method 2: From the QR Code Builder**

The Website QR type lets you select a destination directly without copying or pasting a URL.

1. From your **Sub-Account** view, navigate to **Sites → QR Codes**.
2. Click **Create QR Code**.
3. Enter a **QR name**, select the new **Website** type, and click **Next**.  
     

   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084674824/original/12TOTWOQdJJTCy-uX2Uj25Ce0Eg8oCGMFg.png?1793519900)
4. Under **Additional information → Content**, select your **Website** and **Page** from the drop-down.
5. Click **Next**.  
     

   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084674863/original/fttXhdvqXav03SHmqX_BEDweh2Ph6b9D6w.png?1793519957)
6. Under **QR color and shape**, customize the appearance of your QR code.
7. Click **Save**, then download the QR code in your preferred format.

---

## **Manage and Customize Website QR Codes**

Website QR codes can be edited, downloaded, saved to a digital wallet, and filtered from the QR Codes library.

### **Customize an Existing QR Code**

You can update a saved QR code's appearance to match your branding without recreating the code.

1. From your **Sub-Account** view, navigate to **Sites → QR Codes**.
2. Locate your website QR code and click **Edit**.
3. Customize the available settings: **Color**, **Shape & form**, **Logo**, **Page background**, and **Rim content**.
4. Click **Save**.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084675055/original/IbaxM_1iOh33iQx0hNqMw8rhJuGHijHtaw.png?1793520719)

### **Additional Management Options**

The QR Codes library provides options for keeping codes accessible and sharing them with your audience.

- **Add to Wallet:** Open the QR code editor and click **Add to Wallet** below the preview. The wallet pass displays the Website and Page names.
- **Filter Website QR codes:** Navigate to **Sites → QR Codes**, click **Filter**, and select **Website** to view website-specific QR codes.
- **Share a QR code link:** Use the available copy-link option to share a QR code without downloading its image.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084674978/original/3JdWAuVq9XkoIHcA4lZ9IFFoLUWwNHlarg.png?1793520331)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I still create a QR code for a manually entered URL?**

Yes. Select the **URL** QR type. This is the previous Website QR type, renamed in the new release.

**Q: Can I create a QR code for a funnel page?**

Yes. Select the **Funnel** QR type instead of Website.

**Q: Can I share a QR code without downloading the image?**

Yes. Use the copy-link option from the QR code window or QR Codes library.

**Q: Can I access a saved wallet pass offline?**

Yes. The wallet pass can be viewed offline, but opening the linked website may require an internet connection.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [QR Code Generation and Download Guide](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004583)
- [Manage QR Codes with Search, Filters, Views, and Bulk Actions](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006540-manage-qr-codes-with-search-filters-views-and-bulk-actions)
- [Saving QR Codes to Apple Wallet or Google Wallet](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009239-saving-qr-codes-to-apple-wallet-or-google-wallet)
- [Websites Overview](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000001633-websites-overview)

title_en: How to Integrate Jobber with HighLevel
source_md:
HighLevel now integrates with Jobber to keep client data aligned between operations and marketing. This article explains what the integration does, who it’s for, and how to set it up—covering two‑way client/contact sync, bulk deployment for agencies, historic imports, and the included snapshot. Learn how to roll it out quickly and avoid duplicate data entry.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is the Jobber Integration with HighLevel?](#What-is-the-Jobber-Integration-with-HighLevel?)
- [Key Benefits of the Jobber Integration](#Key-Benefits-of-the-Jobber-Integration)
- [How To Set Up the Jobber Integration](#How-To-Set-Up-the-Jobber-Integration)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is the Jobber Integration with HighLevel?**

The Jobber integration connects field‑service operations in Jobber with sales and marketing in HighLevel. Client and contact information stays synchronized across both platforms, so teams can run day‑to‑day jobs in Jobber while automating communications and pipelines in HighLevel—without re‑typing data or risking mismatched records.

---

## **Key Benefits of the Jobber Integration**

- **Two‑way Client Sync:** Keep names, emails, phones, addresses, and more consistent across systems.
- **Reliable Matching:** Linkage by Jobber client ID prevents duplicate records when emails/phones change.
- **Historic + Live Sync:** Import past client data from a chosen date, then continue syncing new clients automatically.
- **Snapshot Included:** Start with prebuilt workflows and message templates to launch faster.
- **Marketing+Ops Alignment:** Run jobs in Jobber while leveraging HighLevel for funnels, CRM, and automation.
- **Reduced Manual Work:** Eliminate repetitive data entry and lower error rates.
- **Consistent Reporting:** Unified client data improves attribution and campaign targeting.

---

## **How To Set Up the Jobber Integration**

Proper setup ensures your data syncs accurately and your team can start using the included snapshot and workflows immediately. Follow the steps below for the agency and each sub‑account.

```
Note: The app can only be viewed and installed by Agency Admins. The app is not visible/available to sub-accounts until the agency has install the app.
```

### **Step 1:** Agency‑Level Installation & Bulk Deploy

1. In HighLevel (Agency view), open **App Marketplace**.
2. Search for **Jobber**.
3. Click on the **Jobber Integration** app.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/n6A7mU6pwuHOatG3Pl35+/Screen+Shot+2025-10-22+at+7.33.22+PM.png)
4. Click **Install**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/XQ0IkNwoYjm7F0MYeXeC+/Screen+Shot+2025-10-22+at+7.42.35+PM.png)
5. Select the **sub‑accounts** to deploy.
6. Click on **Proceed**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/ocpCcjM4aRBMoWE2bJ4A+/Screen+Shot+2025-10-22+at+7.44.23+PM.png)
7. Select the **Assets** you want to **push/update** from the snapshot.
8. Either **Proceed without conflict check** with current data in the sub-account(s).
9. Or **Proceed to check conflicts**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/diQxQLRosdELsPSGwwbL+/Screen+Shot+2025-10-22+at+7.46.21+PM.png)
10. If you Proceed to check conflicts, click on the **+** icon to expand and review conflicts in the sub-account. Subsequently, choose the assets you wish to overwrite.
11. Click on **Proceed**.
12. Type **Confirm** in the box and click on **Proceed**.  
      
    ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/3JnSuod7JPUJ6yWgmMj1+/GIF+Recording+2025-10-22+at+7.55.26+PM.gif)
13. Click **Allow & Install**.  
      
    ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/NtA4zxh7aAlnpDXkl7da+/Screen+Shot+2025-10-22+at+7.58.28+PM.png)

### **Step 2:** Sub‑Account Connection

1. Switch to the **sub‑account.**
2. Click on**App Marketplace → Installed Apps → Jobber**.
3. Click **Connect** and complete the authorization flow.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/y8TfIa2QF5TlEeIIdDgd+/GIF+Recording+2025-10-22+at+8.23.20+PM.gif)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I connect more than one sub-account to a single Jobber account?**

No, Jobber only supports one active connection. This means that you can only connect one HighLevel sub-account to a unique Jobber account.

**Q: How long does it take for the initial contacts<>clients sync between HighLevel and Jobber?**

Jobber allows syncing about 2500 records for every 5 minutes. So based on the start date you're selecting in "Sync Data" tab in your Jobber app, the system will take the necessary time to sync all the clients data inside HighLevel.

**Q: What all fields are synced between HighLevel and Jobber?**

First Name, Last Name, Email, Phone Number, Address, Lead Source, Jobber Client URL, Jobber Created Date, Tags.

**Q: What details are not synced between HighLevel and Jobber?**

Custom Fields on Jobber, Notes, Attachments.

**Q: How does HighLevel match clients with Contacts?**

HighLevel maintains the Jobber client's unique ID. This allows to maintain the sync even if you update the email or phone number

**Q: Can I pause or stop the 2-way sync?**

No, we currently don't have that option. To stop the sync without disrupting your workflows build in Jobber, you must disconnect the app from Jobber by navigating to Jobber App Marketplace > Connected Apps > LeadConnector App and click the Disconnect button.

**Q: Once I've initiated the sync, can I go back and change the start date for syncing my historic client data?**

No, syncing historic data from Jobber is allowed only once while initiating the Jobber data-sync. Once we've synced the historic data, you cannot modify the timelines and reinitiate the sync from a different start date.

**Q: Can I view logs of clients data that was synced?**

The sync-logs are currently not available.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Setting up QuickBooks Integration](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001153903)
- [Integrate Xero with GoHighLevel (GHL)](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006078)
- [Notion Integration with HighLevel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005812)
- [Private Integrations: Everything you need to know](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003054)

title_en: Facebook and Instagram Chat Widgets
source_md:
Bring real-time Messenger and DM conversations right to your website. The new Facebook Chat and Instagram Chat widget types let you greet visitors on the Meta channel they already use, boosting response rates and streamlining follow-ups.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What are Facebook & Instagram Chat Widgets?](#What-are-Facebook-&-Instagram-Chat-Widgets?)
- [Key Benefits of Facebook & Instagram Chat](#Key-Benefits-of-Facebook-&-Instagram-Chat)
- [How To Setup Facebook & Instagram Chat Widgets](#How-To-Setup-Facebook-&-Instagram-Chat-Widgets)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What are Facebook & Instagram Chat Widgets?**

Facebook Chat and Instagram Chat are **channel-specific** options inside the HighLevel Chat Widget. Instead of opening a website messenger, these widget types **redirect** visitors to the selected Meta channel (Messenger or Instagram DM) so conversations continue natively on Facebook or Instagram. Each type comes with a dedicated setup panel in the builder for selecting (or connecting) the correct Facebook Page or Instagram business account.

---

## **Key Benefits of Facebook & Instagram Chat**

- **Frictionless Engagement**: Visitors continue the conversation in Messenger or IG DM without creating a separate on-site chat thread.
- **Channel Preference**: Meet customers on the social platform they already use for daily messaging.
- **Better Adoption**: Leverages users’ existing Facebook/Instagram logins and apps.
- **Unified Inbox:** Keep every Meta conversation inside HighLevel’s Conversations inbox alongside SMS, email, and WhatsApp.
- **Cross-Device Continuity**: Conversations persist in the user’s Messenger/IG app, so threads follow them across devices without losing history.

---

## **How To Setup Facebook & Instagram Chat Widgets**

Follow these steps to quickly and easily create a Facebook or Instagram chat widget that you can install on your website!

#### **Step 1:** Create a New Widget

Navigate to **Sites** → **Chat Widgets** then select the blue **+****New**button.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155060348475/original/elOj_5dm-_s2o0sUdzfnGJj623Dq3ovuUw.png?1765388725)

#### **Step 2:**Select Chat Type

In the "Select the type of chat” pop-up, choose **Facebook Chat**or**Instagram Chat**.

If a Facebook/Instagram account is connected but no pages are selected, a page selection modal opens up to select the page to be used in the widget.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155060350088/original/yO7fZsVYCVXXsGVHatbDlcCq6bgQDfR5Vg.jpeg?1765390979)

**Important:** You cannot select Facebook Chat or Instagram Chat here unless a corresponding account is already connected to the sub-account. If you don’t have a connected account yet, the in-modal link will instead prompt you to connect an account (e.g., Connect Facebook/Instagram under integrations). Open this link, connect your account, then return to this selector to choose the chat type.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155060350092/original/jsVdwN__K5cjKScy1fhL_BpcM8DtY01HBQ.png?1765390994)

#### **Step 3:**Customize the Widget

Customize the **Style**, **Chat Window** and **Messaging** tabs as needed (colors, greeting text, launcher icon) to build a widget that matches your brand. For additional design options, see [Overview of Chat Widget Customizations.](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000002960)

Within the **Chat Window** tab, you can change what Facebook/Instagram account is linked to the widget. If needed, click **Connect a linked Facebook/Instagram account**button to open the new connection modal and add more pages/accounts.

After making all required edits, save your widget.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155060350150/original/hCpviuit3NtfBrynsJe5_HGgO4PThscLtA.png?1765391093)

#### **Step 4:**Share Your Widget

To install this widget on a 3rd party site, click **Get Code t**hen embed the code snippet on your website/funnel where you want the widget to appear. If you are installing it onto a Wordpress site, click **Get it for Wordpress.**This widget can also be installed directly within the HighLevel Funnel and Website builders

To learn more, check out [How to Install HighLevel's Chat Widget](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48000984860)

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155060349629/original/tkuC8Q7A2ZfTxvzZkN4MegGTa8PChiaJaw.png?1765390165)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I enable both Facebook and Instagram in one widget?**

No. Each widget is tied to a single channel. For multi-channel bubbles, use the All-in-One Chat widget.

**Q: Will conversations show up inside HighLevel’s Conversations tab?**  
Yes, provided your Facebook/Instagram integrations and permissions are correctly connected and messaging access is enabled.

**Q: Can I run automations on incoming messages?**

Absolutely! Use the Facebook Message or Instagram Message workflow triggers to tag, assign, or route the chat.

**Q: Does the visitor have to be logged in to Facebook or Instagram?**

Yes. If they are not logged in, the Meta login screen opens first.

**Q: Do Style and Messaging settings work differently for FB/IG widgets?**  
No. Styling and placement behave the same as other chat types. The main difference is **where** the conversation occurs (Meta vs on-site).

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Getting Started with Chat Widget](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004102)
- [How to Install HighLevel’s Chat Widget](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48000984860)
- [Step-by-Step Guide to Facebook Integration in HighLevel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001157632)
- [Connect Instagram: Facebook-Linked vs. Direct Instagram Integration](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001213003)
- [How to Use the All-in-One Chat Widget](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004779)

```

title_en: How to Add Your Own Email Service (MailGun) in Agency
source_md:
Email Infrastructure

How to Add Your Own Email Service (Mailgun) in Agency

Connect your own Mailgun account to the platform so your agency sends email through your infrastructure — with your own reputation, domain, and volume limits.

Overview

By default, your agency sends email through the platform's built-in LeadConnector Email System. If you have an existing Mailgun account with an established sending reputation, higher volume requirements, or a dedicated domain, you can connect it directly at the agency level.

This guide covers where to find the Email Services settings, the difference between the default and a custom service, and a complete step-by-step walkthrough for adding and activating Mailgun in your agency.

## Where to Find Email Services

The Email Services settings live inside your agency account — not inside individual sub-accounts. Navigate here before making any changes:

1. Log in to your Agency account
2. Click **Settings** in the left sidebar
3. Select **Email Services**
4. Open the **SMTP Service** tab (also labeled **Advanced Settings** in some versions)

Tip

Your interface may show the tab as **SMTP Service** or **Advanced Settings** — both lead to the same configuration area.

## Default vs. Custom Email Service

Your agency starts on the shared LeadConnector Email System. Connecting Mailgun replaces that with your own sending infrastructure. Here's how they compare:

| Feature | Default (LeadConnector) | Custom (Your Mailgun) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Sending domain | Shared platform domain | Your own verified domain |
| Sender reputation | Shared with other senders | Fully owned by you |
| Volume limits | Platform-managed | Based on your Mailgun plan |
| Setup required | None — works out of the box | API key + domain configuration |
| Best for | New agencies getting started | Agencies with established sending history or high volume needs |

Heads Up

Switching to a custom email service affects all outbound email sent from your agency. Make sure your Mailgun domain is fully verified and your API key has the correct sending permissions before activating.

Setup Guide

Adding Your Own Email Service (Mailgun)

Follow these five steps to connect your Mailgun account to your agency.

## Step-by-Step: Adding Your Own Email Service (Mailgun)

Step 1

Open Email Services

From your agency account, go to **Settings → Email Services → SMTP Service** tab.

Step 2

Click + Add Service

In the top-right corner of the page, click the **+ Add Service** button. A popup titled **Add your own email service** will appear.

Step 3

Select Mailgun as Your SMTP Provider

From the list of available providers in the popup, select **Mailgun**.

![SMTP provider selection screen showing Mailgun option](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155073953045/original/qyEWS4o0kk1ZySrPNiltmgA0ALWON6bDTA.jpeg?1781774144)

Select Mailgun from the provider list in the Add Service popup.

Step 4

Enter Your Mailgun Credentials

Fill in the required fields using details from your Mailgun account dashboard:

- **API Key** — Your Mailgun API key. Found under **Settings → API Keys** in your Mailgun account.
- **Domain** — Select the verified sending domain you want to use from the dropdown.

![Mailgun credential form showing API Key and Domain fields](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155073953029/original/kDOiN0NIZRnIA9bvyWE-Axu7FCz1MIMU3Q.png?1781774130)

Enter your Mailgun API Key and select your sending domain.

Step 5

Save and Set as Active

Once saved, your Mailgun service will appear in the list but won't be used until you activate it. To start using it:

1. Find your newly added service in the list
2. Click **Set as Active**
3. Confirm the selection in the prompt that appears

You're All Set

Your agency will now send all outgoing email through your Mailgun account. You can return to **Settings → Email Services** at any time to switch services or add additional providers.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Does this setting apply to all sub-accounts under my agency?

Yes. The custom email service you set as active in **Settings → Email Services** applies at the agency level and becomes the default sending service for sub-accounts that have not configured their own. Individual sub-accounts can override this with their own service if needed.

Q: Where do I find my Mailgun API key?

Log in to your Mailgun account and go to **Settings → API Keys**. You'll see your Private API key listed there. If you haven't generated one yet, click **Add new key**. Make sure the key has sending permissions for the domain you plan to use.

Q: What if my domain doesn't appear in the dropdown?

Only verified Mailgun domains will appear in the domain dropdown. If your domain isn't listed, go to your Mailgun account and confirm the domain is fully verified (all DNS records — SPF, DKIM, and MX — must be in place). Once verified in Mailgun, return here and try again.

Q: Can I add more than one Mailgun service?

Yes. You can add multiple services — for example, separate entries for different Mailgun domains or accounts. However, only one service can be marked as **Active** at a time. The active service is what all agency-level outbound email will use.

Q: Can I switch back to the default service after activating Mailgun?

Yes. Go back to **Settings → Email Services** and set the LeadConnector Email System as active. This immediately reverts all agency-level outbound email to the platform's default sending infrastructure.

Q: Will switching affect emails that are already scheduled or in active workflows?

Emails already queued or mid-workflow will pick up the newly active service when they are processed. There is no rollback for emails already sent. Test your Mailgun setup during a low-traffic window if you want to minimize risk during the transition.

Q: Does using my own Mailgun account cost extra?

Connecting Mailgun is free on the platform side — there's no additional charge for using a custom SMTP service. However, Mailgun's own pricing applies based on the volume of emails you send through your Mailgun account. Review Mailgun's pricing at their website for details.

title_en: Staff in Field Services
source_md:
Staff are the people you send out on jobs. When a staff member is fully set up, Field Services can suggest them for the right visits, at the right times, in the right places. This article explains how to add staff and configure their working hours, services, service areas and route.

```
Note: Field Services is currently in private beta and is available to selected accounts. Features and screens may change as we improve them.
```

## In this article

- [What is a staff member in Field Services?](#what)
- [Where to find staff](#where)
- [How to add a staff member](#add)
- [Basic details](#basic)
- [Assign services and set a visit limit](#services)
- [Weekly working hours](#hours)
- [Eligible service areas](#areas)
- [Dispatch settings (route start and end)](#dispatch)
- [Frequently asked questions](#faq)
- [Related articles](#related)

---

## What is a staff member in Field Services?

A staff member is a user in your sub-account who can be assigned to visits. Setting up a staff member completely makes them **bookable**. A bookable staff member has:

- Working hours.
- At least one assigned service.
- At least one eligible service area.

![Staff list under Services & staff](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084162774/original/lACDGriDDBMG2mf7gmgLTnNXnAkdL_Pqeg.jpg?1792999499)

---

## Where to find staff

1. Go to **Field Services > Services & staff**.
2. Click **Staff** under **Coverage & staff**.

The list shows each staff member's name, email, phone number and type. Use the search box to find someone, and click the pencil icon to edit them.

---

## How to add a staff member

1. On the Staff page, click **New staff**.
2. Enter the staff member's details and add them.
3. Click the pencil icon next to the new staff member to finish setting up their hours, services, service areas and route.

The staff editor has five sections, described below.

---

## Basic details

- **Photo:** Upload a PNG, JPG or GIF.
- **First name, Last name, Email:** Required.
- **Phone number:** Optional.
- **Timezone:** The staff member's time zone. Make sure it matches where they work so hours show correctly to customers.

---

## Assign services and set a visit limit

Open **Assign services** to choose which services the staff member can perform. Services are grouped by category. Tick a category to select all of its services, or use **Select all**.

Turn on **Set visit limit** to cap the number of visits that can be assigned to this person per day, week or month.

![Assign services and visit limit for a staff member](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084162775/original/HOVNwZIu2cpfKE834WI6P_hnDlol9yufNg.jpg?1792999501)

---

## Weekly working hours

Open **Weekly working hours** to set the days and times the staff member works. These hours describe their overall availability. They are not set per service or per service area.

| Control | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Day toggle** | Turns a working day on or off. |
| **Start and end time** | Sets the working block for that day. |
| **Add interval** | Adds more than one block in a day, for example a morning and an afternoon shift. |
| **Copy icon** | Applies a day's hours to other days. |

![Weekly working hours editor](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084162777/original/z_DAxLSWL_HDvHd36ogo0BS_TZYdBEtS2w.jpg?1792999504)

---

## Eligible service areas

Open **Eligible service areas** and tick the areas where this staff member can be assigned work. The page shows how many areas are assigned, for example "1 of 1 areas assigned". Use **Select all** or **Deselect all** to change everything at once. See [Service Areas in Field Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009371).

---

## Dispatch settings (route start and end)

Open **Dispatch settings** to set where the staff member's day starts and ends. Field Services uses these points to plan the shortest route.

| Field | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| **Route start** | The staff member's day-start location. This is the starting point for route optimization. |
| **Route end** | Where the staff member ends their day. |

Enter an address and select it from the suggestions. A green **Location confirmed** message tells you the address was recognized. Click **Save** when you are done.

![Dispatch settings with route start and route end](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084162778/original/ODOmx4f-3W_Mqo9u1UvHIiNBaQmADENu3g.jpg?1792999506)

```
Note: Route start and end are used by Route optimization. Set them for every staff member who works routes. See the Route Optimization article.
```

---

## Frequently asked questions

**Why is a staff member not showing in suggested times?**  
Check that they have working hours for that day, are assigned to the selected services, serve the customer's service area, and are not already booked or blocked.

**Can I assign someone who is not set up for a service or area?**  
Yes. When you schedule a visit manually you can choose any staff member. The suggested times only include staff who match the service and service area.

**Do office staff and owners need to be added as staff?**  
No. Add only the people who go out on jobs. Other team members can still use Field Services based on their user permissions.

**Can a visit have more than one staff member?**  
Yes. You can assign more than one staff member to a visit. Field Services checks that all selected staff are available at the same time.

---

## Related articles

- [Service Areas in Field Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009371)
- [Services and Add-ons in Field Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009373)
- [Scheduling Visits and Finding Availability in Field Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009377)
- [Route Optimization in Field Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009380)
- [Timesheets in Field Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009383)

title_en: How to Upgrade a Voice AI Agent to the New Voice AI Experience
source_md:
Upgrade your Voice AI agent to the new Voice AI Experience for improved call quality, better stability, and more natural conversations. This article explains what the upgrade does, how to prepare, and how to upgrade an existing Voice AI agent safely.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is the Voice AI Agent Upgrade?](#What-is-the-Voice-AI-Agent-Upgrade?)
- [Key Benefits of the Voice AI Agent Upgrade](#Key-Benefits-of-the-Voice-AI-Agent-Upgrade)
- [How To Upgrade the Voice AI Agent](#How-To%C2%A0Upgrade%C2%A0the-Voice-AI-Agent%C2%A0)
  - [Step 1: Access the AI Agents Menu](#Step-1%3A%C2%A0Access-the-AI-Agents-Menu)
  - [Step 2: Select the Agent to Upgrade](#Step-2%3A%C2%A0Select-the-Agent-to-Upgrade)
  - [Step 3: Review and Confirm Upgrade](#Step-3%3A%C2%A0Review-and-Confirm-Upgrade)
- [Testing and Optimizing Prompts](#Testing-and-Optimizing-Prompts)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is the Voice AI Agent Upgrade?**

The Voice AI Agent upgrade moves an existing Voice AI agent to the new Voice AI Experience. This can improve voice quality, call handling, response behavior, and overall call stability. After upgrading, review and test the agent because prompts, responses, and call behavior may perform differently in the new experience.

---

## **Key Benefits of the Voice AI Agent Upgrade**

Upgrading can improve the way your Voice AI agent handles live conversations:

 

- **Smarter call handling:** The agent can respond more naturally and manage conversations more smoothly.
- **Better voice quality:** Improved tone and clarity can make calls sound more professional.
- **Improved stability:**The upgraded experience is designed to provide more reliable call performance.
- **Access to newer Voice AI improvements:** Upgraded agents can take advantage of newer Voice AI capabilities as they become available.
- **Simple transition:**Existing agents can be upgraded individually, allowing you to test and adjust each agent before relying on it in production.

---

## **How To****Upgrade****a Voice AI Agent**

Before upgrading, review the agent’s configuration and test plan. The upgrade is permanent, so we recommend duplicating or documenting the agent’s current setup before upgrading.

```
Note: The upgrade is permanent. After upgrading, review the agent’s prompts, settings, and test calls. We recommend duplicating the agent or saving a backup of the current configuration before upgrading.
```

### **Step 1:**Open Voice AI

1. Log in to your sub-account.
2. Go to AI Agents > Voice AI.
3. Review the list of available Voice AI agents.

### 

### **Step 2:**Select the Voice AI Agent

1. From the Voice AI agent list, click the name of the agent you want to upgrade.
2. Alternatively, click the three-dot menu next to the agent name, then select Edit.

```
Tip: Confirm that you selected the correct agent before upgrading. The upgrade is permanent.
```

![](https://jumpshare.com/v/jmVxkCHpCKliFJ2ptWZA+/Screen+Shot+2025-06-26+at+12.26.55+AM.png)

### **Step 3:**Review and Confirm the Upgrade

1. On the agent edit page, click Upgrade to New Voice AI Experience.  
     
   **![](https://jumpshare.com/v/5zmmKB9SJBQUg29m4OAA+/Screen+Shot+2025-06-26+at+12.56.44+AM.png)**
2. Review the upgrade details shown in the confirmation modal.
3. Click Upgrade to New Voice AI Experience to confirm and complete the upgrade.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/v/FnJvWe5PUbc7bQhgKg6P+/Screen+Shot+2025-06-26+at+1.05.52+AM.png)

---

## **Testing and Optimizing Prompts**

After upgrading, test the agent before using it for live calls. This helps confirm that prompts, tone, call handling, and actions still work as expected.

 

- Run sample calls to check tone, clarity, response accuracy, and conversation flow.
- Test important scenarios, such as appointment booking, call transfers, workflow triggers, or custom actions if the agent uses them.
- Review transcripts and recordings to identify prompt updates.
- Adjust prompts as needed to improve naturalness, accuracy, and task completion.
- For prompt-writing guidance, see AI Prompting 101.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Will upgrading affect my existing call flows or prompts?**

The upgrade may affect how prompts, responses, and call behavior are handled. Test the agent after upgrading and adjust prompts or settings if needed.

**Q: Can I revert to the previous Voice AI version if needed?**

No. The upgrade is permanent. If you want to preserve the previous setup, duplicate the agent or document the configuration before upgrading.

**Q: Is there any downtime during the upgrade process?**

Upgrading is typically seamless, but you should test the agent before using it for live calls.

**Q: Are there additional costs for upgrading to the new Voice AI Experience?**

The upgrade is included with your existing Voice AI access. Standard Voice AI usage or subscription charges may still apply.

**Q: How do I know if my agent is already upgraded?**

Upgraded agents display an UPGRADED badge next to the agent name in the Voice AI agent list.

**Q: Can I upgrade multiple Voice AI agents at once?**

No. Each Voice AI agent must be upgraded individually so you can review, test, and adjust each agent separately.

**Q: What should I check after upgrading?**

After upgrading, test the agent’s greeting, prompt behavior, call transfers, appointment booking, workflow triggers, custom actions, and any phone or availability settings used by the agent.

**Q: Should I duplicate the agent before upgrading?**

Yes. Because the upgrade is permanent, duplicating the agent or saving a copy of the current configuration is recommended before upgrading.

---

## **Related Articles**
